Get more sales for your store with our all-in-one Product Review App 
 ConfidentCustomer automates the process of getting video, image and text product reviews for your Shopify store and turns visitors into customers. Get product unboxing and demonstration reviews and build interactive and real social proof for your store. 
 3 Simple Steps to get Reviews from our Product Review app 
 •     Send Email/SMS invitation to customers to leave a product review 

 •     Customers leave either a video, image or text review of their purchase 

 •     All reviews appear on your Shopify store, search results, and can be instantly shared on any social platform 
 Tons of Product Review Features to boost your store 100% Free to Start off 
 We understand that most store owners are just starting off their e-commerce journey. That’s why we have Free Forever Plan that gives you unlimited invites, product reviews, store widget and a lot more. 
 Pioneer in Video Product Reviews 
 ConfidentCustomer is the only and pioneering Shopify video product reviews app in the marketplace. You won’t get any other app that combines Video, Text and Photo Product Reviews  under one dashboard. 
 Send Bulk Product Review Invites 
 You either have 1 or 1000 of customers on your Shopify store, send bulk product invites via email or SMS to your customers to review your store products. 
 Get High-Impact Video Product Reviews 
 Actions speak louder than words. That’s why video product reviews have the highest conversions from other reviews forms. ConfidentCustomer provides a quick and seamless solution for your customers to leave video product reviews. 
 Google Stars Snippets and Store Ratings in Search Results 
 Let’s face it – Google powers more than 70% of traffic for top online stores and with its new Rank Brain algorithm, it values user’s engagement as the top search ranking factor. Having a Google-approved star rating widget that is visible in search engines not only gives a boost to search ranking but it also doubles your click-through rates. 
 Turn Reviews into High-Converting Retargeting Ads 
 Videos as boasts are the highest engagement and conversion from all forms of product ads. Use video product reviews from your store into high converting Facebook or Google Ads and get more traffic and sales with validated social proof. 
 Share your reviews on Social Media 
 Social Media is one of the best growth channels for online stores. Gain more visibility, engagement, reach and new customers by sharing your product reviews across top social media platforms.

The easiest way to run sweepstakes, contests, giveaways, competitions, and other engaging promotions directly on your Shopify store. Launch sweepstakes, contests, or giveaways in minutes that will explode your email list, grow your social media profiles, and increase your store’s sales. 
 With ViralSweep, you'll have the power to: 

 *Access all the apps we offer, including: Sweepstakes, Contests, Giveaways, Competitions, Instant Win, Referrals, Social Comments, and Email Collection.

title: Loyalty Program ‑ Beans
description:
You spend time and money to get customers, they are very happy with your products but never come back! 

 Keeping customers loyalty in 2018 is tough, especially when it comes to online shopping. There are so many distractions, competition is aggressive, and customers eventually forget about you. 

 The good news is solutions exist. The Beans Loyalty Program creates bonds between you and your customers by: 

 
 Making customers addicted to your products with a loyalty points system 
 Rewarding customers to spend more and increasing loyalty 
 increasing customers' love and loyalty for your brand 
 
 How does Beans Loyalty Program work? 
 Create a loyalty program to reward your customers to increase your revenue and profitability. Customers get rewarded with loyalty points that entitle them to a discount in your shop. 
 How Beans Loyalty Program helps you make more money? 
 
   Capture email addresses 
 

 Reward customers who create a shop account to capture more emails. 

 
   Increase loyalty and customers satisfaction 
 

 Customers know that the more they buy the more you are grateful, so they are happy to keep buying and therefore your customer loyalty increases. 

 
   Increase average order value 
 

 Reward customers who spend over a certain amount, automatically get your customers to spend more. 

 
   Increase repeat purchases frequency 
 

 For example, give extra rewards to customers who purchase twice or more in the same trimester and increase loyalty. 

 
   Increase 5 stars review 
 

 Get more customers reviews by rewarding for their reviews. 
 Extra features 
 
   Notifications 
 

 Beans Loyalty Program sends customized notifications to your customers about their rewards points balance so they don’t forget to come back and spend their credit. 

 
   Integrations 
 

 Connect other tools to your loyalty program and extend its capacity, including Juge.me, Shopify Product Review, Mailchimp... 

 
   Time based campaigns 
 

 Create urgency among your members of your loyalty program with limited time promotions such as double and triple loyalty points campaigns. 
 Frequently asked questions 
 
   How long would it take to see results? 
 

 Loyalty program is a mid to long term marketing strategy. Significant impact on revenue will be noticeable after 6 to 12 months. 

 
   How long does it take to set it up my loyalty program? 
 

 This Loyalty program software is automated you can set it up in 5 min. 

 
   Do you provide installation assistance and customization for Beans Loyalty program? 
 

 Yes, we can get an engineer to do a custom loyalty program for you. Please note that you will be charged a fee for that. 
 About Beans 
 Selling online is very competitive and is getting tougher every day. Beans empowers you with the latest marketing technologies so that you stand above the crowd.

title: Testimonials & Reviews by EVM
description:
PRODUCT REVIEWS, TESTIMONIALS & PHOTO REVIEWS 
 This Product Reviews app has 2 parts. First one is Customer Testimonials and other one is Product Reviews. Both are must have features that are needed for Shopify stores.  
 PRODUCT REVIEWS 
 One of the best reviews app with very simplified admin dashboard at an affordable pricing structure. 

 You can show product reviews on the product pages and any other page as well. This app let your customers submit reviews about your products from frontend and you can moderate it from the admin side. We tried to keep the reviews dashboard very simple for you so it can be managed easily. 
 Product Reviews App Features: 
 1 - Send Review Request: 
Using this app, you can send review request to customers from the app easily. 

 2 - Customers can Write Reviews in Email Directly: 
Customer will get reviews request in his email and he can submit review directly inside email itself.  

 Customer doesnt have to open your site to write review, reviews can be written inside email and submitted. This is one of the best feature to collect reviews easily. 

 3 - Moderate the Reviews:
Admin can see the reviews in dashboard of app easily and moderate. 

 4 - Import Reviews:
You can import reviews from Shopify or other services as well. 

 5 - Faster Loading Time:
Fast loading reviews widget for your site. 
 Customer Testimonials 
 Testimonials are an important part of ecommerce websites. It allows the new customers to read views from old customers about your products. Almost every customer read past reviews before making a decision to buy the product from a site. 

 By using this app, you can showcase all your customer testimonials at one place in a nice grid format. You can even collect testimonials from past customers using our frontend submission form. 

 THE ONLY TESTIMONIAL APP THAT ALLOWS YOU TO DO THE FOLLOWING -  

 Manually add testimonials from admin and showcase on frontend.
Photo Reviews feature added in the app. Its a new way to show Testimonials on your site using original photographs sent by customers. 
 Let your customers submit testimonials from frontend & you can moderate from admin. 
 
 Grid & Slideshow format style. 
 5 premade templates available to select which you can customize too. 
 Add testimonials on frontend and a separate page too. 
 SEO friendly testimonials that can help in improving site seo too. 
 You can even reorder the submitted testimonials easily. 
 
 Photo Reviews 
 This app allows you to show a Photo Review option as well so the customers can submit the product pictures in their reviews. It increases engagement on the site and make it more lively by showing real photos by customers.

title: Custom Announcement Bar
description:
How Announcement Bar Works? 
 Motivation is the energy that lies beneath every purchase decision. Determining how to influence and direct that energy towards your offerings is the key to higher sales figures and better conversion rates.   

 Providing free shipping or presenting something extra as a gift are the proven sales motivators in eCommerce. Also, these goodies can help you increase customers’ loyalty and strengthen emotional ties with your brand. 

 The app creates a custom-tailored announcement bar that motivates customers to complete a purchase.  

 The bar timely informs customers that once they achieve the set ‘goal’ (a certain about of money spent in your store), they unlock the above-mentioned benefits.  

 It works as a trigger for making a purchase for all kinds of customers: new, hesitating, those who are comparing options or those on the verge of placing an order — and can potentially increase conversion rates and the average order value manifold.  
 Info Bar Design & Content 
 The app enables you to create a motivation bar that ideally blends with your website style. With the app, you can:  

 
 specify the bar’s position (relative, fixed bottom or top),  
 set the background color, top, and bottom padding, Z-index,  
 customize the bar’s borders. 
 

 More than that, you can fill the bar with a series of custom messages that describe the steps to achieve the set ‘goals’. The toolkit enables you to:   

 
 create an initial message (displayed to the first time site visitors), 
 set up a congratulation message (shown upon the achievement is unlocked). 
 

 For each message, you can add a link. This may come useful when you need to send customers to a promo campaign landing page or want to provide them with more info about your offerings.  
 Bar Display Rules 
 The Display Rules are one of the most powerful features of the app that allow you to maximize the marketing potential of the sales motivator bar.  

 With this functionality, you can hide/display the bar for the targeted:  

 
 website pages (the homepage, any product, collection page or the shopping cart), 
 locations (countries),  
 time periods/days of the week,  
 device types (desktop, mobile).  
 

 Additionally, for each bar, you can set up display timeout and delay, as well as add custom CSS styles.

title: B2B Handsfree
description:
Handling B2B / wholesale customers is different than managing regular consumers in multiple ways. You usually want to qualify business customers before showing them wholesale pricing, and if you’re in the EU you’ll want to get their VAT ID so they can buy from your store without paying VAT. 
 Custom registration form for wholesale customers 
 With B2B Handsfree, your wholesale customers register for an account on your store using a custom registration form. Wholesale customers in the EU can enter and validate their VAT ID, which is critical info for you as the merchant, so you can verify the customer is actually a business. 

 But that’s not all. Unlike the regular registration form, where a customer first registers an account with her name, email and password and can only add an address after registering, our custom registration form lets customers register with their full business info right away, including their full address, company name and phone number. Unlike Shopify's default signup process, this familiar workflow is how experienced wholesale customers expect a B2B store to work. 
 Automatic account invite after registration & VAT exemption 
 After completing the registration form, wholesale customers get an email with a link through which they can set a password for their newly created customer account. The app also sets foreign wholesale customers to tax-exempt and automatically adds their VAT ID to every order as an order attribute. You can then include the VAT ID in Order Printer invoice templates and elsewhere, which is legally required in order to be able to sell to EU business customers without charging VAT.  
 Configure the app's settings to match your requirements 
 All these features can be enabled or disabled depending on your specific requirements. Want to verify new wholesale customers by hand? No problem. Just disable the automatic account invite and send it out manually after you’ve verified the customer. Don’t want to set EU B2B customers to tax-exempt automatically? Simply uncheck the appropriate checkbox in the app’s settings. 

 Last but not least, the app (optionally) sends you an email every time a new customer submits the B2B registration form. That way you can immediately double-check who is registering a business account. 
 Features overview 
 
 Custom registration form for B2B customers with VAT ID validation and full contact data. 
 Customers automatically receive an email to set a password for and activate their account. 
 Automatically set foreign wholesale customers to tax exempt. 
 Include customers’ VAT ID on Order Printer invoices and elsewhere. 
 Get notified whenever a B2B customer registers a new account. 
 Coming soon: Automatically assign a tag to new wholesale customers (useful for wholesale apps that change pricing based on tags)

Better engage your customers by switching the displayed pages and collections of your store depending on their location.

 The GeoSwitcher allows you to make your pages and product collections specific to the place your visitors connect from by automatically and seamlessly adapting the displayed content in real-time.

 and …

title: Loyaltyplex
description:
Loyaltyplex Supercharge your loyalty program. 
 The story of e-commerce today is one where thousands of options are competing for your customer's attention and traditional points-based rewards simply won't cut it when it comes to ensuring customer loyalty.
Loyaltyplex lets you create a fun and engaging loyalty rewards experience through defining levels of loyalty and rewarding customers based on how frequently they make purchases and earnings based on their current level. 
 Gamify your rewards 
 The most engaging experiences are the ones in which the next levels are not too easy to reach while not being too inaccessible either. Define as many levels or as few as you like for no extra charge. 
 Interactive Ops Center 
 Upon installing the plugin, you also get free access to Loyaltyplex interactive ops-center, where you can visualize customer retention metrics, update your plugin theme or update your program policy whenever you like, 
 Flat fees, no hidden charges 
 Service as many customers as you like and define as many levels to your program as you'd like for no extra charge.  
 How it works 
 Consider a sample policy might look like- 

 
 0-10 Credits 2% cashback in rewards  
 11-50 Credits 2.4% 
 ... 
 

 According to this sample, a new customer will be level 1 and earn 2% cashback in the form of loyalty points on making a purchase which they can either redeem on a subsequent purchase or accumulate more to move up to the next level and earn higher % credits on subsequent purchases until they move further up. 
 Keep 'em coming back for more. 
 Once a customer has made a purchase they will return either to redeem their rewards or to earn more rewards to move up to a higher level. Either way, it means more sales for your store and higher engagement for your customers. 
 Specifications 
 
 Loyaltyplex is a close-loop rewards system, meaning rewards earnt by customers can only be spent at your store. 
 The plugin does not use any external authentication and uses your store's login to maintain customer session. Hence you need to enable register/login functionality in order for your customers to earn rewards while shopping at your store. 
To enable customer login in your admin console-> click on Settings->Checkout->Accounts. 
Normal checkout flows will still work as expected even for disabled/guest users. 
 The app is lightweight and the entire functionality is implemented using script tags in conjunction with price-rules,  this means that the expenses can be audited easily and your reporting/audit system will not be affected by any of the plugin functionality. 
 Points are earnt on the final total after applying any discount (Excluding taxes and shipping) 
 

 So sign-up for a free trial today, define your loyalty policy and watch as they can't get enough and keep coming back for more..

title: Trending Sort
description:
This Might Be The Easiest Way To Boost Your Profits & Slash Your Bounce Rate Within Minutes! 
 Want to hear something crazy? As few as one fifth of the products in your store are bringing you the majority of your traffic, conversions, and profit. Go on, check your analytics. You'll see that of all the items in your store; a select few are getting all the attention. It's incredible! 

 What's even crazier is... you can boost your conversions and slash your bounce rate by showing these products more. Sorting your products based on performance is the smartest way to ensure your customers see your best side first. Plus, it gives them the best chance of converting to a sale.  
 Doesn't Shopify Already Have This Feature? 
 The answer is - YES and NO.  

 Sure, you can order your products by name, creation date, price and best sellers. But there are three key reasons why the in-built Best Sellers feature falls short!
1. You need very high sales volume for this feature to be accurate. 
2. It does not cater to new products and shows stale rankings. Older products are will often rank better, even if they're not best sellers. 
3. There's no way to make sure it shows your most profitable products first. Which means, products with low profitability and high-sales volume could be displayed instead. 
 Power Tools Trending Products Takes It To The Next Level... 
 
 Accurately rank your products by performance. No matter how big or small your store is.

title: Simple Coming Soon
description:
What is ‘Simple Coming Soon’? 
 Simple Coming Soon is a convenient, time-saving app that allows you to build a stylish coming soon landing page within minutes; no programming required. 
 Why do you need a coming soon page? 
 An attractive coming soon page helps you generate interest and intrigue as you work on your website behind the scenes.  

 By displaying a stylish coming soon landing page your business will never miss out on the opportunity to grow brand awareness. As you work towards delighting your customers with a new or more advanced store, your online branding remains consistent and engaging.  

 What’s more, a coming soon page also provides enhanced communication with your target audience. Conveniently, our handy countdown timer and contact form ensure your customers will never be kept in the dark in relation to why your store is not currently ‘live’. 

 Plus, if you want to get the word out that your fantastic new site is about to launch, a coming soon landing page is a must! With ‘Simple Coming Soon’, you’ll have an actual webstore link to share with your followers and fans. 
 Benefits, Features and Options: 
 
 An adaptive coming soon page that looks great across all devices 
 Use custom text/a call to action on your coming soon page 
 Add your corporate logo; use brand-appropriate background imagery 
 Google fonts support 
 Social network buttons 
 SEO data 
 Live countdown timer 
 Collect subscriber data while in coming soon mode 
 Fast, responsive technical support 
 Coming Soon page appear on the domain root (‘Pro’ plan) 
 
 Future features 
 *(Jan 19) App ‘auto-deactivates’ when the coming soon countdown reaches ‘0’. 
 How does Simple Coming Soon work with Shopify? 
 Put simply, the Simple Coming Soon app adds a coming soon landing page to your store. You can customize the style of this page to reflect the tone and feel of your brand. The coming soon page will be visible to anyone who is not logged in to your Shopify store. Meanwhile, you or any other logged-in staffers can access the under construction/under maintenance site as normal, i.e. anyone logged into the store can continue to update content or make changes. The app works with any Shopify store. 
 How do I get started? 
 Installation is simple: just go into the app listing admin area of your Shopify store, then click on our app icon; in the app settings, check the ‘Activation’ checkbox and save changes. Note, that you need to disable all similar applications before use. Please, don't forget to deactivate the app when your website maintenance/upgrades are complete. 

 How can I deactivate the application?
If you have already deleted the app, please install it again. Go to the app settings page and uncheck the ‘Activate the application’ checkbox and click the save button. Now you’re done!

title: Product Warnings on Checkout
description:
Looking for an app that notifies customers about all product aspects before proceeding to the checkout? If so, you're in luck! 

 This app displays a proper and lightweight pop-up, when specific products are added to the cart. You can even disable purchasing of specific products displaying an alert message instead. The pop-up content is highly customizable and can be modified to suit best for your business. 
 How does it work? 
 It's all very simple. The app allows to display a custom content pop-up before the product is added to the shopping cart. You just have to define the pop-up content and select the relevant products. The app will do everything else. 
 Features: 
 
 Pop-up confirmation messages to warn the customers before checkout 
 Pop-up alerts to prevent the purchase of specific products or product variants 
 Location dependent warnings (California P65 and others) 
 Global warnings for all the store products 
 Customizable pop-up content 
 Editable text message below specific line items, which is shown on the cart and checkout pages 
 Enabled/Disabled tumbler 
 Mobile friendly 
 
 Use cases: 
 
 For certain products, lead time may be prolonged. Notify your customers about it. 
 Some products are exposed to increased risk of shipping damage. Suggest a specific shipping method to your customers. 
 Some products or product variants may be available on pre-order. Warn your customers that the lead time for such products is slightly extended. 
 Some of your products can not be shipped to the specific locations. Or you might want to ask the customers for the additional confirmation (e.g. California Proposition 65). 
 Certain products are not available in specific countries. Notify your customers about it. 
 If the product is intended for adults only, you may demand an additional confirmation of customer's age. 
 You may want to display additional terms and conditions for specific products. 
 For certain products, you may want to disable the checkout option to prevent your customers from receiving broken or frozen products during the coldest winter days. 
 And much more! 
 
 Looking for installation help? 
 If you need any help with the app setup or customization, don't hesitate to contact us via e-mail!

title: Transportr
description:
Did you know that you could be losing sales and potential customers due to un-handled 404 errors? 
 Transportr makes creating, editing, managing and monitoring Shopify redirects hassle free. Easily create individual redirects or thousands with just a single upload. 
 Why you should use Transportr 
 
 Make moving from another platform to Shopify quick and easy. 
 Prevent potential lost sales for visitors requesting old and outdated links. 
 Create and analyze vanity URLs for email marketing and ad campaigns. 
 Easily identify 404 events in real-time and correct them 
 
 Detailed redirect requests and history 
 You can optionally have Transportr create a "target proxy" which will record all requests made to that redirect. Traditional Shopify redirects will simply forward the visitor to the target URL leaving you clueless to who's visiting your redirects and where they're coming from. By using Transportr target proxies, all redirect events are recorded including date/time, the referring URL, user agent, search engine type and IP address. 
 Real-time 404 tracking 
 Transportr will automatically embed a light-weight tracking script into your 404.liquid file to track any 404 events that occur on your shop. This will log event data such as date/time, the referring URL, user agent, search engine type and IP address. 
 Target finder 
 Tired of hunting down the correct url to redirect to? We'll import all of your products, blogs, pages and collections so you can easily search and apply the correct target URL. 
 Google Webmaster integration 
 Link Transportr to your Google Webmaster account and import 404 logs. When creating redirects or fixing 404s, Transportr will automatically mark your 404 events as fixed on Google.

description:
Cyfe is an all-in-one business dashboard app that helps you easily monitor all your business data from one place (e.g. social media, analytics, marketing, sales, support, infrastructure, etc). 

 
 Monitor Everything: Monitor individual departments, multiple websites and anything else using dashboards.

 Historical Data: Data from the past is archived within Cyfe, so you will never lose sight of it again. 
 Data Exports: Download or schedule email reports of your data in PNG, JPEG, PDF, and CSV formats. 
 TV Mode: Automatically rotate one or more dashboards for your big screen monitor.

title: Easy Responsive Videos & Maps
description:
What is Easy Responsive for? 
 Nowadays the most of Shopify themes are responsive so you're getting a good looking website on all the devices out of the box. But there're two things that are not responsive in the most themes: YouTube and Vimeo videos, and Google Maps. 

 Our small app solves that problem and makes your videos and maps responsive, so they're looking good across all the devices. 
 What pages are supported? 
 The app works on Pages, Articles, Products and any other page on your website. 
 Installation 
 Installation is extremely simple: just install the app on your store, and it will start working immediately making your maps and videos responsive! No need to add any codes to your templates manually. 
 Configuration 
 By default, the app uses 16:9 aspect ratio for both videos and maps while making them responsive, but if you prefer different aspect ratio (for example, if you'd like to have square maps), you may adjust dimensions in the app settings easily. 
 Supported videos and maps 
 At the moment our app supports YouTube and Vimeo videos, and Google Maps. If you're using another video hosting - please contact our support team and we'll do our best to add its support for you.

      YouTube,
     
     
      Vimeo,
     
     
      Google Maps

title: Speed Optimization Analyzer
description:
Speed Optimization Analyzer - Tips and Insights to Speed up your store loading time 
 The Speed Optimization Analyzer app lets you get powerful insights on how to improve your store loading time. It analyzes your store and generates several tips and insights on how to speed up your store. The tips are various and ranked by importance. The analysis lets you know what technical modifications you must make to your store and theme to make it load faster. 

 With the practical tips the app provides, you can easily limit the bottlenecks of your store's loading speed. 
 Get better ranking in search engines and thus more traffic 
 Google has announced that it takes websites speed and loading time in their ranking algorithms to give better search results. As a result, improving your store loading time and performance gives it higher chance of being in the first results and thus providing more traffic to your store. 
 Get higher conversion rate with better speed performance 
 Loading time is directly linked to conversion rates. Studies show that customers take loading speed very seriously and online stores often lose several customer because of the loading time of their stores. 

 As such, alongside marketing and advertising, making a faster Shopify store is one of the best ways to increase your conversion rate and let your customers have a good user-experience. 
 Features 
 
 Analyze any page of your store and get speed optimization tips 
 Get powerful insights on how to optimize your scripts and style-sheets 
 Get a list of resources(files) loaded by your store and find out which of them take longer to load and sort them by size or load time 
 Get easy to implement but also advanced tips that will increase your store performance 
 Get a global score on your store performance 
 Easy to use and user-friendly UI

title: Member Pricing
description:
Member Pricing is a complete solution for membership rewards, and wholesale pricing management. Encourage the customers you have to spend more in your shop with this simple yet powerful system.  
 What's in the app? 
 A way to set up custom pricing levels for different customers.  

 
 Set up triggers for automatic membership for customers based on registration, number of orders, and total amount spent. You can also manage it manually. 
 A configurable smart email system that enables you to set email notifications to your customers of membership status engagement in your site. Let your customer know when they've become an exclusive member. 
 An optional, configurable banner notification system that allows you to encourage registration for new customers, and tell existing customers of their membership status and savings. All this in a few easy clicks. 
 
 What can I do with it? 
 Here are some examples: 

 
 Approve and allow wholesale customers to receive products tax free and with a major discount as they shop just like a normal customer. 
 Automate a rewards program with tiered discount rewards that emails your customers when they unlock them. 
 Increase engagement as well as email collection with incentivized account creation. 
 Your unique needs? The app is actively being developed. Help us shape the future of the design to fit your needs. 
 
 How Does it work? 
 Member Pricing uses discount codes it creates automatically that are specific to tagged customers only. This means that the discount codes cannot be used by other customers as some other apps allow. 

 Because it uses discount codes, Member Pricing also does not create extra variants so your inventory stays clean and in sync.  

 The customers see the prices on your site that they will pay at checkout. These prices include the discount so they are encouraged to spend more money.  
 Free Installation 
 Member Pricing will be installed on your site fast and free automatically.

title: Invoice Hero
description:
Invoice Hero 
 Sending professional looking invoice creates trust and long lasting impact of your brand in customer's mind. Just sending an email of the order confirmation is good. However, sending a proper pdf file of generated invoice along with taxes and other information will go long way in creating a trust bridge between you and your customers. 
 Invoices for international orders 
 Issuing invoices is particularly important when you're shipping your products globally. Tax authorities are especially alert on overseas sales and purchases which is why it’s best to always issue a proper tax invoice with your international shipments. 

 In many countries worldwide, it is even mandatory that businesses issue proper invoices for their international sales. Also, many merchants add invoices into packages together with packing slips and return forms. 
 Provide Business Legal Information 
 Your invoice must include your official business name. If there are other associated names, those must be mentioned as well. An example could be "Quality Merchants" as the business name, and "a franchise of XYZ Online Markets" as a secondary indicator. 
 Customize your Invoice 
 We provide the flexibility to add your company's logo and signature to make the invoice look more professional and trustworthy. 
 Resend Invoice 
 The invoice is sent automatically when the order is generated on your store. However, if the customer accidentally deletes the email containing the invoice or does not receive the invoice you can send the invoice again at any point of time by just a click! 
 Download and Print Invoices: 
 You can download the invoices at the time of shipping your order and can print it and attach it with your shipping parcel so that customers receive the invoice in a physical form as well. You do not need to maintain a separate software just to generate and print invoices anymore!

title: Shopkeeper Easy Gift Cards
description:
Shopkeeper Easy Gift Cards adds a single, simple form to your gift card product page that lets shoppers add a "from" name and personal note to gift cards purchased from your store. 

 The app adds the following fields to your gift card product page:
* Recipient's name
* Sender's name
* Personal note 

 Not only does this make sending a gift card a simple and easy process, it lets your customers make their Shopify gift cards a bit more personal with a personal note and the ability to sign their name. 

 Adding a personal note lets your customers send gift cards to friends, family and other important people in their lives for any occasion — whether it's birthday, Christmas or "just because." 
 How it works 
 
 Customer selects a gift card amount from your preset options. 
 Customer enters the recipient's name, their name and a note in clear and easy to use fields. 
 Customer adds the gift card to your store's cart and check out as normal. 
 The gift card is emailed to the customer for forwarding to the recipient. 
 The recipient clicks the link in the gift card to open the gift card and see redemption instructions. 
 
 A better look for your Shopify gift cards 
 Gift card recipients receive an immersive, animated gift card experience that's also mobile and print friendly and prominently displays the personal note and gift giver's name so they know who the gift is from. See the demo URL below to see the full experience. 
 Why sell gift cards? 
 
 Gift cards are a great way to make it easier for customers to send gifts without having to worry about picking the right size or color. 
 Gift card purchasers tend to spend over the face value of the gift card, giving you more revenue. 
 Gift cards are a great way for existing customers to introduce new customers to your store. 
 
 Simple, easy pricing 
 No transaction fees or other hidden fees. Our flat rate app pricing includes sending unlimited gift cards. 
 More great gift card apps 
 If Shopkeeper Easy Gift Cards isn't quite right for you, be sure to check out our full line of Shopify gift card apps. 
 Important note 
 Please note that this app requires a Shopify account with the gift card feature. It does not add the ability to send and redeem gift cards to lower level Shopify plans.

description:
Every successful business has strong sales team and each sales team requires the best tools. Most online stores miss out on sales representatives who can market and sell the products. This is mostly because lack of features for sales rep scenarios. With the Sales Rep by Chief Software Solutions app, we solve this problem! 

 Using this app merchants can add sales reps to their online store. You sales reps can do 4 things from your online store: 
 1. Send Invoices to Clients 
 
 Your sales reps can send invoices to clients and get a commission when the invoices are paid. 
 You can also set different discount levels for the invoices 
 You can configure the commission that your sales rep get. 
 
 2. Place Wholesale orders 
 
 Store owners can set custom wholesale prices per product type. So your sales reps can purchase products at wholesale prices and then sell them forward at retail price, hence making a profit. Orders will be sent as invoice to sales rep email. 
 Advanced plan feature: Give quantity based discounts. 
 
 3. Affiliate links 
 
 Each sales rep gets their own affiliate link  which they can share and market on their social media. 
 You can set the affiliate commission from admin back office.

 Advanced plan feature: Each rep can  
 
 4. Discount coupon code 
 
 Each sales rep gets their own unique discount coupon code, which they can share on social media and email.  
 You can give commission whenever a sales is made using the sales rep's coupon. 
 We track all sales made using the coupon and we track the commission payouts. But our app does NOT manage the affiliate commission payouts. 
 

 Once the app is installed and configured, your sales representatives can login to your online store and access all the features from their accounts page.

 Customize the sign up page to send invoices for Sales rep kits, additional form fields etc.

description:
Youneeq is a proven and award-winning Artificial Intelligence company that increases revenue and engagement levels for Digital Publishers and now, E-Commerce Stores.  
 Why Youneeq? How does it work? 
 We use state of the art machine learning techniques in order to recommend to your customers the products they're most likely to buy. We analyze the behaviour of all the customers on your store in real-time and combine it with historical data in order to craft our recommendations. 

 We also offer a real-time dashboard which tracks pageviews, referrals and revenue on your store. It identifies products which are hot today and provides a traffic graph which includes  the average traffic on your store. 

 Our app is FREE for the first 30 days and if we don't make you more than $250 in a billing cycle it's FREE for that cycle. You can track your bill in our dashboard so you'll never be surprised and we'll send you an estimate at the end of your trial. 
 Features 6 Different Recommendation Types: 
 
 Standard: Our standard recommendation type. It uses machine learning to provide the best possible recommendations to each user. 
 Top: Recommends the most popular products in your store. 
 Trending: Recommends products which are currently hot in your store. 
 Recent: Recommends products that the customer has recently viewed. 
 Also Viewed: Recommends products which customers who viewed the current product also viewed. 
 Similar: Recommends products which are similar to the one the customer is currently looking at.
# Customizable Recommendation Panel
Customize the panel title, how many products go in each panel and whether you want to display the price and vendor name. You can drag and drop the items which make up each individual recommendation to change their display order. 
 

 Each page type is independently configurable, so you can have a different recommendation type and panel on each page.

* Overview: Check out your traffic numbers for today in the hourly traffic graph, which includes the average traffic for your store. Keep an eye on your current bill, today's revenue, the devices your customers are using and the extra sales we've generated so far for you this month as well. 
 Quick and Easy Install 
 The app detects what theme you're using and match styles. By default the app displays the recommendation panel at the bottom of all pages. Get up and running in less than two minutes!

title: Dynamic Pricing
description:
Change prices automatically according to product sales volume 
 Create rules for product prices to adjust automatically, and watch your sales and revenue go up! 

 Choose products that you want the app to track, and create rules that will adjust the prices of these products. Increase the prices of your best sellers and reduce the prices of items with low sales volume. 
 Why should I use Dynamic Pricing to grow my Shopify business? 
 There's no need to spend time changing your products' prices manually. Let the app do all the work for you! You set the rules for optimal price alteration. Let your bestsellers bring in even more revenue entirely automatically. 

 Sell more of your weak items. Let Dynamic Pricing lower prices for poor sellers and watch their performance increase, making you more money. 
 How it works 
 
 Choose a date range for when you want to track sales activity. e.g. it can be done during peak times such as holidays, or alternatively, during slow times 
 Set up the rule, e.g. "if 8 or more are sold out, increase the price by $2" 
 One or more rules can be applied to one or more products. e.g. you can apply a rule to all of your t-shirts for the next 2 months 
 You can apply a rule to all the products in your store. e.g. Increase all prices by $1 if the total monthly amount for each selected product sold was $600 
 It works on a Variant level too, i.e. you can watch for and check the price of just one specific variant 
 
 Why customers choose our apps

 ✔️ Set start and end date to track sales activities

 ✔️ Reduce, increase or set fixed prices 

 ✔️ Apply rules to one, several or all products 

 ✔️ Apply rules to all variants of a product or to one particular variant 
 Examples

About us 
 Tshirtgang.com has been a leader in the print-on-demand t-shirt fulfillment industry since 2005. We provide members with all the automation tools and support, so that running their own on-line graphic garment store is easy and seamless. There's no need to purchase equipment or stock, we take care of all the printing and shipping for you.Simply upload your designs, and with a single click all your products automatically appear in your online store. 
 Why Choose Tshirtgang.com as your Fulfillment Partner? 
 Doing business with Tshirtgang.com couldn't be easier. Our team has fully integrated the fulfillment process with Shopify, so that orders are automatically sent to us for fulfillment at the click of a button.
All orders come with tracking numbers, and insurance, so in the event of a lost or damaged order we will replace it at no cost to you.
We Use the latest Digital Print Technology: At Tshirtgang we take quality seriously. We are constantly investing in the latest digital print technology to offer our customers the very best print quality.
No Order Minimums: We are a print-on-demand fulfillment company, so there are no minimum order requirements. You will always receive our lowest product fulfillment pricing. 
 Order Processing and Shipping Intervals: 
 All orders are processed (printed and shipped) within 2 business days.
For even faster processing we offer a 1 business day "Fast Track" processing option.
USA orders ship via First Class USPS and will be delivered within 2-3 business days.
Canadian orders ship via Expedited Canada Post and will be delivered within 2-5 business days.
International Orders ship via First Class USPS and will be delivered within 6-12 business days. 
 Product Pricing/ Shipping Rates: 
 Our buying power allows us to offer the most competitive pricing to our customers.
T-Shirts prices start are as low as $8.00. See our Pricing page for a complete list of our product offerings, as well as shipping rates. 
See for yourself exactly what your customers will receive. Tshirtgang.com offers samples of your products for 50% off and free shipping worldwide!

title: Mapeaks
description:
Get insights on your sales by viewing your store orders on a map and segmenting results according to a variety of filters. 
 Mapeaks comes in hand to help you get insights about orders and business strategies. The interactive world map and filters available give you the ability to extend your knowledge about your business by analyzing and extracting useful information that is not provided by default by Shopify. 
 Ever wondered how your customers orders would look like on a map? 
 Get a detailed view of all orders locations according to the criteria that most fit your need. You can refine your search by date range, minimum and maximum price, minimum and maximum amount of items, financial and order status. 
 Would I be able to see search statistics? 
 Yes. The following statistics are presented on every search: total of orders, total of customers, total amount of sales, total quantity of items, number of cities and states covered by the filtered orders. 
 Is it possible to get details of a single order using Mapeaks? 
 Yes. By clicking on a map marker is possible to get informations such as the order number, date and time of creation, total price and status. If you need a more detailed report, there is a button to get you directly to the order’s page on a single click. 
 How the app looks on mobile and tablet devices? 
 Mapeaks is completely responsive and will look great in any of your devices. Please check our presentation video above to look and feel the design. 
 Still not convinced after your trial? 
 Get in touch and let us know your questions and concerns. Our team would be happy to answer and help you in case you are experiencing any issue. 
 Is that all? 
 Absolutely not. Mapeaks will be actively supported and improved along the way.

title: Emailify
description:
What is Emailify? 
 Emailify allows you to create beautiful and professional looking Email notification templates for Shopify. Instead of manually fiddling with the code of Shopify's default notification templates, you can now use Emailify's visual editor to make your Emails look awesome.
You can think of Emailify as a theme editor for Shopify notifications. Pick a theme you like from the free library and adjust it to your needs with the integrated theme editor. 
Once you are happy with the result, copy the automatically generated template code and replace the Shopify default template with it. That's it!
Using Emailify doesn't require any coding and is so much easier than modifying Shopify's notification templates directly.
On top of that, Emailify comes with a number of language presets which allows you to quickly change the language of your notification Emails. 
 Features 
 
 Unlimited trial period 
 Free, configurable list of themes 
 Email theme editor similar to Shopify's visual theme editor with many familiar features like mobile preview, editable sections, drag & drop, etc. 
 Send preview Emails to your shop Email 
 Language presets for English, German, French and Spanish - localize your whole Email communication with one click 
 All texts are changeable through simple text fields or text editors 
 Use context-specific variables from a dropdown list in your templates. 
 Fine tune any theme by adjusting settings for colors, links, shadows, spacing, typography, etc. 
 Choose from many awesome fonts like Google webfonts 
 Include featured products and collections in your Emails 
 Include discount codes in your Emails and decide whether they should only be included after the first, the fifth or the tenth order 
 Include custom text blocks with images from any source 
 Include all your social media links like Facebook, Instagram, Youtube, LinkedIn, Weibo, etc. in every Email 
 Create custom footers that are included in every Email 
 Restore settings for sections / styles / general settings individually 
 Each theme contains all 18 Shopify templates
# How does it work? 
 Select and install themes from the list of free themes 
 Adjust and modify the theme settings 
 Modify Email texts, style settings and general sections to be appended to each Email with the theme editor 
 Once you are happy with the look of your templates, copy the generated template code and transfer it to your shop 
 Done!
# Unlimited free trial
You can try / modify / save / restore / preview themes and settings as long as you want.

title: SKYOU
description:
SKYOU is the most powerful on demand design platform to date. 
 Using our 3D design tool, you’ll be able to design and publish a huge variety of apparel & accessories to your Ecommerce store. Our powerful technology provides you with the freedom to truly create unique products for your customers. 
 What is manufacturing on demand? 
 Superior to print on demand (printing on pre-made low quality blanks) - We print, cut, sew, and garment wash each order as they are placed.  We’re not decorating, we’re manufacturing your brand! 
 Advantages of SKYOU over other POD platforms 
 
 Print anywhere, no charges for additional print locations 
 100% cotton (not poly) all over printing (t-shirts + hoodies) 
 Print graphics over seams with +/- 1mm accuracy 
 Vibrant bold colors through our reactive dye print process 
 Zero hand feel, no plastic feeling graphics (even on darks!) 
 Garment washed for softness 
 Highest quality and most unique product offering 
 
 The SKYOU order process: 
 
 Design your product with SKYOU app 
 Publish your products to Shopify (we generate high quality thumbnails automatically) 
 Your customer purchases the product 
 The SKYOU app receives order and begins manufacturing 
 The SKYOU team manufactures the order and ships it to your customer 
 We automatically transmit a tracking number to Shopify 
 
 You decide profit! 
 You set your products’ prices. We charge you a fair base price to cover manufacturing costs for each individual product. You can view all our products and prices in the pricing link. 
 Additional Info 
 Check out our FAQ’s for additional information on how to install our app, our product catalogue, pricing, how to use the 3d design tool and more. 
 About us 
 We’ve built out a retail quality on-demand manufacturing platform that allows for super high quality one offs, and products previously only available with large MOQ's (all over print cotton garments, backpacks, lunchboxes, etc.). Our largest differentiator is our quality, we actually manufacture each product we make from scratch -- printing onto white rolls of fabric, and then cutting and sewing into final form. Since we're making from scratch, you can print all over any of our products, and our patent pending tech also allows for graphics to match over seams with +/- 1mm accuracy. 

 Our CEO/founder started Timbuk2, the original mass customization bag company. We've also worked with all the big shoe manufacturers setting up and running their custom shoe programs (Nike, Reebok, Puma, Adidas, etc.). Suffice to say we have lots of experience in this industry helping large multinational brands, and as innovators in the space. SKYOU is a combination of all that knowledge, built into an easy to use platform that ships big brand quality direct to consumer.

title: Zestard Product Matrix
description:
Why use Zestard Product Matrix? 
 This app is especially useful for wholesalers and B2B (Business To Business). It allows ordering multiple quantities of products at once/ bulk order. Even when the product has multiple options and variants, it displays product matrix on the product page in such a way, that it becomes very to order multiple quantities of a product with different variants. 
 How Product Matrix will be displayed in my store? 
 The default Shopify product page view will be replaced by product matrix, which will display variants in an organized way according to the number of options such that customers can easily compare price and quantity of different variants. 
 Can I customize product matrix displayed on my Frontend? 
 Yes, the product matrix is highly customizable in terms of design, language, and positioning of options/variants. 
 How do I get started? 
 To get started, install the app into your Shopify store. From there, you will be directed to set up your product matrix general settings, which you can change according to your needs. Now by pasting shortcodes in product page and cart page as per the instructions are given on dashboard or help page, you are ready to go. 
 What are the main requirements for Product matrix to be displayed in my store? 
 The product should have at least one option and one variant added for that product. 
 How does minimum quantity validation work? 
 Minimum quantity value will be needed to add for each product from product settings section of the app.
Now, every time customer adds the product to cart and cart quantity is less than minimum quantity set from product settings, the customer will be prompted and will not be allowed to add the product to the cart.
After adding the product to the cart, if the quantity is reduced than the minimum quantity than also, an error prompt will be shown and the customer will not be allowed to check out unless cart quantity is less than or equal to minimum quantity. 
 Features : 
 
 Views all variants of a product using a matrix on the product page, such that customers can compare different variants. 
 Customers can order multiple quantities at once/ bulk order. 
 Quantity management/ Option for whether to allow out of stock products to order or not. 
 Price management/show default price or individual price for each variant. 
 Minimum quantity validation on the product page, as well as cart page as per the minimum quantity value set from product settings product wise. 
 Product matrix, displayed on frontend is highly customizable in terms of design and language options.

title: Simple Discount Code Generator
description:
Generate discount codes easily! 
 This discount code generator app integrates seamlessly with Shopify and lets you easily generate random discount codes in bulk or import discount codes from a CSV file from any existing discount page in a user-friendly manner. 

 Configure your discount as you would normally do from the Shopify Discounts section and generate/import codes for it via the "More actions" menu. 
 What problem does the app solve? 
 Shopify allows you to create discounts natively from the admin panel, but there's no easy way to generate multiple codes for the same discount. This is where this application comes into play. 
 How does it solve the problem? 
 It integrates seamlessly with the discount section in the Shopify admin panel and lets you generate or import discount codes for any existing discount in your shop. 

 This way, you don't need to recreate discounts by hand manually for each of your customers. You can simply configure your discount once and generate or import unique codes that you can then distribute. Note that it is also possible to specify a prefix for generated codes. 

 To generate or import codes, simply click on the "Generate discount codes" button from the "More actions" menu from any existing discount (after it has been saved). See the screenshots to get a better idea of how the application is integrated with Shopify. 
 Will this application change the look of my store? 
 No! Not at all! This application simply lets you generate or import codes for any existing discount in the Shopify admin section. It is not a customer facing application. 
 Features 
 The following features are currently supported: 

 
   Generate random codes and optionally specify a prefix for your discount codes. 
   Import codes from a CSV file. 
   Create up to 9999 discount codes at a time for a given discount. 
   Get realtime status updates of your discount code creation. Note that the creation runs in the background. You can leave the page and get back to it at any moment to get the status of a running creation.

description:
Why Ultimate Scarcity Pro ? 
 
 Count down timer are extremely effective to generate scarcity to inspire visitors to purchase as soon as possible before a product becomes unavailable. 
 Customize the look of your countdown timer by choosing from multiple styles and templates. Display immediately, after a set period of time, on a page’s bottom or top or below add to cart button. 
 With Ultimate Scarcity Pro timer, you can develop and implement a wide range of scarcity building solutions with just a few clicks. 
 Ultimate Scarcity allows you to display your real stock levels to show visitors that they should act quickly before they miss out. 
 
 Key Features: Countdown Timer - 
 
 Countdown timer type - There are options for your timer based on a specific date and time. This will hide when it expires or it'll auto reset when it comes to expire. 
 Multiple timer templates - You have the option to set different types of templates for different products! 
 
 Stock bar & timer - 
 
 Stock bar customization - You have the option to set a different coloured stock bar at different levels of stock. 
 Multiple font selection - Choose the font type which will match your theme layout for a better looking view of your timer. 
 Product selection option - There is an option to choose all products or specifically selected product(s) or selected collection(s) for which selected timer will display. 
 Timer alignment and position - Choose your timer alignment (left/right/centre) and position (top/bottom/below the add to cart button)

title: Buy Now Banners & Discounts
description:
Easy to Use 3-in-1 Conversions App Countdown Timer, Timed Discounts and Animated Banners All In One App 
 The philosophy behind building this app is simple. Many e-commerce customers abandon cart before making a purchase. Once they've purchased, customers are far more likely to purchase again. Instead of spending more money on retargeting, the idea is for them to  purchase now and in the process also acquire their email. We combine three of the most effective marketing techniques to skyrocket your conversion rate. 
 Timed Discounts 
 Fully customise your users' discounts allowing them to have a fixed discount, percentage discount and even free shipping. Once the user has been shown the banner, the countdown timer begins and the discount will run out if they don't order in time. The user pre-commits to purchase by having to click "Get My Discount" in order to get their discount, this already makes them far more likely to make a purchase during their session, however Buy Now Banners takes this to the next level. 
 Add-To-Carts Become Sales 
 The reason why this app works so well is that it provides value to your customers rather than taking it away (scarcity timer). Your customers will not want to buy later, if they can buy now at a discounted price using the code. Each code is uniquely generated for that customer, adding to the authenticity and trust given off by the app. The best part is, there is no bluff, the discount will run out if they do not purchase in time. 
 Extreme Versatility 
 This app allows you to combine timed discounts and sales features to make a myriad of highly converting banners. Below are just some examples of what you can do. Please see the demo store for some example use cases: 

 
 Create Engaging Countdown Timers  
 Timed Discounts On the Cart Page  
 Product Feature with Particle Effects  
 Advertise a Sale Happening on Your Store  
 Allow Users to Interact with Banners  
 Draw Attention To a Product or Collection  
 Convert Abandoned Carts to Sales Before They Even Happen  
 
 Amaze Users With Animation 
 Be unique and stand out from the crowd with your custom animated sales banners, typically such fancy animation is created by a web design team and can cost thousands of dollars to implement correctly onto your website, which is why you will notice only the bigger stores and premium brands have these features. But now, we're making this technology available to Shopify store owners. This app makes a phenomenal first impression on your customers.

title: Purchase Orders by Helm
description:
Purchase Orders by Helm 
 
 Draft orders as you go, arriving at a single larger order and cutting down on unnecessary handling fees 
 Stay on top of what you've already ordered, avoiding duplication or overstocking 
 Maximise your selling potential by updating Shopify the second your inventory arrives 
 

 Our app provides end to end Purchase order management, right inside your Shopify store admin. 

 Purchase ordering is a crucial task to stay on top of, and it can take a lot of time and energy to get right without a structure. Our app enables you to: 

 
 Easily create and review POs right 
 Submit them to your vendors via csv, pdf or email 
 Reconcile your deliveries when they arrive. 
 Maximise selling windows by automatically updating Shopify's inventory 
 
 How does it work? 
 With our app you can now store cost prices and vendors inside Shopify, and create the purchase orders directly from your store catalogue - avoiding having to duplicate your product information elsewhere or use an alternative solution. Creating purchase orders is as easy as adding the products, associating a vendor, and then either sending directly from our app or downloading a csv to send externally. 

 Once your order's approved you can reflect that in our app, making it easier to forecast inventory levels and expected deliveries over time. When stock arrives you can receive it against the order, and even update the product availability for your store! No more delays between stock arriving and it being available for sale. 
 Why use purchase orders? 
 Purchase orders are a legally binding document between you and your vendors, so they deserve better care than handling purely over notes or email. 
 In summary… 
 Purchase orders are crucial. Every business is already doing them in some shape or form, so do so with structure and discipline to avoid vendor fallouts, stockouts, and poor customer service

title: Bazaar
description:
Creating a rewards program for Ecommerce professionals in the Shopify Network. 
 There is no other application like it in the Ecommerce marketplace. 

 At it's core, The Bazaar Network provides a way for allowing Ecommerce Professionals and online store owners to invite other Ecommerce Professionals and Shop Owners to interact with their site and products through a discount process. 

 Simply put – It is like the traditional bricks and mortar staff discount: Just on a larger and more global scale. 
 Benefits: 
 As the network grows, every user receives discounts at ALL other online stores within the network. Whether it’s a small untapped niche store, or a globally known general store, all users will receive exclusive discounts provided to The Bazaar Network. 

 The Bazaar Network application is designed to create benefits for Ecommerce store owners by bringing other Ecommerce Professional visitors to your store via the high quality sales channel. 

 With only Ecommerce professionals using The Bazaar Network, who are more familiar with the intricacies of marketing and the online shopping process, users see a greater conversion rate than those sites that rely solely on normal shoppers. 

 Best of all … As the network grows, these benefits increase for every Ecommerce Professional and Shopify Store Owner – Meaning more discounts, and more traffic for everyone who is part of the Bazaar Network! 
 Shop with Privilege: 
 Once you have downloaded the App from Shopify App store, and completed the tutorial – you will be listed in the marketplace. 

 You will be prompted to download the partnered Chrome Extension once you are listed, giving you instant notifications offering all discounts available between partner stores in the network. 

 The Bazaar Network icon in your extension bar will light up blue when you visit a Bazaar Partnered store. 
 You have control: 
 The Bazaar Network provides mechanisms that allow you, as an Ecommerce Professional and shop owner, total control over the discounts you invite other Ecommerce Professionals and shop owners to access. These include: 

 
 Set your own discount vouchers to automatically notify your customers when they are browsing. 
 Have the opportunity to offer multiple types of coupons to Ecommerce Professionals and other Shop Owners. 
 Choose the three best products in your store to advertise on your profile. 
 Add tags to your store so that other stores users can search your products. 
 Define specified categories to get better chance of discovery. 
 Ecommerce Professionals and Shop Owners who are in the Bazaar Network can browse all other stores within the Bazaar Network to find exactly the right product. 
 Coupons codes are randomised and automatically changed every 24 hours to protect coupons from leaving the network.

title: Recently Viewed Item Bar
description:
Do your customers stick around? 
 The expensive part is getting them into your store. 

 Once they're there, you want them engaged and able to navigate effortlessly. 

 The Recently Viewed Item Bar keeps customers browsing longer and more likely to buy your products. 

 Big online stores like Amazon use recently viewed items on every page because they know it's important. 

 The Recently Viewed Item Bar offers one-click installation, mobile-friendliness, and customization options to make sure it looks good in your store. 

 No coding required. 
 What's in the app? 
 A configurable product bar that appears at the bottom of the product and other pages showing the customer items they'd previously looked at. This allows your customers to navigate to and from products naturally as they have come to expect from modern ecommerce stores. 
 Why is it important? 
 Customers generally browse around your store and come back to products they'd looked at before. If they can find products quickly and easily, they're much more likely to buy.  
 What makes it even better? Installation's a snap 
 We created an one-click install for this nearly-required feature of any online shop. No technical knowledge required.  No messing with theme files, no code snippets. Just a smart app that does what it should! 
 A light weight design that doesn't get in your way 
 The app is designed to fit in with the theme you have currently installed and not get in the way. In fact, the app is extremely light weight so as to not cause much of the loading that some apps do that end up bogging down your site making it slow for your customers. 
 Configurability allowing you to decide how it works 
 The recent items bar allows you to configure on which pages it shows up and how it appears to the customers so you can make sure it's exactly how you want it. 
 A Custom CSS editor built-in 
 In case you want to customize the bar completely, we give you full control with an easy to use CSS styler for advanced installations.

title: Discount Reminder
description:
Do you plan to organize a Sale and do not want to lose any potential customers visiting your store without making a purchase because of prices not satisfying their holiday shopping expectations? 

 Do your products have flexible prices and you would like to manage them according to your customers' wishes? 

 Would you like to automate a process of notifications for customers in case of prices decreasing for the products they need? 

 ...If so, then Discount Reminder is your right choice! 
 How it works 
 Discount Reminder lets your customers register an email address for an instant email alert if they are interested in purchasing a product, but at this moment the price is not suitable for them. When the price for the product is decreased, customers will receive an automatic notification about this in their email. 

 A small button will be displayed on the product pages of your web store. When clicking on the button a pop-up window will open, where a customer can enter their email, percentage of a desirable discount or exact required price and a period they are ready to wait for the price decrease. 
 Most important features 
 ✔️ The app doesn't require any manual modifications of your store during the installation process!

title: Power Editor
description:
The missing CMS for Shopify 
 This app brings CMS-like features – that users know and love from Content Management Systems like Drupal, Wordpress, CraftCMS – to product, collection and content pages.  

 It increases content management efficiency by providing Shopify admins with an excellent authoring experience. 

 It lets you configure easy-to-use interfaces for content editors to capture additional content in a structured way. This content gets stored entirely within your Shopify store. There is no lock-in. Even when you delete the app, the content will still be available and your storefront will be unaffected. 
 Design complex layouts while providing an excellent authoring experience for your store admins 
 You can compose complex content forms with a wide range of building blocks.
The basic building blocks include an 

 
 image picker 
 date & time picker 
 color picker 
 product picker 
 rich text 
 plain text 
 numbers 
 numeric ranges 
 text position. 
 dropdowns 
 checkboxes 
 

 The star among those fields is the "Composite Field". Composite fields are super fields made up of other fields that can be stacked, edit and rearranged  (drag and drop) at will. You can use them to create page sections that feature a variable amount of entries of a predefined structure. For example, testimonials, accordion elements or image galleries. 

 
 Flexibility for developers: The app is highly configurable. It is geared towards theme designer/coders who want to use more complex content structures. 
 Familiarity for content editors: The content editing experience should be a no-brainer. It is embedded within the familiar Shopify admin. Common content structures (like tabs, accordions, carousels, galleries etc.) can be configured and personalized to exactly fit the store's content needs and terminology. 
 

 ⚠ NOTICE ⚠ 

 The app is geared towards technically experienced folk.
It has to be configured and integrated into existing theme code by an experienced Shopify developer. There is coding involved to make it all work!

title: Shopper Age Check
description:
If you are selling e-cig, vape, tobacco related products, you are required by FDA to verify customer’s age. Shopper Age Check automates this process by integrating age verification into your checkout process, and verify customer’s age in a few seconds.  

 How it works? 

 
 When your online shoppers are about to checkout at cart page. We will prompt the customer to provide first last name, date of brith, address. This information will be sent to our age verification data partner. A result will be returned within 3 seconds.  
 Over 95% of the US shoppers will be verified by the combination of these information. If the shopper’s age is verified as meet the age requirement, those information will be pre-filled as shipping information at the checkout page. 
 If the first last name, date of birth, address combination is failed to verify shopper’s age. The app will ask the shopper to upload a government issued ID.  
 ID picture can be taken either by webcam of a computer or the built-in camera of a smart phone. 
 Once the ID is uploaded, the app will automatically analyze the content of the document to verify customer’s age. 
 

 This app is different from an age verification popup which is completely relying on shopper’s honesty without actual verification. This app is verifying shopper information against 3rd party age verification database or analyzing photo of Identity document to meet the legal requirement set by the FDA.

title: Dealio
description:
You have not seen an upsell app like Dealio 
 Dealio has totally changed the up sell tactic. We took the buyer psychology and turned it against the buyers. The greatest feat we could ever do, was taking more money from a customer and making him feel better about it.  

 The whole point is in the perception of the up sell offer, which is now: "Yes, I WON a special deal/offer", instead of: "Ohh, they only want more money from me". The whole experience happens on the actual product page and what is really important is that it's done in a subtle, non disturbing way.  
 We had to overcome quite a few things 
 We had to make the app as easy and intuitive as possible. So when a user sees it, they know what to do and how to do it. One could imagine that scratching a card is a simple task, but it does not come natural on a mobile or desktop device, so we had to think outside the box.  
 What kind of discounts can you create with Dealio?

title: Woo Importer
description:
Thousands of Shopify users have used Woo Importer to migrate over a million products to Shopify, now it's your turn! 
 Our Woo Importer app saves you time by quickly importing products and orders from WooCommerce into your Shopify store. This is a great way to test out a new platform or to migrate an existing store. 
 You can use Woo Importer to do the following: 
 
 Migrate products to Shopify 
 Transfer your customers and orders to Shopify 
 Import product reviews to Shopify 
 Generate account activation links for your customers 
 Create URL redirects to fix broken links when you switch to Shopify 
 

 Just enter the API information for your WooCommerce store and we'll take care of the rest! 
 What information is transferred from WooCommerce? 
 Woo Importer is able to migrate all data from your products, variants, images, orders, and customers that is accessible through the WooCommerce API. You can visit our support site to see a complete list of supported fields. 

 If you have any additional data that you need to transfer, contact us and we can help out with a custom import. 
 Requirements 
 To run for the import, you will need an API key from your WooCommerce site. You can generate an API key by following the instructions in the WooCommerce Documentation at: 

 https://docs.woocommerce.com/document/woocommerce-rest-api/#section-3 
 Documentation 
 For more information on importing products check out our support pages by clicking on the link to the right. We also recommend reviewing our Frequently Asked Questions which cover some common issues in migrating. 
 Product Support 
 All product support is handled by our US-based team. We reply to all inquiries within one business day (but usually faster!) 
 URL Redirects 
 Since WooCommerce and Shopify have different URL structures you may have a lot of broken links when you first switch to Shopify (for example, your Google search results will still be pointing to old URLs). 

 We've developed an integration with our Link Manager app that will automatically create redirects so you don't loose these visitors. This is free for Woo Importer users. Please visit our help site to read more about how to set up the redirects. 
 Customer Accounts 
 If you would like your existing customers to be able to log in to your Shopify store you will need to email them activation links so they can reset the passwords for their accounts. The Woo Importer app can generate a CSV file for you of your customers and their activation links. You can use this CSV file to do a mail-merge and email the links to your customers. 

 You can learn more about generating Shopify activation links for your WooCommerce customers on our help site.

      shopify reviews,
     
     
      link manager

What is the Sold Stock App ? 
 This Sold Stock app is for your Shopify store, which help you to display sold and available stock on a particular product page. 
 Why should your store have this app ? 
 This app helps you to increase sale & revenue, by creating scarcity & urgency to customer. Customer visits your product page and they found limited stock or stock running out, they will most likely purchase the product before going it stock-out. 

 Also it help to aware customer about product demand & to choice right product. 
 How it will look on Shopify product page ? 
 i.e. : 12 in stock / 20 sold 

 Though you can customize the display text using application admin.

title: SEO JSON‑LD Boost by Verge
description:
We have provided this tool free of charge to increase the searchability of your products across the web and hope that through our contribution you are able to grow and expand your business. 

 In comparison to other products out there, we do not modify your template. This means that if you remove this application, we will remove any traces of it. Equally, you won't need to re-install this application every time you update your template. 
 What is JSON-LD? 
 JSON-LD is a lightweight 'Linked Data' format. It is a way encode your website data to be easier to understand for all of the other machines on the Internet - including search engines like Google! 
 Why is JSON-LD important for my shop? 
 Google looks for JSON-LD, and rewards websites and webshops that serve JSON-LD data. Many of Google’s search results page features (including rich snippets and Knowledge Graph cards) are enabled by JSON-LD mark-up. Their 'Shopping' search results tab is also powered by JSON-LD. Making sure that your site serves this type of data can be very helpful in your search engine rankings! 
 What content types does your app support? 
 Currently we support specialized JSON-LD data on the following pages: 

 
 Landing page 
 Product pages including variants 
 Collection pages 
 Content pages 
 Blog overviews 
 Blog content page 
 
 Why does my product show up multiple times in the Google Structured Data testing tool? 
 Many templates include metadata as part of their tag structure. For example you may see something like this: itemtype="http://schema.org/Product" in your HTML. The tool will pick up this data as well as the JSON-LD data that we inject into your shop. 
 Why are you doing this for free? 
 As we are already using this application in all our stores as part of a larger, comprehensive SEO package for Shopify, it was not difficult to split it out and make it available for free to all Shopify users. If you are interested in being notified upon the release of our more comprehensive SEO app for Shopify, please contact us through our support email. 
 How is your application different to other JSON-LD applications? 
 We inject JSON-LD data into your shop using Javascript. Other solutions we have seen modify your template directly. While this is also a solution Shopify prefers our approach according to the documentation. 
 Is this one of those crummy free apps that never live up to what they promise? 
 We hope not! If you are having problems with your set-up or ideas for improvement, please contact us through our support email.

      Shopify reviews,
