title: The Bundled APP By Appiness
description:
What is The Bundle APP? 
 Bundle application is designed to make the combination or set of products selling process smoother. It links a group of products with a distinct product or variant easily. The best thing about the application is that it makes the inventory maintenance process very convenient. In fact, things made of diverse components can also be sold using this application as you would be able to trace the inventory easily. 
 How does it function? 
 Bundle verifies and harmonizes the products/variants in a bundle after every sale. It brings back all the products & variants back in synchronization in a jiffy after sales. You do not have to create new products or variants using this app, you can just link one product to various products. The process of adding the bundles is also pretty simple.  

 A bundle product in the application will be made by selecting the bundle products and their variants and choosing the related products/variants. Interestingly, a store owner can select multiple variants of related products as well.   

 Bundle application is used to manage the quantity of products. For instance, if a customer buys Bundle Product, the application will verify the minimum quantity of all the product variants that are available in that bundle product. Then, it will update the minimum quantity of those bundle products/variants in Shopify store. 

 A Store Owner would also be able to check the log of products ordered. In the Inventory Log, a store owner can check the updated quantity & old quantity of products/variants. 
 Does it require any alteration in templates or liquid files? 
 No, it's very simple. Bundle application manages everything automatically. You would just have to select the products/variants that are required to be added as Bundle along with other content, in the Shopify store. 
 Does it treat products & variants equally? 
 For Bundle application both products and variants are equal. You can easily make a bundle which contains both variants and products. This also implies that it also functions in the similar way when you let your customer select colors or sizes on the product page. All diverse sizes and colors will show individually when you make a new bundle.

description:
Entrepreneurs and business owners agree that having control over your product is critical to successfully growing your business. The Lulu xPress App connects our print and fulfillment network to your Shopify storefront for a more efficient way to sell your books. Now every time an order is placed for your books, we’ll print and ship the order, and provide you and your customer tracking to ensure everyone is happy. It’s that simple! 
 Why Lulu? 
 
   Lulu pioneered on-demand book printing. After printing over 5.3 billion (yes, billion with a B) pages across our global network, we perfected the art of printing high quality, on-demand books, the same as any you’d see on the shelves at your local bookstore or big box 
   Lulu offers a variety of binding, size, color and cover options, including common and many uncommon book designs, as well as offering customizable products 
   Print prices low enough that you can sell your book for the same or less than a bookstore list price and still realize a substantial profit 
   No set-up charges or handling fees 
   Global dropshipping direct to your buyer with trackable shipping methods

 The Lulu xPress App integrates our printing and fulfillment network with your Shopify store. When an order for a book is placed in your store, it automatically sends a request to our network. We print and ship the order directly to your customer. Integration and setup is easy. 
 Book Formats

 You can import dropshipped products from Wish, AliExpress or Weeberly Marketplace. When you find a product you would like to import you could copy the link and paste on the Weeberly importer. title: Returns Management System
description:
The Returns Management System App integrates with Shopify and provides for a seamless experience for managing returns. We make it easy for your customers to file a return and we make it easier for you handle returns requests.  

 This app is bundled with tons of features. Some notable features are: 
 1. Easy for Customers 
 Simply embed a Request Creation form on your store and allow your customers to create returns without logging in. 
 2. Easier for Owner 
 As a Merchant you can quickly create a Return Request from the Admin Panel. It lets you record everything like Item Status, Quantity , Return Reasons etc.  
 3. Send Prepaid Return Shipping Label to Customer 
 Admin can quickly generate and send Prepaid Return Shipping label to customers directly from the App.  
 4. Automate Return Shipping Labels 
 The App will allow customers to generate and print pre-paid shipping labels without any intervention from support personnel. This will save a lot for time for Shop Owners. Simply activate it from the settings panel and customer will have the ability to create prepaid returns label on their own.   
 5. Allows your customers to return Multiple Products in a Single Request 
 Allow  customers to return multiple products in a single return request.  
 6. Highly Informative and Graphical Reports 
 Reports include Most Returned Products, Return Percentages etc. These Reports provide actionable insights to reduce costs and improve profitability.  

 
 Attach images to the return request
Customers can optionally upload images of items (defected parts) while creating a return request.  
 
 8. Custom Return Reasons 
 Set Up Custom Return Reasons like "Wrong Size", "Damaged", "Wrong Color" etc. You can create as many custom reasons to suit your workflow.  
 9. Custom Item Status 
 You can set Custom Status for every Item included in the Return Request.  
 10. Return time window 
 This features allows you to define a time window (in days) for creating a return. So if a customer tries to create a return after the time window has passed, the system will display a customizable “Return Window Expired” message 
 11. Exclude Products from Return 
 Simply select a product category and customers wont be able to include it in the return request 
 12. Disable International Returns 
 It is now possible to prevent international customers from filing a return request. 
 13. Override Return Rules 
 As Admin you can override the rules and manually create a return request.  
 14. Setup Terms & Conditions 
 Quickly add a Terms and Conditions Check-box on the Request Creation form.

description:
The Future Has Arrived - Boost Sales with Notifications on a Map 
 New visitors can be very suspicious of your store. 

 
 Are they going to get scammed? 
 Is it the real deal? 
 Does anyone else order from here? 
 

 Awesome Social Proof Map helps you with that - it boosts sales by showing real orders placed by real customers from real cities. On a gorgeous, animated map. 
 What is social proof and why do I need it? 
 Social proof (also known as an informational social influence) is a psychological and social phenomenon where people assume the actions of others in an attempt to reflect correct behavior in a given situation.
 
Social proof is considered prominent in ambiguous social situations where people are unable to determine the appropriate mode of behavior and is driven by the assumption that the surrounding people possess more knowledge about the current situation. 
 Why do you need Awesome Social Proof Map? 
 Our app automatically updates orders in real time. Set it up once and forget it - the app will work instead of you, for you.

description:
Take Your Shopify Store to The Next Level 
 The fastest way to increase Site Speed & Search Engine Ranking and consequently - conversions. Loved and utilized by merchants worldwide and leading Shopify agencies go-to optimization tool. 
 Make your shop faster 
 Properly optimized images can save many bytes of data. With Crush.pics, your web shop will load faster. Check your page speed with Google's Page Speed Tool. 
 Improve your Search Engine Ranking 
 Faster loading speed will improve your search engine ranking. Google has been using site loading speed for SEO ranking since 2010. See examples of different PageSpeed scores on our Demo Page. 
 Tidy your Image SEO 
 Your SEO will improve further if your image file names and alt tags are more descriptive. Automatically rename all image File Names and Alt tags. Use your product data to go from a generic image file name to one consisting of your product name, variants and brand name. 
 Grow your Conversion rate 
 High page load time affects customer retention. Crush those worries and concentrate on your product. 

 # Same quality, smaller image files
Choose between Lossless or Lossy compression.
* With LOSSLESS compression, your images will be as crisp as the original
* For biggest savings, choose LOSSY compression. There will be small, barely visible loss in image sharpness, but your compression will be much higher. You can compare your original image to the compressed one and restore originals if you change your mind. 
 Restore Batch process 
 Crush.pics will store all your original images for 30 days, and you can revert to your original images during that time. You can do this for any image manually, or do a Batch Restore and revert all your compressed images to their original version. 
 Set and Forget 
 When you install Crush.pics, it will go through all your images and optimize them. Whenever you add a new product or asset image, Crush.pics will automatically optimize it with no work from you.
1. Install Crush.pics and choose compression type: Lossless or Lossy
2. Choose compression mode: Automatic or Manual (If you choose Automatic, Crush.pics will start compressing your images automatically. If you choose Manually, you can do this yourself, one by one.)
3. If you go over 25 MB/month, choose a Crush.pics plan that suits your needs
4. Newly added images are compressed automatically & Crush.pics Reports will update you on how your site is performing. 

 If you ever get stuck, you can search our Help Centre articles or contact us. We are known for great support.

 Constant Cart is a persistent cart application that saves your customers cart in the background so when they log in later on another device they will find their cart waiting for them.

description:
Make your shop fit for the Euro Zone! 
 Exemptify helps you to increase sales by making your shop compliant with EU VAT regulations and allowing you to conduct proper EU B2B transactions by validating EU VAT IDs. 
 How does it work? 
 EU companies are allowed to sell products to other EU companies without charging them VAT. This regulation is called reverse-charge mechanism. In order to be able to issue VAT-exempt invoices, customer and merchant need to have valid EU VAT Ids. It is the merchant's responsibility to validate their customers' VAT Ids in order to benefit from this regulation.
Exemptify completely automates this process by checking the validity of the customers' VAT Ids using the official EU (VIES) database. The Id is then stored in your customer database and VAT is automatically deducted from future orders of the customer. For reporting purposes the Id is added as a note to each order.
Exemptify also helps you to make your shop compliant with EU law by including the VAT in the price displayed to your customers while still allowing you to sell VAT-free to non-EU customers.
Price text and validation error messages are fully customizable and localizable.
Exemptify now also allows you to show prices excluding VAT for non-EU customers and including VAT for EU customers.

 Enter your own VAT Id

description:
Upsell product coverage (extended warranties) from top insurers to increase average order size & boost sales and margin. 
 When you offer warranties through Clyde, your business makes a margin on the sale of every extended warranty sold. With our autopilot margin feature, we combine analytics across all stores using Clyde to adjust contract pricing to drive the most additional revenue for your business. 
 Sell Online, B2B, and in-store – all with one app. 
 Clyde automatically connects to your store and manages all contracts and contract sales made through your website. You can use Clyde’s web app (or the Shopify admin portal) for B2B and in-store sales. 
 What kind of protection will you offer? 
 We work with numerous insurers to offer product coverage plans across a wide variety of products. We can cover electronics, appliances, jewelry, furniture, sports equipment, outdoor equipment,and general merchandise – we almost always cover for accidents as well. We make sure to match each of them with the extended warranty that will give the best value to your customer. Our contracts can even be customized to fit your business specifically. Reach out to our team to learn more! 
 How does Clyde work? 
 Connect: Install Clyde's app. 

 Customize: Upload your logo, choose your color, and pick locations on your site. 

 Launch: Clyde matches extended warranty contracts to your products and launches them directly to your live store.  

 Sell: When your customer purchases a coverage plan they'll receive an email from Clyde with info about their contract and what to do when something goes wrong. 
 Everything you need to run a warranty program 
 With our autopilot feature, Clyde drives sales without needing any extra work on your end. Turn our autopilot features on so you can focus on your business while we handle your product coverage program.

title: Recommendify
description:
Are you going crazy trying to increase your sales? 
 So you've set up your store. You're making a few sales, but people are only buying one or two items. Yeah, it feels great to get those order notifications, but what really matters is the "Today's Sales" figure. 

 Or maybe potential customers arrive at your store and leave without finding what they need. The worst bit is, you know they're not coming back.   

 And what if you want to cross-promote products, or push a particular item, either because you're overstocked or because that's where you make your margins? Where do you even start? 

 There are so many apps out there that promise to help, but how do you know if they really add to the bottom line? 
 It's enough to drive you up the wall, but it doesn't have to. 
 What if you could increase your sales effortlessly with the traffic you already have? 

 Instead of letting your customers browse aimlessly, you could show them accurate suggestions, as if you were reading their minds. 

 You could skyrocket average order values by cross-promoting perfect product combinations, automatically. 

 What if you could push a single product across your entire store with a couple of clicks? Bye bye, dead stock! 

 And wouldn't you like to know, down to the cent, how much your sales app is adding to your bottom line? 
 With Recommendify, you can do all that and more. 
 Recommendify is a recommender system for Shopify stores, like the ones used by the most successful online retailers. 

 Here’s what Recommendify can do for you: 

 
 Related Products: 
 

 Recommendify analyzes your products to figure out which ones go together, then suggests them to customers so they can zero in on exactly what they want. 

 
 Cart Recommendations: 
 

 Recommendify mines your order history for purchasing patterns and finds products that are frequently bought together, then suggests upsells to your customers on the cart page before they check out. 

 
 Hand-Picked Recommendations: 
 

 Recommendify's algorithms are great, but sometimes you want to take control of things yourself. With custom recommendations, you can manually select the products that are suggested. 

 
 Click and Conversion Tracking: 
 

 Recommendify tracks clicks and conversions over time and calculates the total conversion value so you always know how much money the app is making you. The dashboard area also contains clear documentation to get you up and running quickly. 
 Just do the math: how much is a ten percent increase in monthly revenue worth to you? 
 And with a 14-day free trial, you can figure out if it works for your store without risking a cent. 

 So what are you waiting for? Click "Get" and watch your sales go through the roof.

title: Audience Push to Facebook
description:
Put Your Facebook Audiences on Auto-Pilot! What does it do? 
 This app is designed to make your life just a whole lot easier by taking some work off your plate each day by doing something that you should always be doing anyway; Updating your Facebook custom audiences, all the time! 
 How does it do it? 
 Every time there is a phone number or email entered into the checkout, a sale or a customer registration, the contact details are instantly pushed to (and/or pulled out of) a Custom Audience in Facebook 
 But don't Facebook Pixels do this? 
 NO, only part of it. If someone is private browsing, not logged into Facebook, or the biggest issue is the 1 in 5 people that use Ad blockers - then you lose them. This guarantees a perfect match with email and phone numbers. 

 Across our customer base we see more people added to an audience using Audience Push compared to using a pixel. You are literally losing money not using Audience Push. 

 This is literally the only app that does this. Its crazy, but true! 

 You setup rules to handle new actions - for example, if a customer purchases from your store, you can add them to a custom audience called Buyers and remove them from one called Abandoned Cart. 
 What about Cross-Browser-Targeting? 
 So this is a neat way of doing this - Pixels may only track a mobile user or a desktop user, or an app user. Audience Push actually does the full and complete cross-browser targeting. 
 Setting it up is super Eaaaaasy! 
 STEP 1: After you install the app you'll click one button to connect to your Facebook account and away you go. 

 STEP 2: Next you select which ad account(s) you want to work with 

 STEP 3: You add Pushes of your audience to the Custom Audiences that you choose in your add accounts. 

 You can setup an unlimited amount of push rules to different advertising accounts you manage in Facebook 

 Still not easy enough? OK! We will configure it for you! install the app and then follow these steps and we will configure it for you FOR FREE! 

 That's it, you're done! 

 You NEVER need to touch the app again, it will run in the background instantly and forever!! Now go focus on your business and let this app take care of your custom audiences!

Quantity Breaks has been by far our #1 MOST POPULAR REQUESTED APP! It will forever change the way you manage the pricing in your Shopify store!

 How tiered pricing it works 
 This app will allow you to create different price tiers for products based on the quantity a customer buys. You can set it so they have to buy a certain quantity of one specific product or ANY of its variants.  

 It's your standard bulk pricing, quantity breaks or tiered pricing sale :-).  

 
 Buy 5 or more of product X, get 10% off 
 Buy 10 or more of product X, get 15% off

title: Store Images Management by WAL
description:
Store images Management. 
 With our app you can deal with your images online or offline. At present, you can export and download product images directly on spreadsheets by using our app. 
 Why? 
 Let me explain what this app can do for you. Let us say you need to send product information along with product images to your vendors or to your sales people. For that you may want to prepare it on a spreadsheet (like excel, Numbers on Mac etc.) with proper information. But to send product images you might be sending them separately by attaching zip folders, etc. or through some other image sharing tools. At this point our app will help you in a better way. With the help of our app you will be able to simply download your Shopify store’s product images directly on a spreadsheet. The steps are very simple as given below.
* Install our app & activate monthly charge.
* Synchronize all urls of images of your products to our app.
* Click on export buttons to export your product or variant images. 

 You can export images in batches of 25, 50, 100, 500 or 1000. 

 Also, you can upload your own CSV containing handles to export images to spreadsheets. 

 We created this app because we know that when trying to export a spreadsheet (CSV) of products from the Shopify admin you will only get product image urls. You will not get the exact images on spreadsheets. That's a problem if your staff members need a product or variant images directly to a spreadsheet. With the help of this app you will be able to export those images directly on spreadsheets that you normally can't get from Shopify both effectively and quickly. It's also very simple and easy to use. They are clearly listed for you as soon as you install the app and there is no coding knowledge required. Just as simple as opening the app or downloading the excel file with your images. 
 Feature Requests 
 We are improving our app functionality continuously. I am open to your suggestions. Feel free to email me.

description:
The simplest way to send account invites, automatically. 
 We have taken the hassle out of remembering to send account invites to your customers who might have checked out as guests on your store. Now, you can install our app, and let us handle sending the invites for you!

 Migrating to Shopify with your existing customers? 
 If you are about to migrate to Shopify from another platform, our app can send account invites to your customers for you once they are imported to Shopify. Use our Bulk Invite tool to send all your migrated customers an account invite quickly and easily. 
 Reporting 
 We provide you stats on how many emails invites have been sent for your store, as well as a view of the last 10 customer invites we sent on your behalf. Super simple and easy to understand. 
 Plan Features Basic Plan 
 
 Send automatic invites to new online and POS customers 
 Set timing delay of invites to minimum of 1 day 
 Great for new or growing stores, and stores that don't need to send invites immediately 
 
 Advanced Plan 
 
 Bulk Invite tool - send invites to all previous customers at one time 
 Site link tool - place a link on your site that customers can use to send themselves an invite 
 Open Tracker -  track how many of your account invites are opened by customers 
 Domain Blocks - block email domains you don't want invites sent to. Useful if your store integrates with a third-party marketplace like eBay or Amazon that have rules preventing any emails going to their customers.

description:
ShipRobot is an intuitive web-based shipping solution for online merchants. ShipRobot is tightly integrated with Shopify. ShipRobot supports multiple sales channels and shipping carriers. 

 We've removed the hassle of going to several web sites to create shipping labels and manage order statuses by including all those features into one simple solution. Now you can sync orders from your Shopify store in real-time and print a shipping label for an order with only a few clicks. After a label is created we automatically update the shipping status to fulfilled within your Shopify store Admin. Tracking number emails are then triggered and sent to you and your customer. 

 Features: 

 
 Import orders in real-time, print USPS, Canada Post, UPS, FedEx, and Swiss Post labels. No more copy and pasting shipping addresses. 
 Try our REST API to extend functionality. 
 Print address labels without postage. 
 Bulk label creation. Generate up to 250 shipping labels at once. 
 Real-time syncing of unfulfilled and partially fulfilled orders from multiple sales channels you use like Shopify. 
 Create and print shipping labels for all your orders with one solution. 
 Update order statuses automatically once orders are fulfilled. 
 Automatically send tracking number emails to customers. 
 Support for partial order fulfillment, pick the item to be shipped. 
 Option to manually add/create orders. 
 Option to manually add tracking number and update order status. 
 Option to import orders using .csv file. 
 Automatically retains order, customer, shipment data and export to .csv file. 
 Print customized packing slips. 
 Print pick lists.

 Search/filter for any order or shipment easily. 
 Add unlimited "ship from" addresses. 
 View postage rate for a label before you create one.

 Receive commercial plus pricing postage rates and a free account from Express1. 
 Keep track of shipments you've made with one solution. 
 Reprint labels and track shipments easily. 
 Reopen orders that have already shipped in case you need to send more items. 
 Add unlimited package size presets so you don't have to enter package dimensions manually. Other types of presets are also available. 
 Add unlimited sales channels and stores. 
 Cloud-based software, use it anywhere with a web browser and an internet connection.

description:
Drive More Sales with a Same-Day Shipping Countdown Timer 
 Give customers another reason to buy with this simple to use, professional-looking shipping countdown timer. 

 Creating urgency is a powerful persuasion technique to convert visitors into purchasers faster. Countdown timers are an unmistakable visual signal that notifies customers if they want a product, they must take action. 

 For a countdown timer to work without looking spammy, it needs to refer to a genuine cut-off time and convey genuine and useful information to the customer. A shipping cut-off timer does just that. Knowing that they have an hour left to place a purchase to get the fastest possible shipping is a powerful motivator. 

 ShipTimer lets you display a countdown timer for your same-day shipping cut-off time. This creates genuine urgency, helping convert more visitors into customers. 
 Automatic & Fully Configurable 
 After an automatic install, ShipTimer displays a countdown timer on your product pages notifying customers of their expected shipping date and encouraging them to order quickly so they can order before the cut time. 

 Set your shipping cut-off times on a per day basis, add your shipping holidays with our easy to use interface, and you're set. 

 The only requirement to use it in your store starting today is knowing your shipping cut-off time. Whether you fulfill your orders yourself or use a 3PL, so long as you know the deadline for orders to go out the door the same day, you can use ShipTimer to give your customers another reason to buy with this simple to use, professional-looking shipping countdown timer.

title: DHL
description:
INTRODUCTION 
 With the official DHL plugin you profit from a quick and simplified shipment process enabling you to easily create DHL labels and send tracking IDs to your customers. It covers domestic and international services from DHL Paket and DHL eCommerce to perfectly suit your needs. Manage your shipments through one single shipping provider by using DHL. 
 FEATURES 
 
   Print labels for DHL Paket or DHL eCommerce: Fast and easy label creation of domestic and international orders 
   Create auto tracking codes: Automatically receive a tracking code for each label (if tracking is available for selected product) 
   Create handover notes conveniently for a smooth and reliable manifesting process in-line with your specific regional requirements for DHL eCommerce 
   Use additional delivery services, e.g. visual check of age via API by DHL Paket or cash on delivery by DHL eCommerce in selected countries 
   Offer preferred delivery options via DHL Paket`s “Wunschzustellung” enabling your customers to select preferred time and location of delivery. If the customer enters his home address and a preferred location or neighbor, the parcel can be delivered in his absence 
   Customize names and rates: Enable/disable or edit the names of services and set up the handling costs for each DHL shipping service 
   Delete labels or reprint labels in case your printer experienced any issues 
   Experience premium support, timely compatibility updates and bug fixes 
 
 AVAILABILITY OF DHL SERVICES BY SENDER COUNTRY 
 DHL shipping products range from small light weight packets with milestone tracking to delivery duty paid parcels with end-to-end tracking and a range of delivery times from same day to 14 day delivery - depending on your sender country and shipment destinations. To find the shipping services that best suits your needs, please see available DHL services in the overview in the screenshot section. 

 DHL eCommerce services are available in the following countries: Australia, Canada, Chile, China, Hong Kong, India, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, US, Vietnam 

 Please note: Based on your sender country and shipping preference, different access credentials for DHL Paket and DHL eCommerce are required for configuration.  
 PREREQUISITES & DOWNLOAD

 Let you customers calculate how much of your product they need.

 Increase sales conversions

In this sense, a single interactive calculator may be more compelling and valuable than detailed product descriptions and customer testimonials.

description:
Looking for customers to add more products to their cart? 
 Start Cross-Selling today! 

 The Cart Related Products plugin is great to show your customers which products would go great with products that they have added to their shopping cart by displaying a pop-up showing the related products! 

 For example, if the user added a cell phone to the shopping cart, you might want to pop-up a window showing the best phone cover and charging cable suitable for that phone model. To do this, all you need to do is configure the source product (the one added to the cart), and any related products (that will show in the pop-up window)! 

 The Cart Related Products plugin has another great feature that will allow your customer to see any configured related products whenever they are navigating to a particular product page. 
 How does it work? 
 
 Install the app with one click! (no coding required) 
 Configure related products for your chosen products (this can also be done in batches) 
 That's it!  When you customers now add any of the configured products to their cart, they will see a popup window showing the related products, which they will hopefully buy too!

The weather has a great impact on how we feel and on the decisions we make. We want to help store owners understand what type of weather motivates their customers to order their products. 
 How does it work? 
 The Sales vs. Weather app will check what was the weather during the time and place of every sale in the last 12 months (starting from the moment of the installation) and analyze it.  

 You will receive 25+ types of reports - we'll check the number of sales, the average number of products, the combined order value and analyze how it compares with the temperature (in Celsius or Fahrenheit depending on the location of the store), the amount of rain, the amount of clouds, time of day and season. You can find the full list of reports below. 
 What about my data? 
 We promise to keep it safe! We do not share any of your information with any 3rd party without your consent or use it in any other way outside from the weather report.  

 You can delete all of the data just by uninstalling the app. If you decide to keep the app we will deliver more reports on the data you have already provided - all of the extra reports will be free of charge. 
 Can I export my report?

title: Handle SEO
description:
With an ever growing number of online stores, what's the best way to get noticed? SEO is the answer. 

 Products listed on Shopify stores depend upon a few important and often ignored product attributes including the product title and URL handle. The URL handle itself needs special attention as it is what the users see on their browser's address bar and can be misleading to users as well as search engines, if wrong. Also, a wrong URL handle can get embarrassing if it bears no resemblance to the product. 

 A frequent cause of products ending up with wrong handles is due to creation of products as a copy of another product. For example, if you first create a product called Red Hat, Shopify will assign the handle red-hat to the product which is added to the end of the product URL. Now, if you copy this product to another one, and change the title to Blue Hat after the product is created, Shopify will keep the handle as copy-of-red-hat which corresponds to the original title. 

 Or it may happen that sometime after creating Red Hat, you come back and change the title to Super Red Hat. Since product title updates do not automatically trigger handle update, you may end up with a title-handle mismatch. 

 This is where the Handle SEO app can help by handling your product handle updates. It can analyze your products and identify title-handle mismatches which can be fixed with the click of a button. You have the option of also creating product URL redirects in case any of your customers had bookmarked the original product URLs. 

 If your store has a large number of products, we recommend using the new background modes which can Analyze and / or Fix the product handles in the background and send you an email with the results. 

 Please note that the app works only for English language titles and handles. 

 Hope you like the app. Please feel free to send us your feature / app suggestions.

title: Image Sitemap
description:
How much money are you losing on image search? 
 Many Shopify stores are missing large parts of their catalog imagery in Google Images — often more than 60%. 

 Image Sitemap is the first Shopify App that automatically builds, submits, verifies, monitors and updates a fully compliant .xml Google Image Sitemap for all images associated with each product, blog article and page in your Shopify store — all in real-time. 

 Image Sitemap is also the first app to provide full reporting for your indexed images. 

 
 1-Click Install — No Coding Required 
 Submit 100% of Your Product and Blog Images For Indexing 
 100% Automated 
 Sitemap Updated & Re-Submitted In Real-Time* 
 Real-Time Monitoring of Google Index Performance 
 

 *If you update any product content or attributes in your catalog (like images, image ALT tags, product descriptions, variants, colors, sizes, SKUs, etc), we rebuild and resubmit your Image Sitemap to Google immediately in real-time. We declare EVERY image, regardless of how many variants you have per product. So if you have 500 products, with 20 images per product. We submit 10,000 images to Google for you. 
 Important Concepts What is an image sitemap? 
 An image sitemap is similar in format to a normal sitemap.xml, except that it specifies images only. Most people don't know that search engines need an additional sitemap to help find images. The internet is just too big to find everything all the time. 
 Do I need one? 
 Yes. While Shopify provides an abbreviated image sitemap with only a single image per product, you need a much more comprehensive document. Our image sitemap includes ALL of your important images and is packed with additional metadata. For example, where Shopify might generate 1,000 lines of XML for you, our image sitemap will be something like 10,000 lines. 
 Metadata 
 We load your image captions with all available product variant metadata, like sku, weight, color, size, description, etc. It is essential to provide this contextual information to Google to enable more powerful and relevant searches. 
 Reporting 
 Image Sitemap is the first Shopify App to provide full reporting for your indexed images. We also identify potential 'Blackout' products — or products that seem to have no indexed images at all. 
 How big is an image sitemap? 
 Image sitemap files can be huge. To give an example, if your site has 3,000 product images, your .xml image sitemap could be more than 20,000 lines of code and more than 2.5MB in file size. Can you imagine editing that file manually, multiple times per day, and re-submitting it to Google by hand? You don't have to imagine. We gladly handle all of the complexity for you.

*If you update any product content or attributes in your catalog (like images, image ALT tags, product descriptions, variants, colors, sizes, SKUs, etc), we rebuild and resubmit your Image Sitemap to Google immediately in real-time. We declare EVERY image, regardless of how many variants you have per product. So if you have 500 products, with 20 images per product. We submit 10,000 images to Google for you.

Important Concepts

What is an image sitemap?

An image sitemap is similar in format to a normal sitemap.xml, except that it specifies images only. Most people don't know that search engines need an additional sitemap to help find images. The internet is just too big to find everything all the time.

Do I need one?

Yes. While Shopify provides an abbreviated image sitemap with only a single image per product, you need a much more comprehensive document. Our image sitemap includes ALL of your important images and is packed with additional metadata. For example, where Shopify might generate 1,000 lines of XML for you, our image sitemap will be something like 10,000 lines.

Metadata

We load your image captions with all available product variant metadata, like sku, weight, color, size, description, etc. It is essential to provide this contextual information to Google to enable more powerful and relevant searches.

Reporting

Image Sitemap is the first Shopify App to provide full reporting for your indexed images. We also identify potential 'Blackout' products — or products that seem to have no indexed images at all.

How big is an image sitemap?

Image sitemap files can be huge. To give an example, if your site has 3,000 product images, your .xml image sitemap could be more than 20,000 lines of code and more than 2.5MB in file size. Can you imagine editing that file manually, multiple times per day, and re-submitting it to Google by hand? You don't have to imagine. We gladly handle all of the complexity for you.

title: Customer Fields
description:
When running an online store, you need to understand your customers to grow your business. And since no two customers are the same, you need to learn about each unique feature, preference, or interest that’s helps you sell better. 

 Customer Fields enables you to solve these problems by creating a custom registration form for shoppers to sign up with a unique profile in your store. Finally, make sense of this data by filtering and integrating with other tools as a CRM. 
 Custom Form Fields 
 Register customers with unique fields that you set up in the app. You can choose a wide variety of fields types with our form builder or even work with us or your developer to build your own custom form as a questionnaire. When a customer registers on your storefront, their information is collected and stored within the app, which is accessible to review or export to another location. Example fields: 

 
 Address 
 Age 
 Birthday 
 Company 
 Identification document 
 Gender 
 Phone number 
 Product preferences 
 Personal preferences 
 Uploaded file (e.g. photo, document, design, or PDF) 
 Wholesale / retail 
 
 Tag Customers Automatically 
 Set up rules that will autotag the customer depending on a field selection. Once a customer is tagged, you can create unique segments in your Shopify admin to group customers by unique tags.  
 Advanced Customer Filtering 
 Easily filter and search through customers to find exactly who you’re after. For example, find registered teachers by searching email addresses ending in a “.edu” domain or find the list of customers that have birthdays this month. 
 Import & Export 
 If you have a customer database from another source, use our import feature to add customers with additional fields directly into Shopify. You can also export customers from the app and import them into other applications and services. Importing and exporting tools support the comma-separated value (CSV) file type. 
 Liquid Integration 
 Any custom field value is saved as a metafield for that customer, which means you can augment the shopping experience based on a certain field right in Liquid or display that value to the customer within the account panel. Discover new ways of product discovery by curating products based on the data unique to each customer. 
 Event Notifications 
 Stay in the loop by getting a email notifications when a customer registers on your store or edits their account. Use this to manage and review account signups for approval processes. 
 Editable Account 
 Customers can edit their own information directly within the account panel of your store, which cuts out on the support requests you have to manage for a simple email or name change. Additionally, you can easily edit customer accounts directly within the app. 

 - 

 Note: Customer Fields used to be call "Customr" in its early days.

 DeliveryTimer allows you to display information surrounding your store's order by/cut-off times, dispatch times and estimated shipping/delivery dates. Customers often want to know "when can I order by today for the quickest processing" and "When can I expect the order by". DeliveryTimer can answer these questions for your customers assisting you to increasing your conversions. 
 Why? 
 You have probably seen something along these lines before on popular stores such as "Order in the next 3 Hours, 27 Minutes for same day dispatch" or "Order within the next 3 Hours, 27 Minutes for estimated delivery by Wednesday 12th July". 

 Providing this information to you customer can create urgency to secure that order today. Furthermore, the timer will hide itself once the order-by deadline has past for the current day and will reappear midnight for the next day. This way you don't deter customers from ordering if they are later on in the day.

 Display Order Countdown (Cut off time / Order-by deadline) 
 Display Estimated Delivery/Shipping Dates 
 Customise frontend widget

DeliveryTimer allows you to display information surrounding your store's order by/cut-off times, dispatch times and estimated shipping/delivery dates. Customers often want to know "when can I order by today for the quickest processing" and "When can I expect the order by". DeliveryTimer can answer these questions for your customers assisting you to increasing your conversions.

Why?

You have probably seen something along these lines before on popular stores such as "Order in the next 3 Hours, 27 Minutes for same day dispatch" or "Order within the next 3 Hours, 27 Minutes for estimated delivery by Wednesday 12th July".

Providing this information to you customer can create urgency to secure that order today. Furthermore, the timer will hide itself once the order-by deadline has past for the current day and will reappear midnight for the next day. This way you don't deter customers from ordering if they are later on in the day.

Features

  • Display Order Countdown (Cut off time / Order-by deadline)
  • Display Estimated Delivery/Shipping Dates
  • Customise frontend widget
  • Extensive settings
  • Responsive
  • Hide timer for certain products/collections
  • Disable timer for public holidays, closed days, vacations
  • Lightweight Widget

Setup

Installation & setup is fairly straight forward. There is documentation for setting up DeliveryTimer & troubleshooting. If you have any questions or problems with installation and would like some help, we fully support our apps so simply drop us a message.

Feature Requests

We are always looking to help store merchants so if you have a feature request for DeliveryTimer or any of our other apps, please let us know!

title: Product Expiry Toolkit
description:
Product Expiry Toolkit 
 
 What problem does the app solve? 
 

 
 Are you selling products with expiry date? 
 Are you selling products which only valid for a period of time, like seasonal goods?  
 Are your selling products only promoting for a while and stop selling after that? 
 

 If the answer is yes, you must spend a lot of time manage product inventory according to its expiry date. e.g. take notes on your notebook when the expiry date is for each product; set a reminder; update the inventory to 0 when the expiry date is due. If you feel annoying to do so, here is good news. We create this app just for you 

 
 How does it solve the problem? 
 

 The Product Expiry Toolkit is an influential tool which helps to manage your inventory of products with expiry date. 

 Built with the concept of simple and easy use, the app allows you to set an expiry date for every variant as you like, and the toolkit manages to track the variant inventory based on expiry date you set. If a variant has reached its expiry date, our toolkit will detect this event and automatically set its stock to 0, so that the customer wont buy any expired product from your store. Keep you confident and good reputation. 

 
 How does your app work with Shopify? 
 

 The Product Expiry Toolkit reads your product and variants information in your store when authorised. In our app, you could set the expiry date on each variants, then it saved to in your Shopify products. Then our toolkit will help you to track these date set, and reduce the inventory of that variant to 0 when it's due. you will also get a email notification indicating the expiry details of that variant.  

 The Toolkit wont change the look of your store. 

 
 How do I get started? 
 

 Install this app, you will get a 30 days trial. Have fun! :)

title: Random Upsells & Cross‑Sells
description:
Random Upsells & Cross-Sells is a cross-selling and upselling automation tool that generates additional sales by offering random products in the most important touchpoints with the customers along all their customer journey - on the homepage, product page, search page, cart page, on “Add to cart” and on Thank you page. 
 Highlights 
 
 Add cross-selling galleries across the store 
 Upsell on Thank you page 
 Sell Bundles with discounts 
 Display "Recently bought" notifications 
 Offer products in pop-ups after the product added to cart 
 Enjoy cross-selling automation 
 Track effectiveness in GA 
 Retain customers at the negative search results page, empty cart, etc. 
 Restart customers journey 
 
 How Random Upsells & Cross-Sells makes you money 
 The application unobtrusively offers more and more products to the potential buyers in most important touchpoints triggering an interest to explore. It relaunches the customer journey after the checkout. And it does all that without bothering you. 
 NEW "Recently bought" pop-up 
 The app triggers purchases with social proof of product popularity.  Encourage visitors to make decisions and act by giving them real-time updates on activity in your store. 
 Add cross-selling galleries 
 Whether it’s a product page or a Thank you page, a neat gallery product gallery will engage visitors to explore more related products in a convenient way. Another closed deal is a natural result of this journey. 
 Offer Bundles 
 Increase an average order value by offering several products with a discount on the product page. The app will offer the viewed product with another one or two from your inventory. 
 Enjoy placement freedom 
 Offer random products from your inventory anywhere in your store. Add it on all product pages, or on the search result page. You can even place it in your blog post using a special code. Display it as a gallery or as a floating button with CTA. 
 Refresh shopping experience 
 Stimulate customers to explore your products as a part of the game. Moreover, if you’ve had nothing to do with “No results found” for your on-site search, now you can give the searchers a way out by offering them random products. 
 Restart customers journey over and over again 
 Make your visitors explore your products. Don't let them leave with an empty cart. 
 Get better rank 
 By guiding your visitors through the store you encourage them to stay longer and take actions, which is a positive signal for the search engine to reduce your bounce rate and increase your website rank. 
 Big data, machine learning, and personalization 
 Random Upsells & Cross-Sells application for Shopify is an alternative to complicated big data, machine learning, and personalization tools. It was created with simplicity in mind for the businesses with traffic under 1 mln visits a month.

title: LeftBrain
description:
LeftBrain is a very simple marketing automation tool that focuses on 100% automation. We know that as store owners, you have to deal with too many tasks and managing relationship with each customer may become hectic. At the end of the day though, customers should be the number one priority. 

 Unlike many other marketing automation apps that are hard to setup and manage, we focus on simplicity. That's why we created LeftBrain Automation. 
 LeftBrain Automation 
 Every online store has a simple goal: to keep as many active customers as possible. An active customer means a happy customer who will consistently purchase at your store. However, keeping customers engaged is a continuous process that requires time and resources. Time and resources are hard to come by when you have a small to mid-sized store. 

 Automation is an offer-based marketing automation feature that continuously tracks customers and periodically contacts them based on a set of rules defined automatically by the system with very minimal input from the store owner. Automation's goal is to keep customers engaged and active. 
 So how does it work? 
 
 Once you set up LeftBrain once and turn it on, it works by itself 100%, with no more interaction from you. 
 LeftBrain AI automatically segments your customers into different segments based on each customers' shopping behavior. It then continuously tracks customers for segment changes. 
 When a segment change occurs, LeftBrain automatically creates a personalized discount code for that customer, and delivers it via email. 
 Customer then is able to use that code at checkout. It's that simple. 
 In the case when customer misses the email, but comes to your store, he/she will be notified via screen pop that they have an unused discount code that expires on a specific date. This way, even if they miss the email, they won't miss their discount codes. 
 
 What do you have to do to get started? 
 
 Install LeftBrain. 
 Edit the email templates so that the wording of each email defines how you would like to approach your customers. 
 Setup your widget (pop-up), same way. 
 Turn Automation ON. 
 Enjoy Full Automation! Just watch sign-ups and sales grow by itself.

 Bestsellers reSort saves your time and money. While you are asleep, the app analyzes the rules you set and sorts products in selected collections according to these rules. Daily. Automatically. Do you know that Shopify's default order "Sort by Bestsellers" is recalculated once every 30 days? reSort can find your bestsellers every single day. 

 Sort your products automatically by: 

 
   Revenue generated 
   Number of sales 
   Product price (low->high, high->low) 
   Product title (A-Z)

  Featured Products - stick them to the top of a collection. Promote seasonal or special items. 
  Tagged Products - choose products with a specific tag(s) and reposition them within a collection. Organize your collections better. 
  New Products - stick them to the top of a collection. Show your customers that you have new shiny things in the store.

title: Pargo pickup points
description:
About the Pargo App 
 The Pargo App allows you to offer your customers an extra shipping method. By adding the App your customer can choose between Home Delivery or Pargo Pick-up. If they choose for Pargo, a map is populated with all the Pargo stores and they choose their preferred Pargo pick-up point. This information is then captured on your back-end after the customer completes the order. 

 The Pargo App allows you to offer South African pickup and drop-off locations that your customers can use when it is most convenient for them by having the packages dropped off at a Pargo Pickup Point. Once the package arrives at the selected Pargo pickup point, an SMS is sent to your customers notifying them the package can be picked up at their convenience. 
 About Pargo 
 Pargo is a convenient logistics solution that lets people collect and return parcels at Pargo parcel points throughout South Africa when it suits them best. Pargo is addressing the challenges of home delivery. People often miss the delivery of a parcel because they are not at home, others live/work at estates or office buildings that are not accessible for couriers. Pargo solves these problems by sending the parcels to the Pargo points where the customer can collect at a time suitable to them. Pargo can also be used to return any parcel. A customer then simply drop’s off the parcel at the Pargo point and we will take of the rest. 
 How Pargo works in 4 steps: 
 *Shop and choose your preferred Pargo point when checking out.
*Delivery will be done to your chosen pick-up point.
*You will receive an email and SMS when your parcel arrives at the selected Pargo point.
*Customers collect their parcels when it suits them best. 
 Features: 
 
 Seamless integration with Shopify's native checkout process. 
 User friendly and easy to use for your store's customers. 
 Over 1500+ Pargo points and growing across South Africa. 
 Parcel stored in safe and secure dedicated area within the Pargo point. 
 Full tracking of entire process. 
 All communication (SMS and email) with customers regarding collections managed by Pargo. 
 No more missed deliveries. 
 Pargo points can also be used for returns. 
 In order to start using this app to fulfill your deliveries, you must first join Pargo and make a myPargo account. 
 
 Feedback and Support 
 If you have any questions regarding the app or enhancement ideas, please contact us.

description:
Cerasis LTL Freight Quotes 
 You must have a Cerasis account number to use this application. Third party calculated shipping (aka Carrier calculated shipping ) must be enabled on your Shopify plan.  Third party calculated shipping can be added to any plan by contacting Shopify customer support.   
 Overview 
 Display your negotiated Cerasis LTL freight rates in the Shopify checkout process so you can collect your shipping costs on each order.  You have the option to include a handling charge in the rate so you can recover the cost of packing materials or other expenses associated with your shipping operation. 
 Key Features 
 
 Supported origins: United States 
 Supported destinations: Canada, United States. 
 Choose from three rating options: Cheapest, Cheapest Options and Average. 
 Control the number of LTL freight options displayed. (Cheapest Options method only.) 
 Control which carriers are quoted. Exclude carriers you've had a bad experience with. 
 Define multiple warehouse  and drop ship locations. 
 Generically label the quote (i.e. "Freight") or brand the quote using the carrier's name. 
 Product specific shipment parameters: weight, dimensions, freight class. 
 Shipment parameters can be set differently for each product variation. 
 Options for residential delivery. 
 Options for lift gate delivery. 
 Provide an option for in-store pick up. 
 Identify a local delivery area. 
 Specify a handling charge as dollars and cents, or as a percentage of the quoted rate. 
 
 Where can I find out more?

 Who is Cerasis? 
 Cerasis (cerasis.com) is a third party logistics company that gives its customers access to dozens of LTL freight carriers through a single account relationship. To establish an account use the link in the User's Guide to access the new account request form.

 48-Hour Print-On-Demand  
 Low Return Rates 
 Product Prices that Push Profits 
 
 Team up with us for your POD orders ready for shipping in 48 hours

description:
What is Ship by Amazon FBA 
 Amazon FBA stands as the number one fulfilment channel for many. Businesses prefer selling on many online channels and fulfil by Amazon. 

 This app connects Shopify and Amazon FBA and allows you to sell on Shopify and ship your orders via Amazon FBA, this app also tracks inventory and automagically updates the inventory levels from Amazon to Shopify 

 This app understands  that the SKU ids on Amazon and Shopify may not be same and hence have a mapping interface, 

 This app understands that the seller may be using Bundles on Shopify and may have normal individual level items on Amazon , and hence we also have a mapping of bundles on Shopify to individual items on Amazon FBA. 
 Why this app? 
 We at WebBee having decades of experience working on integrations with multiple platforms. 

 Many of the much needed though simple features are built in on this app 

 
 Mapping between bundles 
 Mapping between SKUs on Amazon and Shopify 
 Validate correct Amazon credentials before use 
 Real time sync of orders from Shopify to Amazon FBA for fulfillment 
 Partial tracking of orders 
 Enable / disable ship confirmation notification emails to Customers from Shopify 
 
 Is it easy? 
 To make this app simple to use and also less expensive but without compromising the functionality we have removed some overheads like : 
1. We don't edit the order before sending to Amazon
2. A Shopify Embedded App: No separate logins
3. (One can however do the same from Shopify order panel) 

 And above all We at WebBee have a very responsive team on requests to enhancement and support . Our support response time is normally short even if you are testing the app or have a paid plan we will not discriminate and you will receive the best of service. 

 This app will not create listings on Amazon or modify listings there 

 This app will not work if your Shopify store is password protected

title: Bold Returns
description:
In a nutshell 
 This app will help you build a robust returns process that you can use as an amazingly powerful marketing tool for your store. Allow customers to submit return requests, track the status of those returns and print shipping labels, all from an integrated portal on your Shopify store.  

 On the back-end, your team can set custom return rules and deadlines, see analytics on return requests, and approve/reject requests with ease. Spend less time managing returns over email and let the app do it for you! 
 Powerful customer portal 
 Bold Returns offer an easy-to-integrate customer portal that your shoppers can use to do order lookups and submit any return requests they may have. Through the portal, customers can:
* See the status of submitted/past return requests
* Add written notes/messages and upload photos
* Automatically print return shipping labels from UPS (if configured) 
 Custom return rules 
 Set rules for each of your products that determine the length of time for which they can be returned. For example, your swimwear products might not be returnable at all, but you also sell t-shirts that can be returned within 30 days of purchase. It's super easy to set up a rule that will automatically prevent returns for any of your products. The app also keeps track of when each purchase was made, and will notify customers about which products can be returned dependent on how their rules are set. 
 Store overrides 
 Sometimes, to satisfy a customer's complaint, your store might choose to create a return outside of your normal return policy (maybe they call in 45 days after their order, when you only have a 30 day return policy). The app will allow you to manually override any of your return rules so that you can create a return request in the system. The customer can access this request just like any other. 
 Flexible and customizable 
 The app was designed from the ground up to be flexible enough to meet the needs of most stores. You can change language settings, return groups, make custom statuses, and style almost any aspect of the customer returns widget. The return portal embeds easily using the Shopify Pages feature, which means you can include it alongside your return policy. 
 Automatically generate shipping labels with UPS 
 Using our powerful, direct integration with UPS, you can allow customers to automatically generate return shipping labels. Once a shipping label is printed, the customer prints it out and attaches it to their shipment. They don't even need to leave their house! 
 Return analytics 
 View the status of your returns pipeline at a glance, by seeing how many products are approved for return, and a breakdown of the types of returns that are being submitted (for Credit, Refund, or Replacement).

title: Frequently Bought Together
description:
Effortless Amazon-like recommended products 
 You have probably browsed Amazon before and noticed that sometimes you can add a bunch of related products with one single click. 

 The Frequently Bought Together app brings this upsell feature into Shopify in the most convenient way: you can have it ready in your store within seconds and with zero configuration. 
 How does it work? 
 Frequently Bought Together analyses the previous purchases in your store database through data mining algorithms and produces a memory graph with the recommended products that are usually added together to the shopping cart. 
 How are the upsell recommended products displayed? 
 When a customer visits a product page, a bundle comprised of the recommended products usually bought together is displayed. 

 By default, all bundle recommendations are selected but the customer can remove any of them with a user-friendly user interface. 

 If your store uses variants, the customer can also select the desired recommendation variants; their pictures and prices are automatically refreshed. 

 After that, all recommended products are added to the shopping cart with a single click. Easier for your customer means more sales for you. 

 It also works as a reminder of suggested complements to a product. 
 Frequently Bought Together configuration options 
 You can change the following options at any time 

 
 Limit the maximum number of recommended products 
 Select the position of the upsell recommendation widget in the product pages 
 Fully customisable user interface 
 Manual recommendations: although we recommend automatic recommendations as they lead to higher conversions, you can also manually fine-tune the bundle recommendations for each product 
 Show random products when there is not enough data for automatic recommendations. They can be filtered by collection, product type or product vendor 
 Show ratings from Shopify Product Reviews 
 Display 'compare at' prices of the recommendations 
 Option to skip cart and directly redirect to the checkout 
 Option to apply a percentage discount to the bundle 
 Free SEO report: all stores using this app periodically receive a detailed SEO report 
 
 About Code Black Belt, the developers of Frequently Bought Together 
 So who are we? 

 We are a medium-sized app development company whose mission is to provide useful, easy-to-use and reasonably priced apps to our customers, which not only add value to your stores, but also enhance its look and feel. 

 All our apps have been specifically designed with the user in mind. That is why all our apps have a one-click functionality and immediately after installation, are ready to go and automatically configured to your theme. Our team also customises our app to your theme and is here for any request you may have.

title: Bundles | Also Bought Together
description:
Increasing average order value is often overlooked, marketers rather focus on getting a low cost per purchase. Few online stores are taking advantage of this simple tactic to cross-sell and boost their sales. "Also bought" is always a powerful message, making your customers fell they're missing on a sale. 
 Product Bundles -  the ultimate product bundle upsell app for Shopify 
 You've definitely seen Amazon's "Frequently Bought Together", where you can add to cart a couple of related products with one single click. We're bringing this to Shopify - and you can have it running in your store in less than a minute, with just a few clicks. 

 The app checks your previous sales to recommend products that were purchased together. Bundles are displayed when the customers view product pages - they can choose to remove some and add the remaining to cart with a single click. Variants can be dinamically selected, with pictures and prices updated automatically.  

 You can also customize at product level: for example, for an iPhone X, you might want to bundle it with a case, a headset and an extra charger. Sky's the limit - and you'll definitely sell more by upselling and cross-selling. 
 Our top recommendations 
 
 Always add cross-sells for your best-sellers. Just check what products can be easily mixed. Selling cameras? Recommend a spare battery. Phones? Maybe an attractive, compatible case.  
 Never sell more than 3 products together. Our studies shows that cross-selling 2 products always work better than 3, 4 or more. 
 When creating custom bundles, make sure you add a custom, attractive title. Bundling a pair of shoes with a belt? Make it sound awesome: "Match it with a Premium Belt - and get 10% OFF both" 
 
 Note on other types of upsells 
 This app doesn't offer a volume discount / quantity breaks type of offers. Try VITALS for tiered pricing. With Product Bundles you can't yet create "Buy One Get One" (BOGO) or "Buy One Get One Free" - this is on our future roadmap. 
 Clean install 
 Unlike other apps, we strictly follow Shopify's recommendation to never edit your theme files. And we don't duplicate your product variants - so you never have to worry about syncing inventory or anything like that. The app uses discount codes to create bundles, so customers won't be able to use additional discount codes for their purchase. 
 Fast loading 
 We use both Cloudflare for fast, global delivery, as well as browser caching. 
 Look and Feel 
 Beautiful front-end display that looks great on any Shopify-retailed theme on PCs, smartphones or tablets. Contact us and we will help you match the look and feel of the app with your theme.  
 Easy setup, no coding required 
 The installation could not be easier - it is a 1-click process.

title: Easy Google Customer Reviews
description:
What is Google Customer Reviews? 
 Google Customer Reviews is a free program that allows businesses to collect feedback from customers that have made a purchase on their site (Please note that this program is only available to Merchants in certain countries). The ratings left by customers using Google Customer Reviews will be applied to your Google Seller Ratings eligibility. Google Seller ratings appear on Search Ads, in Google Shopping, and on an optional Google Seller Ratings badge that can be displayed on your site. 
 So how does the app deliver the Google Customer Reviews Service? 
 When a customer makes a purchase on your site, they will be presented with a pop-up option on the Order Status page. The pop-up will ask if they would like to opt-in to receive an email from Google requesting feedback about their experience with your store. If the customer opts-in, they may receive an email from Google once their order is estimated to have arrived. 
 So why should I use your app? 
 With the easy Google Customer Reviews app and zero additional coding required, we make sure the survey opt-in code runs on your store, no matter what Shopify plan you're on. It will send only the data that Google require to send the survey on to your customer and it will play nicely with every other app used to process information on your Order Status page(conversion tracking apps etc.) 
  How do I get started? 
 Once you've installed the app, all you need to do is enter your Google Merchant Center ID, pick an estimated number of days it takes to deliver an order and you're ready to go. The survey opt-in will start appearing on the Order Status page after a successful purchase and Google will take care of the rest.

title: Order Tagger
description:
Why tag an order? 
 Applying tags to orders can help to group them based on a particular set of criteria. For example, you might want to highlight all orders that have been placed with a specific delivery method so that you can fulfil them quickly, or, you might like to highlight orders placed by first-time customers so that a welcome gift can be placed in their order. 

 Tagging Orders is a vital step in building automation workflows for the processing and fulfilment of orders. So why waste precious time manually tagging each order when you can create a set of rules to take care of it for you? 
 What rules can I apply using Order Tagger? 
 Order Tagger automatically tags orders based on a variety of conditions. You simply create a rule and then when an order matches that rule, we tag it. This allows you to group your orders based on tags to streamline your fulfilment process, highlight particular orders and much more. 
 Full list of tagging rules available 
 PRODUCT BASED RULES 

 
 Tag orders based upon the product or product variant purchased 
 Tag orders based on the collections the products are purchased from 
 Tag orders based on the product tags of products purchased 
 Tag orders based on the product vendor of the products purchased 
 

 TRANSACTION BASED RULES 

 
 Tag orders based on the sales channel 
 Tag orders based on the discount codes used 
 Tag orders based on their total weight 
 Tag orders based on the total price 
 Tag orders based on the payment method used 
 Tag orders based on where the order was placed (POS/Locations) 
 

 SHIPPING BASED RULES 

 
 Tag orders based on the shipping address state (United States) 
 Tag orders based on the shipping address region (New Zealand) 
 Tag orders based on the shipping address county (United Kingdom) 
 Tag orders based on the shipping method 
 Tag orders based on the carrier service used 
 Tag orders based on the shipping address country 
 Tag orders based on the zip/postcode of the shipping address 
 

 BILLING ADDRESS BASED RULES 

 
 Tag orders based on the billing address country 
 

 CUSTOMER BASED RULES 

 
 Tag orders if it's the first order placed by the customer 
 Tag orders based on the customer's tags 
 Tag orders based on the total spend of the customer 
 Tag orders based on the customer's order volume 
 Tag orders with the customer's first and last name 
 Tag orders if the customer accepts marketing 
 

 OTHER 

 
 Tag orders based on the fraud level 
 Tag orders based on its order attributes 
 Tag orders based on its line item properties 
 Auto tag all orders 
 Tag orders that have not had a tag assigned 
 Tag orders if the order note contains specific text 
 
 Custom Features 
 If you need a rule or workflow that you don't see in the list above, then please get in touch and we'll see how we can help!

title: Multi Vendor Marketplace
description:
This module is a great tool to convert your shop into a fully functioning marketplace. It facilitates the process of adding sellers and keep track of their sales. Sellers (or vendors) can have their own profile and collection page with variety of products. Admin (or merchant) can easily set individual commission and global commission for all the sellers. 
 Features: 
 ** Admin can set global commission for all the sellers & can also set separate commission for individual seller. Category wise commission. 

 ** Product /Seller added through CSV file. Products bulk edited by CSV. 

 ** Admin can assign existing product to the seller 

 ** Admin can select whether the store will sell normal, digital products. 

 ** Admin can allow/disallow seller to have tax on their products 

 ** Reminder Feature to remind the vendor for order fulfillment. Admin can send reminder email to the vendor for order fulfillment. 

 ** Admin to seller invoice and seller to customer invoice is also available. 

 ** Seller can have their own ‘Profile Page’ on the store 

 ** Customer can rate the Seller from the Seller Profile Page. 

 ** App is Multi-lingual with Weglot. 
 Additional Feature Apps : 
 ** Payment Methods for payment split between Admin and Seller - Stripe Connect 

 ** Auction for Sellers 

 ** Mobile App for Customers 

 ** USPS, Canada Post, EComm Express, AirSpeed Shipping available for Sellers 

 ** Allow "Store Pick Up"  

 ** Sync your Seller products from their own ECommerce store. 

 ** Sellers on Vacation? Now update the Customer about the same using this app. 

 ** Membership plan for Sellers 

 ** Favorite Product/Seller 

 ** Slot Pricing 

 ** SMS Alert 

 ** Multivendor API 

 ** Admin Staff (can add staff member) 

 
 Commission Management: Its the admin share in the seller's order. 
 Global Commission : Applied on all the sellers 
 Individual Commission for Seller : If admin want to have different commission rate for different seller then can do it with individual commission.
Also the commission can be a fixed amount or percentage wise as well for both global as well as individual commission. 
 Tax Distribution - Admin can choose to distribute the tax on the product in three ways : 
 

 Admin only : Whole product tax will be given to the admin. 

 Divide Between Sellers : Whole product tax is divided proportionally between the sellers. 

 Proportion Between Admin & Seller : Tax distributed proportionally among the admin and the seller. 

 This was all about the Multivendor Marketplace App. In case of any questions, feel free to connect. 

 Note : Feature Apps are available at extra costs apart from the app charge 

 
             
               Integrates with 
               
                 
     
      Product Auction App,
     
     
      Booking App,
     
     
      Mobixlab App

title: Reeleezee
description:
Your webshop orders effortlessly in Reeleezee 
 This App connects your Shopify webshop to your Reeleezee administration. Your orders will be transferred automatically to Reeleezee, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Save time and avoid errors. No more double data entry! 
 Keep it straight and simple 
 Transfer your Shopify orders to Reeleezee invoices or salesentries (aka boekingsbonnen). This connection is a real-time connection. You indicate when a Shopify order is transferred: When it is created, paid of partially paid. 

 The correct price-details and customer-details are transferred to Reeleezee. This a list of the most important parameter-mappings. A full detailed service description in Dutch language is available. 

 
 Order-details:
The order-specifics, like order number and order date are transferred. The payment method is part of the sales transaction description. Of course the order lines are transferred. Per order line the line-price, article, tax code and ledger code are transferred.  
 Customer-details:
The full customer details like email address, name, company, address, telephone number etc are transferred. Through the email address it is verified whether the customer is already present. If so, the customer-details are adapted. 
 
 Getting started 
 This app is recommended for Dutch merchants with a Reeleezee account. Sign up for a free 30-day trial. Sequential pricing is excluded VAT and subscription of Reeleezee. 
 Our company 
 Webwinkelfacturen.nl is highly specialized and we love what we do: connect webshops to accounting software. We started in 2014 and are the market leader in the Dutch market by supporting 10 e-commerce platforms and 16 accounting systems. We enjoy helping our customers and decrease their administration burden.

title: Delivery Date Pro
description:
Delivery Date Pro 
 Delivery Date Pro is unique extension with many special features to allow a customer to choose the delivery date for their orders and also allows admin to manage feature with more flexibility. 
 Main Features: 
 
 Date picker option along with different date format options. 
 Application will allow admin to set title of the date picker field. 
 Unique feature of allowing admin to block any specific days of the week (example: Saturday/Sunday) or any single/multiple dates (example: Christmas - 25 Dec. or dates between 25 Dec. to 31 Dec.) during the year so the customer won't be able to select those dates for delivery. 
 Application will also allow admin to enable same day or next day delivery option. 
 Another exceptional feature is: "Cut off Time" - admin can set cut off time for orders to consider it same day / next day delivery. so all order before cut off time will be able to set same day / next day delivery otherwise system will show next available delivery dates after cut off time. 
 Also we can add custom notes/message for customer below the date picker field on cart page. 
 Application is also compatible with pop up cart window/theme.
