title: SELLY UNITED
description:
Selly is especially built for Shopifiers to increase sales in many ways: Up-sell popups at Aha moment 
 
 Right when buyers feeling awesome after adding first product to cart, Selly display more up-selling products. 
 These up-selling products are automatically selected by AI based on your sales history or manually selected by you for a specific marketing campaign. 
 
 Cross-sell sections 
 
 Selly displays recommended products at the bottom of pages. Fortunately, Selly has no design for this feature, because these sections will be displayed exactly following your theme design. 
 Some common sections such as best sellers, new arrivals and recent views are ready to turn on. 
 
 Bundle-sell widgets 
 
 Display your products in bundles that buyers can easily add all to cart by ONE click. 
 Selly has many flexible options so you can create bundles for as many products or variants as you want. 
 
 Gamified motivator 
 
 Motivate customers to continue shopping to reach cart goal with a progress bar, e.g., free shipping for order above 100 USD or add more items to get free gift.  
 When customers reach the goal, the offer will be applied automatically. 
 
 Quantity break or wholesale 
 
 Create different price tiers for products based on the quantity a customer buys. 
 For example: Buy 5 get 10% off, Buy 10 get 2 free, Buy 20 get 20% off and free ship... 
 
 Post-purchase upsale 
 
 Display a widget with coupon, social media buttons and products on thank you page. 
 The widget is only shown when an order is completed, to tell buyers to use the coupon for the next purchase or share it with their friends. 
 
 Bulk & scheduled discount 
 
 You can display your discount offers to your customers with many types such as free gift, free shipping, BOGO, buy X get Y. 
 Selly uses the latest Shopify API to have the best discount function. It means NO duplicating variant, NO generating ton of discount codes, almost NO changing your theme. 
 Discount automation of Selly and discount codes of other apps can be applied together via special setting. 
 
 Other tools 
 
 Top bar, last second up-sell, quick-view, flash-sell, countdown, holiday themes, premiums are ready too. 
 They work in harmony and keep waiting for you to explore. 
 
 Moreover 
 
 Selly is easy to use, no coding skills needed. 
 App interface is customizable via setting tools, however if you need any supports or customizations, our dedicated team will help for free. 
 As we focus on only one app to provide a better service day by day, some other helpful modules are waiting for release and we promise the price will be the same for our existing customers.

 Your customer selects Oxxo Pay at your checkout and will be shown a 14 digit reference number with instructions to pay it.

 To make the payment your customer does not need to print anything, they can simply read the 14 numbers to the Oxxo cashier. 
 Immediately after the order was paid, the order status will update to paid in your Shopify Dashboard and you'll receive a notification so you can fulfill it! 
 
 Features 
 
 Customize the payment ticket that is sent to your customers so it matches the brand of your store 
 Get full view of all orders and their statuses directly on your Shopify Dashboard 
 Personalize the expiration date to expire after a certain number of days or hours 
 Ability to re-send tickets for existing orders to customers if they forgot to pay or the due date expired 
 
 Requirements 
 You need an active Conekta account ready for production (free) in order to enable payments through Oxxo.

title: DPEX Worldwide
description:
DPEX Worldwide Online Integration 
 Fully integrating with DPEX Worldwide online system, this easy to install and configure app assists you in the creation of high quality and accurate shipping documentation to accompany your packages – whether they be travelling locally or around the world. 
What this app will help you to do:-
* Import pending orders directly into DPEX Worldwide online system.
* Print labels (as well as commercial invoices if required) and fulfil your orders via DPEX Worldwide online system.
* Track and monitor your orders that are being shipped to your customers. 
 What is DPEX Worldwide Online System? 
 DPEX Worldwide online system is an easy to use web-based portal specifically designed to assist in the preparation and management of shipments being delivered.
In particular, DPEX Worldwide online system will:-
* Assist in the preparation of consignment notes/delivery labels (and commercial invoices as necessary). 
*Provide management of receiver names and addresses (your address book) for future orders.
* Send automated shipment notifications to your recipients to make them aware that a shipment is on the way to them
* Provide up to the minute tracking and monitoring of your shipments currently in transit
* Let you set alerts to advise if there is a problem/delay in the delivery of your orders.
* Allow the setting of user preferences to further ease the preparation of future shipment documentation.
* Provide you with the ability to generate reports and statistics of your current/historical shipments including transit times.  You can event schedule these reports to be sent to you automatically at preset times! 
 What Next? 
 So, take the first step to save yourself time, reduce Customer Service enquiries and avoid the mundane task of preparing shipment documentation.

title: Redirectify
description:
Streamlined 
 Redirectify presents a smart, streamlined approach to creating redirects in Shopify to fix 404 crawl errors. 

 It syncs with your Google Search Console account to list crawl errors affecting your search rankings and presents you with a simple interface with live suggestions as you type to create redirects to similar pages, collections or products in your store, based on actual, valid paths. There's no need to search for an appropriate replacement URL; Redirectify does that for you! 
 Why not use another redirect app? 
 404s alone do not affect your site's overall search ranking. However, if you have previously high ranking pages/products giving a 404, you risk losing a key source of visitors to your store. Redirectify helps you redirect customers who visit these invalid links to relevant and genuinely helpful pages to ensure your customers are always able to find what they're looking for and to maintain a good customer experience. 

 We prefer this approach over generic bulk redirects, as a redirect to an irrelevant page is no more helpful to your customers than a 404. In addition, Google ranks pages on the relevance of the content within, so a relevant substitute will always perform better than a generic catch-all. 
 Partner-friendly! 
 Redirectify is free to try out on any development store—and you will be presented with a set of sample data so you can get familiar with the workflow. 
 Notes on support 
 While we make every effort to provide prompt and helpful support for our users, please understand that we are a small team based in New Zealand and offer support during business hours New Zealand time. This means we may not be as quick to get back to you over the New Zealand weekend or on public holidays.

description:
What does the app do? 
 As multiple eCommerce studies show, upselling and cross-selling can be beneficial in many ways. 

 On the one hand, these sale techniques create a more positive image of an online store: being offered relevant extras, the customers feel that the seller understands their wants and needs. On the other, this approach proved to be effective for:  

 
 better conversion rates, 
 increasing the total store profit, 
 enhanced exposure of the best-selling products and higher margin items.  
 

 With this Upsell & Cross-Sell Toolkit app, you can improve your customers’ satisfaction and generate more profit from each order.   
 Cross-Sell PopUps and HTML Blocks 
 The app enables you to create: 

 
 a custom popup message to promote your additional products or services,  
 [NEW] HTML blocks with related products. 
 

 You can display the popup on the: 

 
 shopping cart page, 
 store checkout. 
 

 Custom cross-sell HTML blocks can be incorporated either on the product page or the shopping cart page. 
 Cross-Sell Message Customization 
 The content of the popup and HTML block is fully-customizable. You can adjust any element, including the:  

 
 title, 
 description,  
 list of promoted products*, 
 order of the products on the list (sort/shuffle them)*, 
 style (content/header/footer background, font and border colors),  
 [NEW] product details (using such product attributes as price, variants, qty, etc.). 
 

  * With the app, it's possible to pick up the promoted products manually OR automatically (using custom conditions). Any product from the list can be manually excluded whenever needed.  

 Also, the toolkit lets you define the amount of cross-sell products to display in the popup/HTML block (per row/slide) and select which attributes to display with them.   

 What is more, if some of your cross-sell products is not currently available (out of stock), you can set the app to automatically exclude it from the popup.  
 PopUp/HTML Block Display Settings 
 After you’ve created your cross-sell message, you can specify how, when and where to deliver it for your prospects, thus maximizing its marketing effect.   

 With the Upsell & Cross-sell Toolkit you can: 

 
 display the cross-sell message for selected locations,  
 specify the offer validity period,  
 set the cart total amount to display the offer for, 
 select the device type to display the message on.  
 

 Any created cross-sell offer can be duplicated.  

 [NEW] The app was tested and adjusted on ALL free themes that can be found in the App Store.

title: 1st Sales
description:
The problem we are trying to solve:
Say you run a facebook ad campaign to reach out to 10,000 prospects. 100 of them clicked on the ad and arrive at the product page of your store. Most of them left the site within 10 seconds. Some of them linger around much longer because they are interested. There is interest but not at a sufficient level for them to buy. 
 Current popular solutions:
There are two popular solutions to this problem. One of them is to use a site-wide banner. to advertise a discount for new customers. The problem is that this banner will be shown to all visitors, not just prospects. The offer is also shown when the prospect reach the site, not when the prospect is lingering over the product.
Another solution is to use a popup to acquire email of prospects. A discount offer is offered in return. Problem is that the popup is shown to all visitors. The conversion will be lower as it requires the prospect to open their email and act on it. 
 The solution we offer:
Our solution is to show the offer only to new prospects. We will show it at the right moment when they are lingering over the product's photos. The app will track the amount of time the product's photos are interacting with the photos. If there is significant interest, the app will offer a good offer for the new visitor in the sales pop-up. 
 Sales popup designed to acquire new customers
The app will check whether the visitor is a new prospect or an existing customer. Offer is only presented to the visitor or logged-in customer who has yet to make a single purchase. 
 Popup triggered by genuine interest from visitors
The app uses time spent on the product's photos to determine whether it is genuine interest. The popup will be shown after the visitor had spent a significant amount of time interacting with the photos. The amount of time is customizable. 
 1-click buy button
1-click buy button will bring visitor straight to Shopify's checkout page. It reduces sales fiction as it skipped the "add to cart" portion of the checkout process. Our app uses Shopify's features to implement this feature.
The app will use the currently selected option and it will work with single or multiple product variants.
It is also tested on popular themes. It uses jQuery to retrieve the selected product variant. It will not work with a heavily customized theme that uses Angular or other similar frameworks. 
 Responsive and customizable
The app is responsive on all mobile devices. You can easily edit the colour, fonts of the message and the popup bar.

title: Error Tracking with CatchJS
description:
Is your store breaking for half your users? 
 Conflicting app installations and ever-changing browsers can cause errors to happen in you store, and leave a user with unfinished business. For this reason, it is important to install error tracking so you won't silently lose business due to errors you don't know about. 

 CatchJS automatically collects any and all errors that happens in your store, and presents you with a detailed log of their circumstances. This way you can have peace of mind, knowing that things work as they should, and that you will be notified if not. 

 
 Get email notifications when errors happen 
 See screenshots of the users screen when the error happened 
 See the clicks that lead to the error 
 Get a full technical description of the problem 
 See a graph of error counts over time 
 
 Reproduce the problem easily 
 You get screenshots of the users screen when the error happened. Along with this, you get the series of clicks that happened on the page, so you can replay the users interation. This way you can easily reproduce the problem yourself, and assess its impact.  
 Drill down into technical details 
 Perhaps the error only happens on a certain type of smart phone? Perhaps it only happens when looking at a particular product? The error reporting script gives you insight into all relevant details about an error, down to the exact line of code on which the error occurred.  
 Error monitoring that doesn't slow you down 
 Shoppers love fast loading websites. Error tracking shouldn't slow things down. The CatchJS error tracking script has a small file size, which translates into fast load times, and a snappy experience for your users.

title: Pincode Serviceability Check
description:
Overview 
 Restrict the Cash on Delivery or other payment and shipping method based on postcodes. You can also add an option of checking the availability of the Cash on Delivery payment method and shipping availability directly on the product page, making it convenient for your customers to see if they will be able to use the service or not in advance. 

 You can manage all your zipcodes from the admin panel or can upload a csv file to bulk update and insert. A sample csv is provided with the extension. 

 Recently added History feature can help you track of which are the zipcodes which are in demand are not serviceable by you. 
 Use Case of Shipping Availability Check 
 The Shipping Availability Check module is a much needed feature to check the availability of a product to be shipped to a specific zip code. It can show if the product is available or not by the setting a zip code for the particular product id from the admin panel. The user can check the product availability on the product page by entering a zip code for his location. If the product is available for the entered zip code then a message will be displayed that the product is available for the entered zip code. 
 Features of Shipping Availability Check 
 
 It allows the users to know about the shipping availability on the product page. 
 Option to add serviceable pincodes for both Cash On Delivery as well as Prepaid payment option. 
 Option to enable or disable Pincode serviceability checkbox on Product page. 
 You could upload the pin-codes’ sheet from the backend ( only in CSV format). 
 Zip codes can be updated and deleted by the admin. 
 Shipping Availability Check supports multiple languages and translation. 
  The recent history of the zip code search for a product can also be seen by the users. 
 

 The main benefit of this module is that it provides customers the ability to check if the product they have selected is available to be shipped to a specific zip code or not. If the product is available for the entered zip code then the customer can easily go ahead for the checkout process. Sellers will also get benefited by using this modules as they can set the availability of their products according to the zip codes.

title: Stock Notifier
description:
With the help of this app, now merchant (admin) can manage the stock with proper notifications once the product reaches to the minimum quantity after which the product needs to be restocked. An email notification is sent to the customers also, when the product is restock. Thus helps increase sales, as now the customer will be aware about the product restock. This will help in analysing which products are hot in market and the products needs to be rebuild because of their poor sale. 
 Features: 
 
 Set the minimum quantity of product 
 Restock products with a click 
 Enable/disable option of "Notify me" when products are Out of Stock 
 Notifications and Communications on registered email of Merchant 
 Notification and Communication via customer's email 
 

 Configuration : Admin has all the control on the app configuration and can set the minimum product quantity after which the product needs to be restocked. Admin can also manage the email configuration. Merchant can also change the logo to be sent in the emails sent. 

 Restock products: Admin can see the list of products and their variants to be restocked and can restock the products along with the variants. Notification is also sent to the customers, once the product is in stock. 

 Restock Product History : The restock history is also managed for all the products and its variants. A detailed history on per product basis is also available, so the merchant can refer to them at any point of time. 

 This way the app is beneficial for managing the stocks and to keep the history for the same.

description:
A powerful tool for showcasing customer generated media in your store 
 TagTray provides a comprehensive platform for incorporating the photos and videos posted by your customers on social media directly into your Shopify store. 

 With TagTray, you can review posts with your hashtag on the most popular social media networks, and can easily request digital rights to select customer generated content that you feel would enhance your store's shopping experience. 

 Once you've pulled your customers' media into TagTray, you can build shoppable galleries that are displayed on your store in general galleries that link the products shown in your gallery photos. You can also build product-specific galleries on your Shopify product pages. 

 TagTray's customization options give you complete control over the look of the galleries being shown in your store. You can choose from multiple layout styles, including grids that dynamically resize to best fit your photos, carousels, full-page slideshows, and many other formats. 

 TagTray offers the following set of features: 

 
 Monitor and incorporate photos (and video) from Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter 
 Allow customers to upload photos directly from your store

 Multiple layout options, including grids and sliders 
 Custom galleries are easily inserted into your store via an HTML snippet

Southeastern (SEFL) LTL Freight Quotes 
 You must have a Southeastern Freight Lines (SEFL) account number to use this application.  Third party calculated shipping (akaCarrier calculated shipping ) must be enabled on your Shopify plan.  Third party calculated shipping can be added to any plan by contacting Shopify customer support.   
 Overview 
 Display your negotiated SEFL LTL freight rates in the Shopify checkout process so you can collect your shipping costs on each order.  You have the option to include a handling charge in the rate so you can recover the cost of packing materials or other expenses associated with your shipping operation. 
 Key Features 
 
 Supported origins: United States 
 Supported destinations: Canada, United States. 
 Define multiple warehouse  and drop ship locations. 
 Generically label the quote (i.e. "Freight") or brand the quote using the carrier's name. 
 Product specific shipment parameters: weight, dimensions, freight class. 
 Shipment parameters can be set differently for each product variation. 
 Options for residential delivery. 
 Options for lift gate delivery. 
 Provide an option for in-store pick up. 
 Identify a local delivery area. 
 Specify a handling charge as dollars and cents, or as a percentage of the quoted rate. 
 
 Where can I find out more? 
 A complete installation and users guide can be found at eniture.com.  Use the phone number or email address in the Support & Sales section of this listing to contact us with your questions. 
 Who is Southeastern Freight Lines (SEFL)? 
 Southeastern Freight Lines, abbreviated as SEFL, is a privately owned American LTL trucking company headquartered in Lexington, South Carolina. It originates service in the Southeastern and Southwestern United States and makes deliveries throughout the United States, Canada, and Mexico.  A network of service partners is used for transportation to areas outside of its service area.  SEFL is the 11th largest American LTL carrier with over $1 billion of annual revenue. If you don't have a Southeastern Freight Lines account number, contact them at 803-794-7300..

title: Bizzy Social Proof
description:
*Formerly known as Yo Recent Sales Notifications 
 Build trust with social proof 
 Bizzy is based on the concept of "social proof," which states that individuals are more likely to perform an action if they observe others around them performing similar actions.  

 By showing customers which products other shoppers have purchased from your store, you'll put them at ease, build confidence, and encourage them to make a purchase. 
 Create a busy "live" atmosphere 
 Bizzy lets you easily replicate the feel of a busy brick-and-mortar store. Your customers see subtle, elegant popups detailing recent purchases from your store. 
 Perfect for large and small businesses 
 Bizzy is a perfect solution for any store, regardless of your team size or how many sales you've made. Bizzy's flexible time stamp features let you customize which orders appear, from as recently as 30 minutes ago to 12 hours or longer. 
 Use retargeting to increase conversions 
 One of Bizzy's most powerful features lets you retarget customers who have viewed a product by showing them a recent sales notification for that specific product. 
 Customizable and user-friendly 
 Bizzy takes seconds to install and requires absolutely no code knowledge. Its simple interface is easy to use and lets you start building social proof in minutes. 
 Built-in FAQ and tooltips 
 We've designed Bizzy to include helpful FAQs and tooltips to give you a detailed overview of every setting, while keeping your dashboard clean and user-friendly. 
 Understand your customers better 
 Bizzy's UTM tracking functionality lets you collect valuable insights about the success of your notifications, along with a wide range of analytics about your customers.  

 Bizzy integrates with Google Analytics to provide detailed information about how each notification is performing—and which individuals are responding best.  

 With source and medium tracking, Bizzy feeds insights into your advertising campaigns by sharing where customers arrive from and how they found your store. 
 Multi-language support 
 No English? No problem! Bizzy's new language feature allows you to show your recent sales notifications in whichever language your customers are shopping in. 
 Premium customer support 
 Bizzy is easy to set up and requires absolutely no code changes. If you run into any issues, our friendly customer support team is standing by and happy to help!

title: Intuitive Shipping
description:
What is Intuitive Shipping? 
 Intuitive Shipping is an advanced shipping rate calculator for Shopify merchants of all sizes in need of more shipping options than Shopify provides natively. From 4D boxing and per-item exclusions to true wholesale shipping and everything in between, Intuitive Shipping’s extensive range of features gives you full control over how your shipping is calculated at checkout, for predictable profit margins on every order.  
 Why You Should Choose Intuitive Shipping. 
 We understand that shipping is an inherent component of running an online store, and especially in the ultra-competitive ecommerce space, controlling costs is critical to remain viable. Intuitive Shipping has all the features you need to take full control of your store’s shipping calculations. In fact, we are Shopify’s most feature-rich shipping calculation app.  
 Why We are Priced Competitively 
 Shipping calculation is business critical, and we don’t believe in stripping out core features to appear more affordable – our $30/month plan has unlimited everything, including features, vendors, and couriers, all at a price that merchants can afford.  
 Features 
 ACCURATE LIVE RATES | Create custom package sizes and assign dimensions to your products. 

 4D BOXING | Our proprietary 4D boxing algorithm automatically calculates the proper size, weight, and number of boxes for each order, ensuring accurate shipping rates at checkout -no more surprises at the post office! 

 VENDOR RULES | Create unique Conditions and special shipping scenarios for each of your suppliers. Add handling fees, duties, and more.  

 COMBINE RATES | Charge separate shipping costs based on specific vendors, products, conditions, settings, and more, then combine these shipping costs using custom formulas for a single shipping option at checkout. 

 FULLY TAILORED SHIPPING |  Create custom shipping rates that encourage customers to buy, while maintaining your profit margins. 

 RATE CONDITIONS | Fine-tune your rates using over 30 dynamic Conditions, including Vendor, collection, and customer tag. 

 TRUE WHOLESALE SHIPPING | Streamline your wholesale process and exclude wholesale customers from shipping promos, increasing profit margins for these high volume orders. 

 CREATE SHIPPING SUBZONES | Account for varying regional shipping costs by creating subzones based on distance, Postal Code, and Zip Code to ensure profitability wherever your order is shipping to. 
 Talk to Us 
 Please reach out if you have any questions - we're happy to help! 
 Requirements 
 Like all Shopify shipping calculation apps, Intuitive Shipping requires Shopify's Carrier Calculated Rates to be added to the Basic & Shopify plans. You can add this feature to your plan for $0/month by switching to annual billing.

 RSS is an XML based syndication standard used to disseminate a website's information to numerous tools and human readers.

 Automating Social Media and Email Campaigns.

title: Beacon
description:
ENGLISH　|　日本語 
 How does it solve the problem? 
 Beacon is an app built to help Shopify merchants detect and prevent fraudulent orders using SMS, big data, and analytics. These three elements combine to help effectively reduce the amount of chargebacks merchant receives and effectively saving the merchant time and money caused by fraudulent orders.  
 How does your app work with Shopify? 
 A special SMS text verification message is sent out to customers for additional verification. Our SMS system is able to extract additional data points to better and quickly identify bad-actors.  

 
 If a customer fails to verify their mobile number, the chance of a fraudulent order goes up by 50%. 
 

 Beacon works by ingesting customer information like name, phone number, and other data points and attempts to extract new data. 

 
 Beacon is able to instantly identify if the customer has provided a fake phone number when an order is placed. 
 

 The app continuously monitors each order and keeps track of all purchases made by individual customers. 

 
 All IP addresses are constantly logged for each purchase. This helps the merchant to see if there are any anomalies compared to previous historical data. 
 
 How will this change the look of my store? 
 A special verification page is generated when Beacon is installed. This verification page can be found under the template menu with the file name of, "pages.verify.liquid". 
 How do I get started? 
 After installing the app, you will be prompt with a simple welcome screen to set up the app based on merchant business needs. 
 このアプリが解決できる問題とは？ 
 Beacon[ビーコン]はShopifyのショップオーナーの為に、不正受注とチャージバックを防⽌するためのアプリです。
販売者が適切な判断が出来るよう、ビッグデータを利用することで危険性の高い取引を特定します。 
 どのように機能しますか? 
 データを集約し、ビッグデータを活用することで、顧客の基礎的な受注情報から追加情報を抽出します。
顧客情報の有効/無効を、分かりやすいデータテーブルで表示します。 

 顧客が登録したそれぞれのキャリアに対応するショートメッセージ(SMS)または電子メールにメッセージを送信します。
送信するメッセージは弊社が用意するテンプレが利用できます。また、自由に編集することも出来ます。 

 基本的に電話番号を利用した受注は信用性が高いですが、IP電話を利用した受注は信用性が低いです。
販売者が顧客に電話番号を認証してもらいたい際には、Beaconを利用して顧客に認証リンクを添付したSMSを送信することができます。
Beaconアプリのダウンロード時、顧客が認証クリックをする際に必要である認証用ページが自動的に作成されます。 

 SMSを受け取り、一度認証を実行した顧客は緑のチェックマークが表示されます。
Beaconは顧客情報を認証結果によって、「Verified-SyS」タグを利用して整理します。
万が一、顧客にショートメッセージ(SMS)の送信不可や顧客が認証を正常に行わなかった場合には、
Beaconからフォローアップのメールを送信することができます。(認証、または、電話番号の更新を促します。) 

 Beaconは一度のみ、新規顧客に認証を促します。
顧客が以前に、販売者のECサイトから正常に受注をした際には(既存顧客)、2回目の認証を促すことはしません。
また、設定タブから認証された顧客の管理方法を選択できます。(手動、または、自動で管理できる2つの選択肢があります。) 
 どのように始めるのでしょうか？ 
 インストール後、単純なセットアップが表示されます。
ショートメッセージ(SMS)や催促メールなどの設定をカスタマイズすることが可能です。

title: Coming Soon Products Preorders
description:
Create PRE-ORDER products - start selling now, ship products in the future. 
 Create COMING SOON products - products that are unavailable for purchasing until a selected date (product preview pages). 
 Add product availability date and automate product publishing process. 
 

 Join over 300 stores - Start your 7-day free trial!  

 The application offers two product types: 

 
 Pre-Order Product - This option allows your customer to place an order before the product becomes officially available for purchase. The application can display "Available from: MM/DD/YYYY" label on a product page and in a cart view. The "Available from" label can be fully customized. For example, you can change it to "Will dispatch on: MM/DD/YYYY". The application automatically changes "Add to cart" to "Pre Order Now". 
 Coming Soon Product - This type of product will display "Coming Soon" in place of an "Add to Cart" button. It remains unavailable for buying unless you manually change its status or based on a date selection. The application automatically replaces "Add to cart" button with "Coming soon" label. You can optionally add "Available from: MM/DD/YYYY" label and customize it for your needs. The product will automatically become available for purchasing on a selected date. 
 

 By default the application also applies badges to selected products on a collection page.  
 It takes just 10 seconds to install the app. Once the app is installed you just need to search for products and enable one of two product options. Your product pages will be updated automatically. How does it work? 
 
 First create products in a standard way and publish them. 
 In “Coming Soon Products PreOrders” app configure "Coming Soon" or "Pre-Order" feature for selected products. You can optionally select “Available from” date. 
 Once your settings are saved new labels will be added to your product pages: “Coming Soon”, ”Pre-Order Now” and “Available From“ (optional). 
 You can change the default text and styles in "General Settings" tab. 
 The application automatically adds badges to the products on collection pages as well as homepage. You can adjust the styles of badges in application panel. You can also disable them. 
 If you configure “Available from” date for "Coming Soon" products please note that they will automatically become available for purchase on the selected date.

 ¿Why do I need the Antifraud App? 

 All credit and debit card payments have a certain level of risk because the cardholder can dispute the charge and if the business loses the dispute the business must return the money in full. This is known as a chargeback. 

 The chargeback was created by the Bank of Mexico as a protection for cardholders against charges made without their consent. Unfortunately, some card holders misuse this mechanism, or their card is stolen and it is used to perform fraud.  

 Our Antifraud App is designed to protect you from fraudulent buyers and works entirely behind the scenes when your customers make a payment with Conekta.  

 At Conekta we want your company to see as few chargebacks as possible so our antifraud system is constantly looking for suspicious buyers! If the system finds a fraudulent user their transaction will not be processed and the user will be displayed a message that says that their payment could not be processed.

Si el sistema identifica un usuario fraudulento, su pago no será procesado y al usuario se le mostrará un mensaje diciendo que su pago no pudo ser procesado.

title: Script Editor
description:
Note: This app is only available to Shopify Plus customers. 

 Shopify Scripts are customizations written in Ruby that allow you to create personalized customer experiences. Using line item, shipping, and payment scripts you can implement custom logic and tailor the user experience during a customer’s checkout journey.  

 Scripts are enabled on a store’s checkout by using the Script Editor app. Since the app hosts scripts you’ve created on Shopify’s servers, they can affect the cart and checkout at a fundamental level without the need of third-party apps or externally hosted plugins. 

 There are three different types of Shopify Scripts: 

 
 Line item scripts affect line items in the cart and can change prices and grant discounts. Note: Theme modifications may be required to show the discount amount or messages in the cart and/or checkout. 
 Shipping scripts interact with shipping, and can rename, show, hide, or reorder shipping methods and grant discounts on shipping rates. 
 Payment scripts interact with payments, and can rename, show, hide, or reorder payment gateways. 
 

 Write a Shopify Script based on our provided templates, follow our documentation to build your own, or use a script creator solution to get started. Some examples include: 
 Line item scripts 
 
 Percentage (%) or fixed ($) discounts, or a combination of both 
 BOGO discounts with simple or complex logic (buy one get one free, buy two get 10% off, buy four get 20% off) 
 Dynamic pricing for volume-based price breaks 
 Tiered discounts by spending thresholds (quantity or dollar based) 
 Disallow discount codes during a promotion 
 Calculate Value-Added Tax (VAT) for European shoppers 
 
 Shipping scripts 
 
 Modify, hide, or reorder shipping method names and prices 
 Free shipping for VIP or subscription customers

 Moving your existing store to Shopify?

 With Link Manager you can create redirects in bulk to send your customers to the correct page.

title: Facebook Ads Booster
description:
Take advantage of our 14 days FREE trial! 
 Get higher conversion rates by messaging everyone that comments on your ads. 
 Facebook Messenger is a great social media platform for engaging directly with fans and moving them into your sales funnel. This app takes advantage of the fact that Facebook allows you to automate engagement with any fan that has already commented on any of your posts or ads (past or future). 
 Who needs this? 
 
 Are you tired of wasting your Facebook Ads budget? 
 Looking for a way to automate your marketing efforts? 
 Do you want more website clickthroughs from Facebook? 
 Do you want to engage with more fans over Messenger? 
 
 Promote your products and collections 
 Send thousands of automated private messages through Facebook Messenger. This app allows you to automatically start conversations with users that comment on your ads and posts and send them messages containing custom collections of products with photos, titles, prices and links to checkout pages.  
 Promote links, texts and discount codes 
 Customize your messages. You can choose to send any link or text which would be appropriate for a specific ad or post. It's also possible to include discount codes. A great way to give your interested fan an extra incentive to buy! 
 Get more pageviews 
 Facebook Ads Booster will help you get more clicks to your website from Facebook faster than ever. We know your fans are genuinely interested in your products, but sometimes they need to be engaged in a more direct way. 
 Automate your social media engagement 
 Call out your fans and ask them to leave specific comments to see related content. Once they reach out, you get to know who they are, where they're from, and what they click on!  
 So how does it work exactly? 
 You select which of your ads and posts you want to watch. With each ad and post you have the choice of filtering for specific keywords. If a fan comments with one of these keywords, they will be send a text message via Messenger, which you can customize. If the fan responds to this message, they can be sent a follow-up showing a custom collection of products to preview within Messenger. You can also choose to send a link or text. Essentially they can view your products or make purchases directly from Messenger. And it's all automated!  
 What if the user wants to talk to you over Messenger? 
 If a user asks you questions and chats with you, it's up to you to respond. There are no automated responses. Beware, fans that you chat with directly over Messenger have a much higher conversion rate and spend more!

The time it takes to comb through orders looking for high risk customers could be better spent marketing your business or fulfilling orders to legitimate customers.

Just set the dashboard to “Activate” and our app will actively find and cancel any new orders that are marked with High Risk by Shopify. All orders before installation and while the settings are Deactivated will not be affected at all.

title: Happy Feeds ‑ Facebook Catalog
description:
Summary 
 Our app allows you to generate a product feed to import product information into a Facebook Catalog. Catalogs can be used for marketing efforts like dynamic product ads, responding to product views, add to carts, and purchases.  

 Shopify's Facebook pixel integration will allow for 3 key events: ViewContent, AddToCart, and Purchase. Each of these events will pass a product ID, which will be included in your product feed. This will allow you to respond to user events with dynamic product ads that include a product image, title, price, availability, and more. 
 Main Features 
 
 Ability to hide individual products from feed 
 Available mapping of 5 Facebook Custom Labels 
 Product image overrides for custom images in Facebook Catalog 
 Automatic Feed Updates 
 Multiple images for slideshow ads  
 
 Facebook Variables included in feed for each Shopify Variant 
 
 Brand: Brand of Product 
 ID: Variant ID 
 Availability: In Stock/Sold Out 
 Condition: Set to "new" 
 Price: Variant Price, unless "Compare At Price" is set and greater than "Price" 
 Sale Price: If Variant "Compare At Price" is greater than "Price", set to "Price" 
 Link: URL of product/variant 
 Item Group ID: Product ID of variant 
 Product Type: Type of Product  
 MPN: Variant SKU  
 Title: Title of Product - Title of Variant (if variant) 
 Description: Product Content 
 Image Link: URL of product/variant image 
 Additional Image Link: 10 product images in addition to main variant image 
 Shipping Weight: Weight of Variant 
 Custom Labels 0-4: Custom Mapped 
 
 Available Mappings for Custom Labels 0-4 (full documentation available in app) 
 
 Product Handle: The URL friendly handle of the product 
 Product Tags: Product tags in Shopify admin 
 Variant Taxable: Is the product variant set to be taxable? 
 Variant Inventory Level: The amount of inventory left for product variant 
 Variant Requires Shipping: Is product variant set to require shipping? 
 Variant Weight In Grams: The product variant’s set weight in grams 
 Variant Weight in Set Unit: The product variant’s set weight in chosen unit of weight

 Easy customization of the look and feel of the Wishlist+ module

 Smart dashboard providing you metrics and reports of the Wishlist activities on your Shopify store 
 
 Why Swym Wishlist+? 
 Purchase journeys are now carried out over multiple sessions, and likely spanning more than one device/channel. title: Order Invoice GST, VAT
description:
Invoicing Under GST 
 Under GST invoicing rules and formats have been notified covering details such as supplier’s name, shipping and billing address, HSN Code, GST Tax Calculation. 

 As per the new government norms, GST is applied differently for intra-state and inter-state sales. GST levied on the intra-State sales by the Centre is known as Central GST (CGST) and that by the States is known as State GST (SGST). Whereas for inter-state sales, only IGST (Integrated GST) is applied which is directly paid to Central Government. 
 Key Features: 
 
 Ability to upload GST Percentage and HSN codes for all the products in bulk. 
 Ability to show the state codes on invoices. 
 Ability to show the % tag whether its IGST, CGST OR SGST on all invoices. 
 Customer can input their GST details on cart page. 
 Download weekly/monthly SGST, CGST and IGST  tax wise reports. 
 HSN/SAC summary reports. 
 Filter by fulfillment status, financial status 
 Set product prices as including or excluding tax to calculate and display GST.  
 SGST, CGST and IGST are automatically calculated and added to order subtotal. 
 You can bulk download invoices for any particular order even if the order has been created in the past. 
 GST compliant invoices including PDF and emails. 
 

 Let's understand this scenario with an example: If your product price is 1100, GST rate is 10%, minimum product price is 2000 and GST rate for the products below minimum set amount is 5%. As the product price is 1100 which is below minimum set price, GST will be calculated considering GST rate as 5% i.e 55. 

 Set the business origin to auto apply SGST, CGST or IGST based on states of India. 

 Please note that currently it only support invoices for India, UAE, and Saudi Arabia currency supported is INR

description:
Europe Cookie Notice - Get compliant 
 The "Europe Cookie Notice" Shopify App lets you add a notice to your store that informs your customers that your Shopify Store uses cookies. All Shopify Stores use cookies for statistics, basic functionality or even trackers and according to European laws, websites must inform their customers that they are using cookies. Our app helps you fulfill this by allowing you to add a cookie notice bar for European customers (or all customers if you wish). 

 The "Cookie Law" is a legislation passed by all European countries that requires websites to get consent from their customers if they use cookies. Cookies are small files stored in customers browsers that save information about a customer. They are essential to provide basic functionality for modern websites. 

 This App let you be compliant with the "Cookie Law" by letting you add a notice on you store. The App has many customization options, you can set the notice message, the colors, add a link button and even restrict the notice for European customers only.  The important feature of this app to show amount or percentage being saved from the compare price of a product.  

 When merchants want to discount a certain product and display to the customer the amount he is saving by this discount, and the percentage the price is discounted for. 

 Discounts, however, are a powerful tool in the marketing world, since it pulls customer's subconscious strings making them feel in debt towards us as if they got a present from us 

 A good thing about this app is even if your product is a variant type (multiple types of single product) and has a different percentage of offers for different variants then this app will update discount percentage or amount according to the selected variant on the product page.

title: Orderify
description:
Orderify makes your customers happier, makes customer support easier and increases sales. 

 *Completely free for 30 days. Takes a few minutes to set up and try. 
 A Better Customer Experience: 
 
 Trust and Comfort: Most online shoppers check the return/cancellation policy before buying, and shoppers are often willing to keep buying from an online store if they had good experience canceling or returning an order. Customers are more comfortable and become more loyal when they can edit or cancel their orders easily. This is why every major online store (Ex. Amazon) lets customers edit and cancel their own orders. 
 No More Frustration From Order Mistakes: Customers make mistakes when ordering. They often enter the wrong shipping address or want to change items. With Orderify they can easily and cleanly change any part of an order on their own without the frustrating, slow back-and-forth with customer support. 
 
 Easier Customer Support: 
 A frustrating customer service experience and higher customer service response times lead to lower sales and fewer repeat purchases. For stores without Orderify, a top reason customers contact support is to edit/cancel an order. Orderify eliminates this burden, getting customers instant satisfaction and reducing the workload on customer support. 
 Convenient Access from 3 Locations: 
 Orderify lets customers edit/cancel/reorder everywhere they can see an order - the order confirmation/status page, the customer account page and the order confirmation email/SMS. Orderify boosts sales not only by making reordering much easier but by also making the ability to reorder available in all highly visited locations. 
 How does Orderify Work? 
 Once you install, our 10-15 minute, one-time setup will help you add order edit/cancel and reordering to your order status page, your order confirmation email/SMS and your customer account page. 

 
 Order Cancellation: When your customer presses the cancel button, he or she will get a confirmation pop-up. Once the cancellation is confirmed, the order will be canceled and automatically refunded. 
 Order Editing: To give your customer complete flexibility when editing an order, we cancel and refund the original order and reload a shopping cart with all of the items in the original order. That way, your customer has the flexibility to edit payment, shipping and order content information. This also prevents any confusion where orders end up partially edited or edited with mistakes. 
 Reordering: When your customer clicks the reorder link, he or she will be taken to either a checkout or a shopping cart (depending on your settings) that contains all the items from the order for easy reordering.

title: Swiss Post Label Printer
description:
Directly create & print your Swiss Post shipping labels 
 Finally, you are able to print your Swiss Post shipping labels directly in your shop backend. Save time and money – there is no need for copy-pasting addresses or tracking numbers anymore. Your labels are generated in just two clicks! 
 Your benefits at a glance 
 
 Generate Swiss Post labels for your parcels 
 Automatically transfer your shipments via web service to Swiss Post 
 Get your tracking numbers immediately and automatically saved to the customer's order 
 Comfortably print your labels with your A4 or label printer 
 Save a lot of time with your fulfillment 
 
 Easy configuration 
 Install the app, enter your Swiss Post web service credentials and map your (custom) shipping methods with the services that Swiss Post offers. That's it. You can now generate the labels in your shop's backend. 
 Directly connected to Swiss Post 
 Our app is connected to Swiss Post and submits all shipments via web service. The app will hand over your customer's address and desired shipping service(s) to Swiss Post in order for your shipment to be registered correctly. This is how all the big shops in Switzerland operate! Nice side effect: The app immediately receives the tracking number and writes it into the order. 

 No need to copy-paste tracking numbers, addresses, etc... into the Swiss Post website or into a Word file (if you used to work in that way...). 
 Comfortable printing 
 Print your shipping labels in the size you need. You can choose between: 

 
 4 Labels on DIN A4 (perfect for A4 label paper) 
 1 Label on DIN A6 (perfect for printing directly on a label printer) 
 
 Even more comfortable shipping 
 Using our app to ship your parcels makes the shipment process comfortable: Just put the labels on the shipping boxes and bring them to the next Swiss Post counter. No need to wait or even pay directly. This is all done via the web service. Basically, you can just "drop off" your shipping boxes and leave. 
 Swiss Post web service account required 
 Our app talks to Swiss Post via their "Webservices API". In order for this to work, you'll need a Swiss Post web service account. Request yours today for free and start using our app as soon you get the login from Swiss Post. Start saving time to ship more products (or focus on selling more ;))

title: Restockify
description:
Know when you need to reorder 
 This restock app allows you to see which products are likely to sell out and when.  Unlike other inventory notification apps that only tell you when inventory for a product gets below a specified threshold, this app will take into consideration recent sales information to predict when an item will sell out based on how quickly it is selling.  
 Customize your report to fit your needs 
 We know that not all businesses operate in the same way, so it may take you a day to restock your inventory, or it may take 2 months to manufacture, ship, and restock inventory.  That's why this restock app allows you to customize your reorder lead-time so that you are notified when you need to reorder, based on how fast a product is selling and how long it takes you to restock that item. 
 Restock information based on your actual sales history 
 Because this restock app uses historical sales data from your shop, you will be able to see that a certain product is expected to sell out in less than 30 days (as an example), so you can take action to start the reorder process preventing loss of sales that might occur if you sell out. 

 Customize the app to fit your needs in the following ways: 

 
 select how many days lead time you want (how long does it take to reorder, manufacture, restock, etc.) 
 select where you want your report sent 
 

 Based on your selections, you can generate an instant report (for those of us who need to know now!), or receive a report automatically on a daily, weekly, or monthly frequency.  You will then receive a report, which shows all of your products that are expected to sell out before your selected lead-time.  As an example, if you selected a 30 day lead-time, the  app would generate a report that shows all products expected to sell out in 30 days or less based on your history of selling that item.   
 Why do I need this app? 
 It's important to know when your inventory is running low, but knowing that you only have 50 units of a certain product doesn't by itself mean that it's time to reorder; it depends on how quickly you expect to sell those 50 units.  This app takes into account how quickly you are selling each product to estimate when a product will sell out so you can make smart reordering decisions.

title: Outlink
description:
Outlink enables Shopify stores to set up links to external / affiliate products. 
 External / Affiliate Product 
 An example of this would be a product that you link to on Amazon and you receive a commission when your user makes a purchase after clicking that link. They are a great way to make some extra income on your site. 
 Replace Add to Cart with External Link 
 Regular products on Shopify can be converted to affiliate products by replacing the ‘Add to Cart’ button with a link button that redirects the user to affiliate product page. 
 Setting Up External Links with Outlink 
 1 - Outlink allows you to specify an external URL for any product on your store . This will be the affiliate link that lead the customer directly to the outside site. You can enable / disable the external link anytime with a click of a button. 

 2 - You can also specify the text to be displayed on the external link button. So you are not confusing or surprising your customers, you can have the button say something like “Buy On Ebay”. That way they know what is going to happen and you are not misleading them. 

 With Outlink you can add one affiliate product or create an entire affiliate site with thousands of products. You can also sell digital products - apps, music, files, data, software, services, coupons etc. 
 Features 
 
 Fast & Easy – Add external links to any Shopify product in 1-click. 
 Consistent Store UI – For Outlinked products, the ‘Add to cart’ button will be replaced with external link button having the same format. 
 Open in New Tab - External links open in a new tab. Your customers can navigate back to your site once they are done with the other site. 
 Keep 100% of Your Commissions - You keep every penny you earn! We do not have a cut in any of your affiliate links. 
 Raw Affiliate Links - Increase speed and protect your privacy by using the affiliate links provided by the affiliate network. No intermediary redirects or tracking! 
 Bulk Editor - Add or edit Outlinks for multiple products together in a Excel like format or via csv file. 
 Uninstall-proof - Once added, external links will work even if you uninstall the app. 
 Multiple Links - Attach multiple external links to a single product to provide more options to your users, get higher payouts and diversify revenue. 
 Multi-Affiliate Support - With Outlinks you can add external links to any product / affiliate network including, but not limited to, Amazon Associates, Ebay, Aliexpress, Etsy, Clickbank, Rakuten, CJ, ShareaSale, Avangate, Flexoffers, Avantlink, RevenueWire, ReviMedia, AdCombo, AffiBank, Kickbooster, LinkShare, ShopSense, SkimLinks, etc. 
 
 Disclaimer 
 This app is just a tool to help you setup external links on your Shopify website. You need to comply with terms of each of the Affiliate / Reseller Networks that you join.

description:
Product picking and preparation made simple. 
 Logistician 55 automatically tallies the required line items from each of your open orders into a single pick list which can be used for order preparation. 

 The list is interactive and can be sorted and filtered. You can also view a breakdown of the items needed for each order, and keep track of which ones have been picked or manufactured. 

 In addition to the aggregated item list, Logistician 55 provides an overview of your orders, along with their inventory and preparation status. This view can be used to determine which orders are ready for fulfillment, and to generate a pick list that contains the items needed for a specific order or a group of orders. 

 Logistician 55 can be used in many different ways, depending on your specific business, and the process used for preparing and fulfilling your orders. We offer a free trial so that you can evaluate how it will work for you.

Convead is a marketing platform that analyzes customer behavior, reveals sales bottlenecks, and provides tools and recommendations to increase revenue.

Upon entering an offline store, people are instantly approached by a salesperson. Otherwise, they are "just looking". A good salesperson carefully encourages shoppers to make a purchase – finds out their needs, gives personalized recommendations and introduces special offers. If visitors aren't quite ready for the purchase, a salesperson will try to get their contacts to reach out later. Convead is the automatic "salesperson" for your online store, empowered by machine learning technology. title: Spin‑a‑Sale
description:
Spin-a-Sale completely reinvents the standard subscriber pop-up and makes it interactive, fun and irresistible for your visitors. Dramatically grow your email list, generate more sales and increase your conversion rates to levels you've never seen before.  

 With a combination of powerful features and reasonable pricing, Spin-a-Sale is the most popular interactive pop-up on Shopify! 
 How does it work? 
 The Spin-a-Sale overlay displays a special prize wheel for visitors that you can fully configure. When visitors enter their email address, the prize wheel spins and they win a random discount. Spin-a-Sale can be fully customized so you can specify the exact discounts you'd like to provide customers and how often each discount is provided. 

 Spin-a-Sale subscribers are more likely to use their coupon code since the discount is won instead of simply handed out in exchange for their email address. 
 Full Customization 
 Spin-a-Sale gives you full control over all text and colors so you can design it to match your website. Specify the exact prizes your subscribers can win including coupons, free shipping or product giveaways. Easily change the probability settings to control how frequently each prize is awarded to subscribers. 
 Desktop and Mobile Exit Intent 
 Target visitors that appear to be leaving your website with exit intent triggers. Our exit intent technology even works on mobile devices by detecting scrolling. 
 Delay and Clickable Tab Triggers 
 Set the Spin-a-Sale pop-up to appear after your visitors have been on your website for a specific amount of time. Or add a tab icon to your website that visitors can click on to launch the pop-up. 
 Automatic Unique Coupons 
 Provide each subscriber with a completely unique coupon code that can only be used once and can't be reused. This prevents subscribers from being able to share their coupon code online or with friends. You can also set the number of days that each individual coupon code is valid for. This creates a powerful sense of urgency for your subscribers to use their coupon immediately and make a purchase. Spin-a-Sale automatically creates each unique coupon code in your Shopify account for you. You won't find this feature on any other interactive pop-up out there! 
 Fully Responsive 
 Spin-a-Sale is fully responsive so it looks and works great on every desktop, tablet and mobile device. 
 Automated Email Integration 
 Automatically add your new subscribers and their winning coupon coupon code to your MailChimp, AWeber or Klaviyo list. Email your subscribers their winning coupon. 
 Shopify Customer List Integration 
 Automatically add your subscribers to your Shopify customer list. This can be used to automatically add your subscribers to any email service that syncs with Shopify.

title: Upsell & Cross Sell • Upselly
description:
What is Upselly? 
 Upselly is an app that will add a recommended products widget to your product page allowing your customers to add highly related products to their order with just one click. 

 We use the same data mining algorithm that e-commerce giant Amazon use to calculate recommended products - Frequently Bought Together. 
 How does it work? 
 Upselly scans previous purchases in your store through data mining algorithms and produces a graph of products that are usually bought together. 
 How are the recommendations displayed? 
 When a customer visits a product page, a widget comprised of the recommended products usually bought together is displayed. Widget can be set to show above or below Add To Cart form on a product page. 

 In the Upselly widget customers are able to select multiple recommended products with a single click. 

 If the recommended product uses variants, the customer can also select the desired variant; pictures and prices are refreshed automatically. In addition customer can also select quantity for each recommended product. 

 Once customer adds the current product to cart, current product and all selected recommended products are added to the cart. 

 Easier for your customer means more sales for you. 
 Why should I use Upselly? 
 No matter if you're big or small you should be taking advantage of side revenue generated by Upselly. Your customers want to spend money. You just have to show them relevant and personalised recommendations without interrupting the purchase flow - that is exactly why we created Upselly 
 Installation 
 The installation is a 1 click process as well. You install the app by clicking the green GET button on this page and the app is ready and fully installed. 

 After the installation, no further action is required. Zero effort, zero maintenance. 

 Upselly is developed to be mobile-first app. It looks great and works fast on all mobile devices. 
 Configuration options 
 You can change the following options at any time: 

 
 Limit the maximum number of recommended products 
 Select the position of the recommendation widget in the product pages 
 Upselly will even automatically match the color of selected recommended product to your theme's call to action color. You can also fine-tune look and feel of the widget 
 Show random products when there are not enough data for automatic recommendations 
 Show quantity selector 
 Display price and discounted price 
 Manual recommendations: although we recommend automatic recommendations because they lead to higher conversion, you can also fine-tune manually the recommendations for each product 
 
 Free support 
 The app works perfectly out-of-the-box but we also offer stellar support for all your custom needs. Just send us an email and we will do it as soon as possible.

title: Abandon Aid
description:
Imagine this scenario 
 A customer finds a great product in your shop and they have every intention of buying it. When they get to the final checkout page they have second thoughts. Maybe they couldn't find their credit card or had to step away from their computer. This is where Abandon Aid comes into the picture. Without you needing to do anything Abandon Aid will email the customer a short while later reminding them of their order and asking them to come back to complete it. This works really, really well! 
 Why you need this app 
 Abandon Aid will save you time and make you money. A personalized email to prospective customers is highly effective in recovering orders and best when sent in a timely manner. Abandon Aid takes care of all of this for you. 

 Competing abandoned order recovery apps ask you to choose between plans based on how many emails you want to be sent. Abandon Aid always offers unlimited emails for every shop! Competing apps also ask you to set up complicated and confusing "campaigns" in order to start recovering orders. Abandon Aid instead focuses on recovering orders in the simplest and most effective way possible. Recovery statistics are available for the last month of orders.

description:
Appush 
 Appush provides service to send a real native push notification for online merchants who do not provide a mobile app. 
 Problem with web push notification 
 
 There is a struggle whenever new customer visiting our store using Chrome, a popup to request for web push notification. New customer will always choose to 'Block' because they are yet to familiar with the product.
Until they do, the popup has been blocked and most of the new customer will no longer receive a request unless they clear the browser log or change a new mobile phone.
Furthermore, keep popping up whenever customers choose cancel on everypage will annoy them. 
 Merchant must have a website to send web push notification. 
 Customers don't have a proper organizer to manage their web notification subscriptions. 
 
 Solution with Appush real native push notification 
 
 Subscription anytime via QR Code will enable customers to subscribe whenever they feel confident with your products/services. Hence, provide more genuine customers. 
 Beside online, if you has a local store located in the neighborhood, you can always print out your QR Code and let customers to subscribe physically. 
 With Appush mobile app downloaded, customers have an overview on their subscriptions and more organized.

title: Shippit
description:
Ship Like the Big Guys. 
 Multiple delivery options (standard, express or 3-hour), centralised tracking & email/SMS notifications across carriers means you can put the power of big business shipping into your Shopify store in minutes. Shippit’s simplified approach to shipping saves you time, money and removes headaches from the delivery process. 
 Discounted rates with Australia’s leading carriers. 
 Shippit gives you access to enterprise shipping rates so you can finally compete effectively. Get instant access to discounted rates from Fastway, Couriers Please, TNT and DHL. With Shippit on your side, you can forget about negotiating rates, selecting the best carrier or spending hours chasing couriers - we make shipping work harder for your business. 

 Have your own rates? No sweat, connect your own Australia Post, Couriers Please, Fastway, TNT and DHL rates in minutes. 
 Easy to set up and even simpler to use 
 Start shipping your orders in under 7 minutes. Forget credit-checks, setting complex shipping rules or wreaking havoc on your IT set up. Creating an account shipping your first order is so simple you’ll wonder why you didn’t make the switch sooner 
 Lightning-fast shipping rates in your checkout 
 Whether it’s same day, standard or express shipping, tap into the power of our instant rate calculator and get live quotes on available delivery services right in your checkout. 
 Automated order fulfilment & delivery 
 Whether you ship from a bedroom, garage or a state-of-the-art warehouse, you’ll see orders that need to be shipped from the very moment they are placed in your Shopify store. Shippit makes smart packaging allocation decisions and finds the best carrier for the job. Simply confirm the price and get your shipping labels in an instant. Once shipped, Shippit automatically closes out your orders and automatically populates tracking information so you can notify your customers at time of dispatch! 
 Own your delivery experience and cut customer complaints 
 Shippit gives your customers an award-winning delivery experience no matter which carrier you ship with. Forget about consignment numbers and dodgy courier tracking sites, with consistent tracking, automated delay avoidance technology and email / SMS notifications, Shippit gives your customers just the right amount of information, every single time. With our brandied tracking & notifications option, Shippit gives you the power to own your delivery experience from door-to-door.

title: Route4Me
description:
This app integrates Shopify with Route4Me route optimization software. It allows you to instantly send newly created orders to Route4Me. Once orders are imported, they can be edited or turned into route destinations, which makes it easier for you to arrive on time and keep your customers happy. Also, with this app installed, you can review an order’s delivery status directly from your Shopify dashboard.  
 Key Features of the Route4Me App 
 
 Automatically send newly created orders to Route4Me 
 Manually send an order to Route4Me  
 Manually send multiple orders at the same time  
 Built-in geocoder 
 Delivery status lookup from the order details page 
 
 How Route4Me Integration Streamlines Your Operation 
 Whether you receive 10 or 10,000 eCommerce orders a day, you need to fulfill them by making deliveries. Up until now, this would require you to manually copy and paste order data into your route planner.  

 This task could eat up hours of your day. But with the Route4Me app, newly created order data will be instantly sent to your route planner. You’ll have more time to take care of all the others things you need to do to run your business effectively. 

 Alternatively, you can turn off automatic sending and manually send order data from Shopify to Route4Me instead.  

 The Route4Me app also gives you the ability to review an order’s real-time delivery status in Shopify. From the Order Details page, you just need to open the “More actions” drop-down menu and select “View status” to track when the delivery is started and completed.

title: Awesome Facebook Product Feed
description:
Personalise Facebook adverts without manual work 
 Product feed is the basis for dynamic ads and it's no secret that dynamic ads work really well to retarget customers. 
 What are dynamic ads? 
 Facebook dynamic adverts automatically promote products to people who have expressed interest on your website, in your app or elsewhere on the Internet. Simply upload your product catalogue, set up your campaign once and it will continue working to convert customers for you – retaregeting and remarketing to the right people for each product – for as long as you want, and always using up-to-date pricing and availability. 

 Please note: you have to create dynamic ads manually in your Facebook Ads Manager. 
 Why do you need Awesome Facebook Product Feed? 
 Our app automatically builds product feed and automates the process. Set it and forget it.
Awesome Facebook Product Feed app will continue to update your product feed whenever you add new products or change existing. 
 Can I choose which products are included in the product feed? 
 You sure can. The are two options: 

 
 include all products or 
 include products from selected collections. 
 

 See screenshots for details. 
 Can I test it for free, do you offer a free trial? 
 Yes, you can test it for free. We do offer a 7-day free trial. 
 Is Facebook product catalog hard to setup? 
 Not at all - Facebook offers a great tutorial. It's a quick, one-time job.
Also, if need help with setting it up - just email us and we'll be happy to help you. 
 Does it automatically create dynamic ads? 
 No, it does not. You have to create them manually in your Facebook Ads Manager. 
 Does it support Google Product Categories? 
 Yes, it does, by retrieving them from Shopify's Free Google Shopping app. 
 I have a question that wasn't answered here... 
 Email us and we'll be happy to help you.

title: Contactly
description:
Are you social? 
 Most customers today spend their time on social media. Having an active social media account is one of the top ways to gain customers. You can market new products and promotions to them, and it's easy for existing customers to become repeat customers, as well as share with their friends so that you can gain new customers! 

 But with so many social media accounts to access, how can you be sure your clients are able to find you?  Those tiny social icons on your store that get lost in the footer? 

 Contactly is a widget that lets users easily access your contact details from anywhere in your shop.  Beautifully designed and a breeze to setup, Contactly sits in the bottom-right corner of the screen, and immediately begins to provide value to you. 
 Benefits include: 
 
 Giving you the ability to have stellar customer support 
 Gaining new followers on social media, which often leads to new customers 
 Attract existing and new customers by promoting on social and having the peace of mind that your accounts are easily accessible from your shop 
 
 How does it work? 
 Contactly automatically adds a button to the bottom-left corner of your screen to ensure easy access to your contact details and social media accounts. 
 Getting Started 
 To get started, click "Get" and begin adding the links to your account.  Contactly will automatically appear on your site.  You can customize the title, icon, and color to suit your shop's theme.

 The folks at Contactly are on a mission to help small businesses with customer support, which leads to happy customers and more sales.

It used to take an average of 38 days to create a dropship relationship with a retailer. Now it takes seconds. 
 Are you a brand which produces your own products and wants to gain distribution? Do you want to earn higher margins than selling your products wholesale?  

 Modalyst connects brands to a wide distribution network of tens of thousands of retailers. Connect your inventory to Modalyst in just a few clicks. title: EVS Age Verification
description:
Age verification is imperative for all online sales of age restricted products such as tobacco, e-cigarettes, wine and spirits.  States such as Texas and Massachusetts have already passed regulations mandating that online retailers selling age restricted products verify consumer information against consumer databases to ensure that consumers are of legal age to purchase their products.  Self-certification of age (e.g. having a consumer click a button or submit their age or date of birth) is not sufficient to maintain compliance with these regulations. 

 The EVS Age Verification App automated integration with IdentiFraud Consumer+ to allow for true age verification to meet compliance requirements within Shopify.  The app will perform the following functions within your Shopify Store: 

 
 Adds a birthdate field to the registration form 
 Creates a new set of integration credentials within the IdentiFlo Management Platform 
 Performs an IdentiFraud Consumer+ transaction each time a new customer places their first order 
 Tags the customer as verified for each successful verification 
 Tags any order from a customer that could not be verified as needing manual verification
The verification process is performed in the background, allowing you to maintain compliance without impacting the checkout process for your customers.  Transaction history is stored within the IdentiFlo Management Platform, ensuring that you always have an audit trail to prove your compliance with age verification regulations. 
 

 EVS provides some of the lowest age verification transaction rates in the industry, no set-up fees, a nominal monthly system access fee and no minimums for transaction volume. Our focus on long-term client relationships allows us to provide these lower costs without sacrificing product quality, maintaining our high standards for data precision, security, and customer experience.

title: Sky Watcher
description:
Increase your sales with real-time social proof, for free! 
 Sky watcher gives you the power to increase purchases through social proof and scarcity.
Simply install the app, customise your design to suit your store and you'll be up and running in seconds! 
 The magic of Sky Watcher 
 Here's how it works 

 The app will keep an eye on your real time stats for each individual product on your site. Then, to show social proof, it will display a simple alert just beneath your add to cart button! 

 You might have seen this type of feature on booking.com or other big retail brands. Why? Because it works! 

 If 10 other people are looking at a product at the same time as you, your brain instantly connects the dots and tells you that this is a trustworthy product that you might miss out on if you take your time shopping around. 
 FAQ 
 Can I customize my design? 

 
 You sure can. We give you a powerful design editor on your dashboard to give you complete control of your design. 
 

 You'll be able to edit,
* Text Color
* Background Color
* Container Padding
* Border
* Border Color
* Border Style
* Alert Wording 

 My site doesn't get many views, will it appear when there is only one person on my website?
* We give you complete control over when your message shows. Simply update the minimum viewers that will trigger your alert. 

 Are the stats actually real-time?
* Yes they are. All "real time" stats are actually real time! You can of course change that if you want 

 Is the app actually free?
* Yep. Completely free, forever 

 
 Nothing! Get started now!

title: Wanelo
description:
Sell in Wanelo’s marketplace and get discovered by millions of active shoppers! 
 The Wanelo Sales Channel was built to help Shopify merchants reach new customers, build a following and grow their businesses. By installing the sales channel, you are applying to sell your products directly on Wanelo, so that millions of shoppers can discover and buy your products with just a tap. 
 What is Wanelo? 
 Wanelo (“wah-nee-loh,” from Want, Need, Love) is a social marketplace bringing together 800K stores and 50M products, all shoppable from one place. For shoppers, it’s a way to discover and buy products from stores both big and small. For merchants, Wanelo is a place to market and sell your products to millions of users who come to do nothing but shop. 
 How does the Wanelo Sales Channel work? 
 
 At this time, the Wanelo Sales Channel is only available to sellers with a US social security number 
 Installing the Wanelo Sales Channel places your store on the waitlist to sell in Wanelo's marketplace 
 While your application is under review, Wanelo syncs with your Shopify inventory to automatically import your products to your own Wanelo storefront 
 If your application is accepted, your store will be notified and your products will be made available for direct purchase in Wanelo's marketplace 
 Any order placed on Wanelo is sent straight to your Shopify dashboard to be fulfilled 
 
 What else do sellers in Wanelo's marketplace need to know? 
 
 All stores are subject to approval. Please read our prohibited products on Wanelo before installing. Any stores with prohibited products will be denied. 
 Orders placed on Wanelo must be fulfilled within 5 days and tracking numbers are required 
 Orders must be confirmed as shipped by a Wanelo supported carrier to qualify for payment 
 Your store’s email address, location and policies for shipping, returns and exchanges must be visible on your website 
 At this time, Wanelo supports a single shipping rate per store and cannot support customized products if they require customer input at the time of order 
 At this time, Wanelo only processes payment to US Bank accounts.
If you do not have a US Bank Account, you can register to receive payment through Payoneer here
