description:
What is FBA Shipping by ByteStand? 
 
 Connect your US & non-US Amazon FBA account to your Shopify store 
 Simple automatic mutli-channel Amazon FBA fulfillment everywhere 
 Provide real time shipping quotes from Amazon FBA to your customers 
 

 FBA Shipping connects your US & non-US FBA account with your Shopify store, allowing you to finally leverage the power of Amazon FBA around the world. Once setup your orders can automagically be sent to and fulfilled by Amazon FBA. Through the power of the internets we automatically pull in shipping status updates and tracking numbers. The app pulls in updates every 5 minutes, and automatically emails your customer when their item ships. With FBA Shipping never worry about shipping or customer updates again. 
 Why? 
 We've sold on Amazon for years, and used FBA to fulfill all our orders. It's been fantastic! We created FBA Shipping so that users outside of the United States can enjoy the same convenience, cost saving, and shipping abilities that we've enjoyed in the US for years. 
 How does it work? 
 Using the customers shipping information, cart data and your Amazon seller account, we send really REALLY fast carrier pigeons(or the Amazon API) out to Amazon. Once there, they pick up all the fees Amazon is deciding to charge then turn around and provide these to you. We then look at the settings within your account to provide the final fees to your customers. 

 Our app is embedded in the admin section of your store, works through Shopify, and if you type fast, can be setup in less than one minute.To get setup we just need a few identifying pieces of information from your Amazon account, plus your shipping rules and you're done.

Why?

We've sold on Amazon for years, and used FBA to fulfill all our orders. It's been fantastic! We created FBA Shipping so that users outside of the United States can enjoy the same convenience, cost saving, and shipping abilities that we've enjoyed in the US for years.

How does it work?

Using the customers shipping information, cart data and your Amazon seller account, we send really REALLY fast carrier pigeons(or the Amazon API) out to Amazon. Once there, they pick up all the fees Amazon is deciding to charge then turn around and provide these to you. We then look at the settings within your account to provide the final fees to your customers.

Our app is embedded in the admin section of your store, works through Shopify, and if you type fast, can be setup in less than one minute.To get setup we just need a few identifying pieces of information from your Amazon account, plus your shipping rules and you're done.

description:
Never worry again about needing to set products on sale one variant at a time! With Sale - All in one, you can set up sales that will automatically update your products when and how you want. 
 Automatically put products on sale on selected dates fast and easy 
 Tired of the stress when it’s sale time? With the Sale All In One App you choose what group of products or collections should be on sale and for how long. Everything happens automatically, and the days are over when you had to put products on sale one by one.  Not only will Sale All In One save you time, but you can also rest assured that your sale is starting and stopping at the exact time you want it to. 
 Sale options 
 You can choose and customize three different kinds of sale :
1.  Percentage discount (for example a 10% off sale)
2.  Fixed amount discount (for example a $5.00 off sale)
3.  Fixed price sale (for example all products are $10.00) 

 You can have multiple sales going on at the same time and easily switch between the options. 
 Prioritize your sales 
 When you have multiple sales going on, you can customize the priority, if a product is represented in more than one sale. Let’s say you want everything in the store to be 10% off, but you want your Frontpage collection to be a fixed amount of $5.00. Then you just set the Frontpage sale to be a higher priority, and the sale with the highest priority gets applied to the product. 
 Features 
 
 Create a percentage discount, fixed amount discount or fixed price 
 Choose exactly what should be on sale 
 Works on all collections both Smart and Custom Collection 
 You choose the start date and the end date of your sale 
 Prioritize sales so that you always get the right product at the right price 
 Perfect for sales like Black Friday or Cyber Monday. Just set and forget.

title: Hindsight
description:
Record and evaluate every visitor’s journey through your site so you can improve their experience and increase sales. 
 Analyse user experience on a macro level by heat-mapping clicks, movements, hovers and  scrolls. 
 No liquid installation: get up and running in minutes. 
 

 You know that your site’s getting visits, but what do these visits really mean for your business? What causes users to make it through the purchase process and what causes them to drop off?
Hindsight allows you to see exactly how your users interact with every element of your site, both individually, through visitor recordings, and on a macro level with heat mapping.
Hindsight helps you to refine your structure and design, weed out sticking points, implement the most effective cross-sells, put your most important products in the line of site and, most importantly, maximise your conversions and increase sales. 

 Key features and benefits: 

 
 Heat mapping 
 Explore a set of heat maps of every page in your store to gain a range of useful insights into your users’ journeys and understand how to improve them. 
 Toggle between mapping clicks, mouse movements, scrolls, or an aggregate of the three. Understand both what your users get to see and the elements to which they are most drawn. 
 Analyse every single click: see click totals/rates, hover totals/rates, hover->click rate; hover time and more. 
 Map any date range. 
 View key statistics including: average visit time for the page, average active engagement time, average scroll distance and total number of clicks across the recordings. 
 Customise the look of your heat map with opacity and intensity controls. 
 Visitor Recording 
 Record and play back your users’ visits to see exactly how they interact with your site. 
 Set what proportion of journeys are recorded. 
 See a recorded visitor’s location, referrer, entry page, visit duration and browsing device. 
 Filter recordings by any date range. 
 Change playback speed; skip between recordings of each page. 
 Store recordings for a month. 
 Intuitive Dashboard 
 View at a glance analytics: latest recording totals and most recent recorded visits. 
 Easily update your plan, set your recording rate, exclude IP addresses and switch recording on or off. 
 Never leave your Shopify admin panel. 
 Instant setup
No liquid setup required. Click install, choose a plan and you’re good to go!

title: Cooki
description:
Make sure your store is fully compliant with GDPR 
 Take the hassle out of becoming GDPR compliant and ensure you're ready in minutes by installing Cooki. 
 What is GDPR? 
 The General Data Protection Regulation is a piece of EU legislation passed by the European Parliament in 2016. It is enforceable in all EU countries since May 25, 2018. The GDPR aims to make it simpler for people to control how companies use their personal details. 

 Strict new rules mean companies are not allowed to collect and use personal information without the person's consent. Data includes things like a person's name, email address and phone number, and also internet browsing habits collected by website cookies.  
 Who needs to be compliant with GDPR? 
 Stores based in the EU, as well as stores not located in the EU, if they offer free or paid goods to EU residents. 

 Cooki doesn't cover compliance for the Shopify platform itself but we are here to fill the gap. We do however support our partner apps. 
 Features 
 
 Fully customisable cookie acceptance banner. 
 Easy GDPR compliant privacy-policy generator. 
 Simple API that could be used by other apps you use that do on-site tracking to check whether the visitor / customer has declined consent. 
 We also log the consent for you. So if you ever had to prove someone's consent, you can do so. You will need to contact us at the moment to get a that but it will be available from your dashboard soon. 
 One click install.

title: Collection Additional Fields
description:
What is a collection in a shopify store? 
 
 A custom collection is a grouping of products that a shop owner can create to make their shops easier to browse. 
 A shop owner creates a custom collection and then selects the products that will go into it. 
 Custom collections are typically displayed to customers so that customers can select them to view only the products in the collection they've selected.  
 They're typically used to break down a catalog of products into categories to make the shop easier to browse. 
 Shopify shops start with a single custom collection called frontpage — the collection of products shown on the shop's front page. 
 
 Can I add different meta form field values for different collections? 
 
 Yes, There is a setting called collection list, which lists all collections of your store. You can choose collection from this list and set different meta field values for each collection. 
 
 Can I disable showing meta fields for some collections? 
 
 Yes, if you haven't set the meta fields value for a collection, meta fields will not be shown for that collection in store. 
 
 If I add additional fields using add fields settings, do I have to paste the shortcode for each of the field added? 
 
 Yes, once you create a new field, it will be required to add its shortcode in collection.liquid file, otherwise that field will not be shown in the store. 
 
 Features 
 
 Add as many form fields, as you wish 
 Each form field can have a different value collection-wise 
 Easy to configure and use 
 No coding required, Fully manage by admin panel 
 Display your custom meta fields as a Textbox, Text-area, Video, Image file, Dropdown, Radio button, Checkbox, Multiple Select, Date, Time, Date & Time in the Collection page.

title: Ship•Systems 3D Box Packing
description:
Stop losing money 
 Dimensional weights can have a HUGE impact on your shipping costs. 

 Pack your eCommerce shipments in 3D to control your shipping expenses and protect your profit margins. 
 Real-Time Rates 
 
 USPS 
 Canada Post 
 UPS 
 Purolator 
 And more to come! 
 
 Custom Carrier Rules 
 
 Per box pricing 
 Maximum shipping charges 
 Geographic restrictions 
 

 Shipping costs used to be charged by weight. The heavier the parcel was, the more expensive the shipping. Today, most carriers apply a dimensional weight or volumetric weight formula and charge you the highest price between the real package size and the calculated one. Using only weight to get shipping rates results in inaccurate pricing. 

 Ship•Systems uses real product and box dimensions to find the smallest box or boxes your customer orders will fit in. Then it gets live shipping rates based on the final dimensions and weight of that packed order. Your customers will see the real rates and choose the one they want, shouldering 100% of the real cost of shipping. They get the items they want at the real price and you protect your profit margins, allowing you to grow faster and reinvest in your business. 
 How it works 
 
 Pack the largest items first. 
 Pack vertically up the side of the box. 
 Pack side-by-side when the item fits beside the previous one. 
 Allow only very small overhangs to prevent damage in transit. 
 Distribute weight evenly between boxes when more than one is needed. 
 

 Ship•Systems will show you how to pack the final order in 3D right in your browser or integrated app. With full Shopify integration, you never need to leave your store's admin area to get the packing instructions. 

 Ship•Systems requires the Shopify Carrier Service API for real-time cart calculations. The Carrier Service is included in the Shopify Advanced plan and up or on the Basic plan with Annual Payments.

 How do Triggered Emails Work? 
 An automated email marketing campaign is when an email is automatically sent to a customer when they qualify for it. Examples of these could be a Happy Birthday Email, an Abandoned cart email, A Feedback request etc. These emails ensure that there's constant communication with customers and aim to build a relationship with those customers.

description:
Your webshop orders effortlessly in Offective 
 This App connects your Shopify webshop to your Offective administration. Your orders will be transferred automatically to Offective, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Save time and avoid errors. No more double data entry! 
 Keep it straight and simple 
 Do you want to keep everything straight and simple?
Transfer your Shopify orders to Offective orders. This connection is a real-time connection. You indicate when a Shopify order is transferred: When it is created, paid of partly paid. 

 It is important that the correct price-details and customer-details are transferred. This a list of the most important parameters that are transferred. A full detailed service description in Dutch language is available. 

 
 Order-details:
The order-specifics, like order number and order date are transferred. The ordernumber of the webshop order is displayed in the reference field. Of course, the order lines are transferred. Per order line the line-price and tax code are transferred. 
 Customer-details:
The full customer details like email address, name, company, address, telephone number etc are transferred. Through the email address it is verified whether the customer is already present. If so, the customer-details are adapted. 
 Product-details:
If you transfer Shopify orders to Offective, the products in the order are added to Offective. The first check is whether the product already exists in Offective. Matching is done on SKU in Shopify and article code in Offective. If the product is not yet available, it is added. The name of the product, the article code, price and VAT is added.

description:
The Fastest & Most Cost Effective Way to Launch a Beauty Store 
 Holding the inventory for all the popular lengths, styles, and origins of hair extensions can cost tens of thousands of dollars. Get instant access to over a million dollars in inventory with our Dropship Beauty system! 

 All orders are processed at our Atlanta location for accurate and lightning fast shipping. We generally ship 99% of all orders placed before 2 pm ET the same day with packages arriving in just 1 - 3 days with standard shipping. Step it up with Express shipping with 1 - 2 day delivery times. 

 
 Please Note - We are currently only dropshipping to addresses in the USA. 
 

 Our catalog of products continues to grow with Hair Extensions, Wigs, 3D Lashes, Edge Control, and more! 
 How does Dropship Beauty work? 
 
 When an order is made in your store with a Dropship Beauty Product, it's directly sent to us.  
 Our team will pack & ship your order (custom branding available) and the tracking information will automatically be sent to your store.  
 Your store will then update your customer with the tracking information.

 Choose your desired retail price markup and start importing products into your store. 
 Advanced & Pro accounts allow you to use custom branding items that you can purchase from us or send in approved items like hang tags, care instructions, and more! 
 Add your credit card for easy ordering. Batch processing is available to quickly process multiple orders at once!

 Ability to set your own profits. You pay the wholesale dropship price and you set your own retail price and profits! 
 Access to all types of hair extensions from less expensive to the finest raw hair from the temples in India.  
 Matching closures & frontals to match the bundles to perfection. 
 Thirty 3D Lash styles. 
 Fast shipping with Priority & Express options.  
 Access to professional product photos. 
 Product videos that can be embedded in your site or used for marketing.

description:
Introduction 
 Proffer is a discounting app that allows store owners to effortlessly run all kinds of promotions. Promote your offers and discounts with the help of elegant sales banners, discount tables and offer labels that your customers can’t miss. Automate your offers by easily scheduling them so that you have more time to focus on taking your product to the next level. 
 List of Features 1. Quantity Breaks 
 The more you buy, the more you save! Quantity Break discounts allow you to create pricing tiers based on the number of products purchased. Select and apply discounts to product variants, individual products or a mix of products and collections. You can set a fixed price/percentage discount with an attractive discount table that helps drive more sales. 

 Examples: 

 
 Buy 2 items, get 10% off 
 Buy 3 items, get 15% off 
 Buy 4 items, get 20% off 
 
 2. Buy X get Y 
 Motivate the customers to buy more by suggesting other products with fixed/percentage discounts. Automatically discounts the lowest priced products. 

 Examples: 

 
 BOGO(Buy one, get one) discounts. 
 Buy a black tie and get a peach skirt at 10% off. 
 Buy 2, get 1 free. 
 Buy 4, and get 2 at $50 off. 
 
 3. Spend Tiers 
 Offer a fixed price/percentage discount when your customer spends a certain amount in your store. You also have the option to create discounts in tiers based on the amount spent on the store. 

 Example: 

 
 Buy items worth $100 and get 10% off. 
 Buy items worth $200 and get 20% off. 
 
 4. Bundle Discount 
 Buy X for $. Set bundle price discount for a selected range of products/collections or a single product with a fixed price/percentage discounts.  

 Example: 

 
 Buy any 2 products from the list of products on discount, to avail a total discount of 10% 
 Buy any 4 products from the list of products on discount, to avail a total discount of 20% 
 
 5. General Discount 
 Offer a fixed price/percentage discount on any product or collection of your choice and set a limit to the number of times a user can avail the offer. 
 6. Cross-sell and Upsell 
 Up-sell and Cross-sell that you’ll actually love. Power up your game by combining this with other offers too! Up-sell and cross-sell by showing your customers, products that will get them further discounts on purchase. 
 Common Features Language Translation 
 Get entire context changed to the suitable language. 
 Custom Styles 
 Personalize the look and feel of the offers to match your store’s theme! Style your sales banners, discount tables and offer labels from our customization panel without having to touch any code! 
 Schedule Offers 
 Alleviate costs and time conflicts during promotions with automated scheduling. Keep track of all current offers and schedule them in advance for your customers. Deals are scheduled as per Shopify's time zone.

title: Sold Out!
description:
Sold Out! 
 As your store does better and better in e-commerce, the quality of your problems is going to increase. This app is built to deal with the high quality problem of your products selling out. If you are getting sales, then this app will be critically important for your store. 

 The moment any item on your store sells out, it will be hidden, and you will be notified so that you can replace the stock as quickly as possible and therefore keep giving your customers the product they want. Alternatively, it serves to remove items from your store when they sell out so that prospective customers cannot see them - this could be a discontinued exclusive model of an item, but all of this plays up and adds to a Premium & Luxury brand experience for your customers. 

 The app will run 24 hours a day 365 days a year so that you never have to worry about not having an Internet connection and your Sold Out products being visible on your store, and can relax knowing that your store will essentially manage itself. 
 Ease of Use 
 Sold Out! takes less than a minute to install and involves one click. No coding is required. You will see all the Sold Out products on your store on the app dashboard, and you can toggle whether they are hidden or not. You can also receive Push Notifications and Email notifications if you want to, so that there is no way you will not know when a product is sold out. 
 Key Benefits 
 
 Boost customer satisfaction with greater "popular product uptime"

title: Product Image Gallery & zoom
description:
The way you present images on a product page matters. It needs to be easy to use, interactive and mobile-friendly. Your visitors will focus on images before they start reading product description. Make your images look professional with our application.  
 How does it work? - GALLERY, SLIDER & CAROUSEL 
 The application automatically replaces your existing image section on a product page with one of the following options (based on your selection):
*Image Gallery - large image with thumbnails displayed beneath
*Image Slider - large image with arrows (previous/next)
*Image Carousel - Images rotate in a 3D circle 
 Instead of loading all product images, your product page can load and display only the images of a variant selected by your customer. Variant images can be configured on a "Manage Variant Images" page of the application. 
 No coding required. Simply install the app and visit any of your product pages to see it in action. The configurable options have been described below. If you need help with configuration our support team is available 24/7 to assist you. 
 FEATURES: Resize section containing images 
 You can resize the section containing images or even make it use 100% width of your website. Simply access the application and navigate to "Configuration" page. Scroll down to an option called "Resize image section by". By default it's value is set to "0" which means that it's configured to use a default size. You can increase or decrease the size by percentage value. In order to display large product images at the top of a product page change the option "Use full page width" to "Yes".  
 Responsive (mobile-friendly) gallery 
 Interactive images work with all types of mobile phones and tablets. Let your customers browse image galleries with a use of touch screen. All elements of our user interface are mobile-friendly.  
 Animation effects 
 The application offers elegant animated transitions on image change. Professional feel and look help to improve user experience and build customer trust. 
 High quality images 
 The application optimizes images displayed to your visitors in order to serve high quality content and reduce loading time.  
 Add videos together with product images 
 Images and videos can be displayed in a the same section 
 Display variant-specific images 
 Would you like your customers to see the actual images that represent a selected product option instead of all images? Our app allows you to assign multiple images to a product variant and show/hide relevant images on the product page based on a variant selection. The image variants can be assigned based on multiple product options. 
 Auto-rotate photos 
 Enable "autorotate" option and images will change automatically every 3 seconds (configurable).  
 All elements of the user interface are fully configurable.

title: Refericon
description:
How does Refericon work? 
 After installing the app the icon engaging customers to recommend your shop appears. The icon can take any graphic form and it can be placed in one of the four corners so as to it does not interfere with e.g. chat.  
 What happens when a customer clicks the icon? 
 A customer will see a picture of a given product, on a subpage of which he or she is, and a description previously prepared by your stuff in the application. The content of the window aims to engage a customer to recommend your shop to their friends. In return, a customer will get a discount or a different prize, e.g. free delivery. 
 A customer can refer a shop in different ways 
 
 using their friend's email address 
 share the information on their wall or in Facebook group 
 send private message on Facebook 
 copy referral link for their friends
The application allocates prizes automatically on the basis of previously set settings in the panel of the application. You can decide if a customer can use all of the options of recommendation or only selected ones. 
 
 Subscribing to the newsletter 
 After recommendingo your shop, a client can subscribe to the newsletter. Question about consent will appear in the window of the application. Subscribing is not obligatory. 

 Gaining email addresses works in accordance with GDPR. In the panel of the application administrator you get the access to gained addresses. You can download them in txt format or do it automatically using the integration. 
 The message with the recommendation 
 A receiver of the message will get an email with the content prepared by you in the panel of the application. You can enter any topic and body, and use HTML elements. In the message, a customer can find a discount code or a link redirecting them to your shop. After being redirected, the code will be displayed above the content of the website. 
 EFFECTIVENESS OF THE APPLICATION 
 The number of the gained clients depends on many different circumstances, such as industry, promotion policy or size of a shop. 
 FAQ 
 
 Can I test applications for free? 
 

 Yes, the first 14 days are 100% free! 

 
 What is the later cost of the application? 
 

 It depends on the number of referrals sent.
from 0 to 100 - 9 $ 

 From 101 to 300 - 25 $ 

 From 301 to 1000 - $ 89 

 
 Is the application compatible with the GDPR? 
 

 Yes.  

 
 Can I upload my own icon? 
 

 Yes, the recommended graphic file is 128 by 128 pixels. 

 
 How can I check the results of the campaign? 
 

 You can find the information about how many times the icon has been displayed, the number of clicks and the number of the sent referral e-mails in statistics Panel. You can monitor the conversion tanks to the used coupons.

      GetResponse,
     
     
      Hubspot,
     
     
      Salesmanago

title: Bundle Builder by Agile
description:
Increase your sales and average order revenue with bundles. 
 Make the most of your Black Friday/Cyber Monday sales with Bundle Builder. Create full page bundles using your existing products and apply fixed or percentage discounts for your customers. As of October 2018, over $2,300,000 of products have been sold by Shopify merchants using Bundle Builder. Join the merchants selling more today! 
 Build. Better. Bundles. 
 Bundle Builder allows store owners to create groups of products or variants, which customers can choose from to create unique bundles, gift boxes or product kits. Fixed price or percentage discounts, and minimums and maximums can be attached to each bundle as required. After purchase, the inventory from each product within the bundle is removed from the store's inventory (and reversed if an order is cancelled). 
 How does it work? 
 It's a simple one-click install - there's no coding required. You can create your first bundle in minutes with 3 easy steps: 
1. Set up the bundle 
2. Choose your products
3. Apply your discounts and limits 

 Once you have completed the settings for your bundle, Bundle Builder creates a 'ghost' product in your Shopify store. This is the bundle page. Once on the bundle page, customers select their products, before adding the bundle to their cart. 

 All product images, variants and stock are updated live, and once a purchase is complete, the inventory is removed from all of the products in the bundle automatically. 

 Having a bundle product page allows you to share the 'product' in newsletters and on social media.  
 Installation. 
 Installation is automatic. There is no code to change. Just open the app in your store and you're ready to get started creating bundles.  
 Fully Customisable. 
 There are options for changing the visuals of the app, to ensure it seamlessly integrates into your store. 
 Single, or multi-page bundles. 
 You can create single page bundles or multi-page 'sectioned' bundles, allowing you to separate your products into different sections. This could be especially useful for building bundles that fall into different categories, allowing the user to 'build' a product, such as a suit, or a custom product. 
 Discounts and limits. 
 You can add fixed price or percentage discounts and combine these with product limits, and minimums and maximums for each bundle.  
 Product tracking. 
 The app provides the option to create a unique SKU for the bundle product. Customer's bundle contents information (including product names, variant types, SKUs) is also transferable via the Shopify admin API - this is especially useful for 3rd party fulfilment apps/systems where bundle contents data needs to be received.  
 Translation. 
 The app is easily translated into any language using text input fields in the Settings area of the app.

title: Turing product recommendations
description:
Visually Similar Product Recommendations 
 For product categories that are highly visual in nature (like fashion, furniture, kitchenware etc.), product descriptions and purchase history are insufficient to make appropriate suggestions to customers. Products in these categories have aesthetic elements like pattern, shape, color and texture at the core of every purchase decisions that are difficult to put into words.  
 How does it work? 
 The visually similar product recommendation engine works like a virtual shop assistant by highlighting products which “look similar” to what a customer is interested in. It helps you suggest products with similar pattern, shape and color from your inventory. The AI powering this plugin only considers the product image to recommend similar products in popularity agnostic manner. 
 One-Click-Installation 
 
 Click the get button 
 Our dashboard shows image indexing progress 
 Widget goes live as “Similar products” on your store 
 
 Simple plug and play Integration 
 
 No technical knowledge required 
 Plugin automatically starts indexing your inventory in the background without any button clicks. It takes a few minutes for small stores and less than 3 hours for stores with 25,000 products 
 Widget goes live as soon as the indexing is done 
 
 Who should use this plugin? 
 Stores that sell Fashion (Apparel, Footwear, Jewelry, bags, eyewear etc.) and Home & Lifestyle (Furniture, Decor, Kitchenware, Appliances etc.) products. 
 Benefits 1. Increase catalog discovery 
 With other recommendations plugin, only the popular products from the inventory are exposed to customers. As top selling products are recommended again and again. With Image based recommendations, the whole catalog becomes open for discovery. 
 2. Cross-sell 
 It is an excellent cross-selling tool that suggests similar products in case the desired product is out of stock 
 3. Convert customers faster 
 By showing almost similar suggestions, it reduces search time for customers to find the desired product leading to better conversions 
 4. 100% responsive & Mobile-friendly 
 Adapts its size and layout to the screen and supports touch gestures for easy product navigation. Freely design our recommendations widget to match your store’s theme 
 5. Supports all languages and currency Pricing 
 Our pricing is simple and cost-effective aimed at helping your shop grow and succeed. We charge fixed monthly fees based on your inventory size.

title: Metafields2
description:
Add extra data fields to your data, using Shopify metafields 
 Did you know you can add extra data fields to nearly every resource in your Shopify store? It's true. Shopify has a somewhat obscure feature they call metafields (not the same as meta tags) which is typically only available to developers thru the Shopify API. The Metafields2 application now provides you the ability to add, manage, import, and export extra fields for nearly everything — the shop itself, collections, products, product variants, customers, orders, blogs, articles & pages! 

 The app installs like any other app and adds context-aware links within your Shopify dashboard to the app where you can create and manage all of your extra fields. The app also provides full import/export capability via CSV files similar to the way you can import products and/or customers now in your dashboard. 

 Affiliates of sineLABS receive this app for free. Contact us for details at our support email address. 

 
 # New Feature!
Writable customer metafields! With a bit of custom code in your theme, you can now update customer metafields from the front end of your shop. This means you can ask the customer for their preferences, measurements, birthday, or any thing else you'd like to gather and store them in metafields you configure using our app. If you have the coding capabilities to customize html, css, and javascript in your theme and want to utilize this new feature, we can provide you with helpful tips and example code to get you going! 
 # Important Note
This is NOT an 'SEO' app enabling meta tags. Although the name metafields might make you think of 'meta tags' at first, the resemblance is entirely coincidental. Its name is simply the same name Shopify gives this 'extra fields' feature via their API (http://docs.shopify.com/api/metafield). With that said, you can certainly use this app for meta tags or any other 'extra' data you want to attach to Shopify resources for SEO purposes, but its utility is much, much broader and the use cases are really limitless. 
 # Important Note
This app will allow you to create, manage, and add data to metafields in your store but makes no changes to your themes or templates on your behalf. To put the metafields you create to use in your themes, you will need to do so manually, they will not automatically display or trigger any special functionality for your store. For reference, search online for Shopify blog articles and their online documentation for metafields to better understand them.

description:

 New visitors to your website are not aware of the popular products of your store. They get confused easily by a range of products and tend to leave the site without buying anything. The best way to recommend products to them is to use 'wisdom of crowd' i.e. show them what other users are buying the most.  
 How it works: 
 The app automatically captures and displays a trending products gallery to  enable popular product discovery and rapid conversion. The app finds top 10 selling products of your store in last few months and randomly displays them in the gallery. It keeps on updating the trending products recommendations every day.  
 One click Installation: 
 The app is very easy to install and use. It is just a one click installation. Any store-owner can install and run this app without the help of a developer. 
 Why you should install: 
 Unlike other apps, we have a unique feature to display manual recommendations as well. If you wish to display new product or a less popular product of your store, which you feel is trending in the market, just add a tag 'mlvedatrending' to that product and the product will start getting displayed in the 'Trending Now Recommendations'.

The Royal Mail Shipping Extension app enables you to offer real time shipping prices to your customers during the checkout process.  

 When a customer goes to complete their purchase, they are offered different shipping services based on products weight and location. They choose the desired service, and the price is added to the total of the order. Simple! 

 The application:
* Calculates prices based on the weight of your product, and the shipping address of the customer. 
* Provide real time prices to your customers.
* Offer all of the services that Royal Mail offer, including Special Delivery, 1st and 2nd Class (Recorded), International Tracked, International Signed & more.
* You can re-name the standard Royal Mail Services to any text you want.
* Allow customers to choose their shipping option when purchasing from your store. 

 Please note you need a Shopify plan with carrier calculated carrier shipping for this app to work.  If your plan does not have this, please contact Shopify Support who can add it for you.

title: Knowband ‑ Exit Popup
description:
Exit Popup App 

 Exit Popup App provides the Shopify stores with the functionality to show a subscription popup with attractive offers whenever the user tries to exit the website. The look and feel of the pop up are fully customizable. The store can even update the text displayed in the exit pop-up. The store visitors need to enter their email ids in order to get the discount coupons. The store owner has total control over the offers displayed in the popup. 

 Which functionalities are controlled by Website admin? 
1. Admin can edit and personalize the popup title.
2. Admin can provide both detailed and short description of the discount being offered in the popup.
3. Admin can choose to register the user using the provided email id.
4. Admin can change the look and feel of the popup using different colors & can personalize the color and text of the button. 
5. Admin can configure cookies expiry time after which a user will again see the pop if he tries to exit.
6. Admin can set any background image to the exit pop-up.
7. Admin can view a graphical statistics report showing how many users stayed using the app. 

 What benefits does it provide to the store owners?
An exit popup is the best way to convert even those customers who were otherwise abandoning the site. The store admin can use the pop up to showcase the financial encouragements in form of discount coupons which will encourage the user to complete a purchase by redeeming the showcased offer.  

 Moreover, it is the best way to build a more relevant email list generated in the process of unblocking a coupon code by the user. The user has to provide his/her email id to unlock a coupon code for his purchase.  

 The automatic customer account registration can help store admin eliminate the account registration process by using the provided email address of the customer to create a user account. 

 How can you tell if the app is really working for you?
The effective reporting system is capable of generating a graphical report of how the coupon performed and how many users stayed on the site by redeeming the coupons from the app.  

 Why is exit pop up not a risky decision?
The exit pop-up uses the exit intent technology to track the user activities. It shows the pop up only when a user tries to exit your website. So, it's totally a risk-free solution that instead is a better tool to fight shopping cart abandonment on your eCommerce site.  

 How is it different from the Abandoned cart apps?
An abandoned cart app works by capturing the email ids of those customers who leave the site without purchasing, after adding the products to their cart. The email addresses of such customers are used by the site admin to contact them using offers and coupons at later part by sending serial reminders.

title: Better Shipping
description:
What Is Better Shipping? 
 Better shipping lets you set suitable shipping rates so you are not out of pocket. 

 Do you have specialty items that take extra care to ship? Do you have multiple suppliers who charge flat shipping for items? Use Better Shipping to set the shipping rate accordingly. 

 Using 'per product' shipping prices lets you set shipping prices for each one of your products. This means that you can set $5.00 shipping for one of your products, $7.50 for another one, and have free shipping on a third product - it's up to you! 

 You also have the option for tiered shipping. This means that you can set multiple shipping rates for an item depending on the quantity the customer buys. Want to charge $10 for the first item, and then $5 for every extra item? Better Shipping has you covered! 

 Need to charge different shipping rates for different areas? Using the delivery areas feature you are able to set the shipping rate for individual zip/post codes. 

 Only send your products to certain areas? No problem! You can restrict delivery to specific zip/post codes.  
 Should I Be Using Better Shipping In My Store? 
 Better Shipping is perfect for anyone who needs to: 

 
 Set individual shipping prices for every product 
 Set tiered (multiple) shipping prices for every product 
 Charge different shipping rates for multiple drop shipping suppliers 
 Charge additional postage amounts to specific areas and locations 
 Restrict postage to ONLY specific locations 
 Bulk update their per product shipping by product type, collection, or vendor 
 
 How does it work 
 Better Shipping calculates shipping rates based on the customer’s zip or post code and the items they order. A customer ordered a fragile antique? Drop shipping supplier uses flat shipping rates? Need to deliver fresh food afar? Better Shipping allows you to set suitable rates so you are not out of pocket. 
 Features: 
 
 Per Product Shipping Rates - Set a different flat shipping rate for every single product in your store. No need to worry about weight or dimensions. 
 Location based shipping prices - Set shipping prices for specific areas using zip/post codes. 
 Restrict delivery to certain locations - Do you only deliver to certain locations? Set them up so that your customers can only ship to those areas. 
 

 Requires carrier calculated shipping. To discuss adding this to your existing plan, contact Shopify Support.

title: Persistent Cart
description:
Persistent Cart (a top 5 Forbes-recommended Shopify App) increases the number of sales, average purchase size, and customer retention by making sure customers never lose their shopping carts. 
 What Shopping is like WITHOUT Persistent Cart: 
 Let’s say Jim is shopping at work on your store and has 5 items in his shopping cart. Then he gets on a bus to go home and loads your site on his phone. He logs in, only to find a sad and empty shopping cart. He tries to remember what he was going to buy and struggles to add some items to his cart. When he gets home, he hops on his home computer, logs into your store and finds his shopping cart empty again. He gives up, and you lose a sale. 
 What shopping is like WITH Persistent Cart: 
 When Jim is on the bus and logs into your site, his cart automatically loads with the 5 items he added while he was at work. Let’s say he adds 2 more items while he’s on the bus. When he gets home and logs in on his home computer, he’ll have all 7 items in his cart. He can then continue shopping and is much more likely to make a purchase, and his purchase will be bigger. He's also a much happier customer and more likely to shop again on your site. 
 See the difference immediately, a quick experiment 
 Navigate to your store. Log into an account like a customer and add some items to your cart. Then go to a different device or browser and log in. Your original cart will be gone. Install the Persistent Cart free trial by pressing the green "Get" button above, and try the same thing. You won't lose your shopping cart. 
 Customers and Shop Owners Love Persistent Cart 
 
 Better Shopping Experience: More than half e-commerce shoppers shop on multiple devices, and unfortunately, these customers lose their carts each time they switch devices on your site. Persistent cart prevents this and gives your store much more professional and convenient shopping experience. 
 Privacy: Customers expect their shopping carts to be empty when they log out because they value privacy. With Persistent Cart, your shopping cart will finally respect your customer's privacy. 
 Fast and Robust: Persistent cart makes sure that your customer's cart is synced to his or her account within a second of any shopping cart changes.

title: Shopcodes
description:
Why Shopcodes? 
 Shopcodes are scannable QR codes that link customers directly to products on your online store. Your customers will be able to quickly scan Shopcodes with any smartphone camera and purchase your products with the tap of a finger. 

 Integrate Shopcodes with your product packaging or marketing material, and then track conversions and traffic through Shopify Analytics. 
 Features 
 
 Create beautiful Shopcodes for any of your products, through app actions or the app dashboard in Shopify 
 Customize where the Shopcode links to, a product's page or the shopping cart page 
 Incentivize purchases by adding a discounts to your Shopcodes 
 Track conversions and traffic from your Shopcodes with Shopify analytics 
 Make quick edits to your Shopcodes through the app dashboard 
 
 How to use Shopcodes 
 Narrow the distance between shopping offline and buying on mobile. Here are a couple ways Shopcodes can be used. 
 Add Shopcodes to Your Product Packaging 
 By incorporating Shopcodes into your product packaging, offline shoppers can scan them to learn more about your products. 

 You can also encourage existing customers to make repeat purchases by scanning them to go directly to checkout on mobile with all the accelerated checkout options available on mobile devices, such as Apple Pay and Shopify Pay. 

 You can even attach a special discount code to your Shopcodes to reward your current customers for their loyalty. 
 Use Shopcodes at Events, Pop-Ups, and in Your Retail Store 
 Customers can quickly purchase or learn more about a product wherever they find a Shopcode offline. 

 Displaying a Shopcode on the windows of your retail store lets you sell even when your doors are closed to customers by directing them to your Shopify store instead. 

 Running an event or pop-up where inventory space is limited? Get customers to scan and purchase through a Shopcode instead to have their order delivered to their door. 
 Incorporate Shopcodes in Package Inserts, Offline Ads, and More 
 Shopcodes can also be used wherever you advertise offline. 

 Promote other products, partnerships, or discounts with packaging inserts, posters, and other offline marketing materials. 

 Instead of manually typing in your website’s URL on their mobile devices, shoppers can be taken directly to the product in your Shopify store instantly.

description:
PROTECT YOUR STORE & HIDE PRODUCTS FROM GOOGLE 
 You have the option to make your product NOT show up in the Google SERPS (search engine results pages). 
 APPLY THE NOFOLLOW AND/OR NOINDEX META TAG 
 Make sure that you take control over what content of your store is being indexed and followed by the search engines by using the noindex and/or the nofollow metatags. 
 INTERNAL SEARCH SHOWS ALL PRODUCTS 
 Your store’s internal search is not affected and your products can still be found through the store’s search functionality. 
 Use the "Product Hider - No Follow & No Index Meta Tag SEO Manager" app to hide your products from Google, Bing and Yahoo! Why should you use the Product Hider app? 
 If you wish to hide a certain page or a product from the search engines, this is the perfect app for you! It allows you to instruct search engines not to include your page in the search results and/or not to follow the links on your page. 

 This is a very straightforward and easy-to-use tool for store owners. It gives you full control about what products, pages etc. search engines shall index and what shall be hidden from Google, Bing, Yahoo, etc.  

 The noindex tag tells search engines that the page should not be shown in their search results. Without the nofollow tag, however, search engines will still follow all the links on the page. In other words, the page will be read by search engines but it won't be indexed. 

 The nofollow tag is a html attribute which instructs search engines to refrain from following a link and thereby transfer so called ‘SEO juice’ to the page it links to. 

 The advantage of not using the nofollow tag combined with the noindex tag is that the Google Pagerank can flow through the noindex. This gives ‘juice’ and authority to the linked pages which are linked to. If the nofollow attribute is activated, this doesn't happen.

title: TrendSeam
description:
Instantly gain a deeper understanding about your store and find sales opportunities. 

 We use your Shopify data to give you a greater understanding of your customers and their buying habits. By automatically importing your sales data we can show you your best and worst selling products, most loyal customers and display year-on-year trends. 

 The patterns of how your customers purchase your goods should the most valuable information for making decisions about how you run your store. TrendSeam solves problems of the unfathomable lists of sales data, by highlighting key information to help you run a more profitable, more efficient e-commerce store - and help you focus on growth. 

 Some examples of real problems TrendSeam solves... 

 
 Get visibility when particular size or model of a product line is more popular than others, which you can adjust your re-stock order accordingly (TrendSeam suggests new buying ratios). 
 See how your customers buy; identify those who make repeat orders and the average time between orders, so you can optimize your marketing activity 
 Learn about specific products that aren't selling well, when they last sold, and what inventory is a liability 
 Understand where in the world your customers live, plotted on maps (UK only currently) 
 See at a glance which products give you the best ROI (actual margin) rather than just opaque sales totals 
 

 TrendSeam contains hundreds of opportunities that with just a little data (including retrospective sales) will help you improve your store to be more effective, as well as help you make key decisions about your supply chain.

title: Smart Product Filter
description:
Smart Product Filters for Shopify 
 What is the first thing you do when you are in an unfamiliar area? Do you check the map or use the navigation system on your phone? Your store is an unfamiliar area to new users and without a good ‘map’ (e.g. Menu, Product Filter, Product Search) they might get lost and leave. 

 Smart Product Filter app won’t let this happen. Your customers are able to accurately find the products they want within seconds. 
 Filter Method 
 You can create multiple product filters for your shop depending on your goods’ attributes. This app allows you to build the perfect product filters for your store. The different filtering methods that the app provides are as follows: 

 
 Filter by variant 
 Filter by size 
 Filter by color 
 Filter by price 
 Filter by tag(s) 
 Filter by collection 
 Filter by vendor 
 Filter by brand 
 Filter by type 
 Filter by inventory 
 Filter by sale percentage 
 
 Other Features of Smart Product Filters 
 
 Supports multiple filters; you can create different filters for different collections. For example; Clothing collections & Shoe collections are different. Using the app you are able to assign different filters for Clothing & Shoes. 
 Allows you to set a specific order for the filters. 
 Supports filtering by tag. You can select a number of tags and group them into a filter ‘block’. 
 Process product filters with Ajax 
 Allows customers to share filter results via URL. 
 Supports 3 filter layouts: Horizontal, Vertical and Off-Canvas. 
 Supports product color swatch. You can display product color swatch without any app. 
 Your customers won’t see any blank pages (no product(s)) on the collection page because only available options are displayed. 
 [New feature] Group multiple values to one value. Example: Light blue, dark blue and blue to a blue master value. 
 [New feature] Match with your layout’s theme. As not all themes are currently supported; if your theme is unsupported please do not hesitate to contact us if you need your products to be displayed as they are in your layout’s theme. 
 
 We need you to give us a hand

description:
SKU Print makes printing customized barcode labels & price tags a simple task. Our labels display product information including the title, vendor, variants, price and barcodes that can be scanned directly into the Shopify Point-of-Sale or Admin area.  Automatic barcode generator 
 SKU Print uses your current barcode numbers or can generate numbers automatically if none are present in the barcode field from within the product page. Barcode numbers can be edited or changes from within the app as well generate new barcodes.

 Uses hardware you already own

description:
Make shopping in your store easier: Checkout at any position in your site 
 Your customers can check out at any position in your site just by tapping on the button, which is displayed on the bottom of the screen. 
 Let your customers view what they added to the carts 
 They can also check what they added to the cart before leaving for the checkout page.  
 Add products to cart and keep shopping 
 You can change the settings of the button so that by tapping on it, your customers add the product they are viewing to the cart and continue their shopping without being directed to any page. 
 Increase traffic to important pages 
 Instant Buy allows users to create a button with a redirect link to redirect customers from one page to another page.  
 Display the button at the suitable time 
 You can edit the triggers for the button to be displayed at the suitable time. Display the button when customers look for it and hide it when it’s not necessary to save the screen’s space. 
 Customize the button 
 Don’t like the add-to-cart button? You can change it to whatever you find suitable for your store. The text and color of the button can be edited quickly and easily as you want it. 
 Track customers by adding a Facebook pixel code to the button 
 Instant Buy allows users to add Facebook pixel code into the add-to-cart button. You can create an audience for Facebook advertising, retarget those who abandoned their carts and bring them back to your store. 
 What you can do with the app An add-to-cart button at product detail page 
 This button only displays when your customers view a particular product. When your customers scroll to view your product, the button will display at the bottom of the screen. 

 
 You can change what happens when your customers tap on it: 
 

 
 Check out page: Add the product to cart and direct customers to checkout pages 
 Cart page: Add the product to cart and show them what they added to cart. 
 Current page: Add the product to cart and keep them on the current page. 
 

 
 With this button, you can change when to display the button to avoid narrowing the screen: 
 

 
 10% scroll: Button displays when customers scroll 10% down the page 
 50% scroll: Button displays when customers scroll 50% down the page 
 No scroll: The button is fixed at the bottom of the screen while customers view your product. 
 
 A random button to lead your customers to any page 
 This type of button is displayed at all but the product detail pages. You only have to insert the link to the target page, your customers will be directed to that page when tapping on the button.
The text of all buttons can be edited.

title: StockBot
description:
Stockbot lets you know when your stock is low 
 
 Want to know which products in your store are running low on inventory? 
 Want to get a daily email with low-stock products so you can reorder stock? 
 How about forecasting sales so you can restock ahead of time? 
 

 When it comes to tracking low-stock products, we are all you need! 
 How does Stockbot work? Simple! 
 
 You set a low-stock alert level and your email preference : Daily/ Weekly/ Hourly. 
 When any variant's inventory falls below your low-stock alert level we include it in the report emailed to you. 
 There is no limit on the number of email recipients  
 An Excel-friendly report file is attached with every email  
 
 What other features does Stockbot have? Glad you asked! 
 
 You can set low-stock alert levels on specific products or variants or even collections 
 Don't want to wait for the low-stock email? The app has a web report online displaying the latest low-stock variants. 
 Want to be emailed as soon as a variant runs low on stock? Try the Hourly option which checks for low-stock on the hour 24x7 
 Inventory Forecasting feature allows you to restock even before an SKU reaches low-stock levels.
SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) refers to any variant that can be purchased by a customer 
 
 How does Inventory Forecasting work? 
 
 Using your store's past sales history the app can forecast future sales of every SKU 
 It identifies SKUs that are about to go low-stock using forecasted sales and inventory-on-hand 
 Forecasting saves you from losing sales because you can now replenish your stock before they sell out.  
 The app also identifies SKUs with Slow Sales to help you better manage inventory costs. 
 
 Does the app change the look of my store? 
 No! the app does not change anything on your store.
The app only reads the latest inventory and product information from Shopify to put together the low-stock report 
 30-day Money Back guarantee 
 If you uninstall the app within 30 days of installation, we will refund your entire billed amount.  
 How do I start the 14-day Free Trial for the app? 
 
 During installation when you land on the billing plans page, choose a billing plan that offers the features you need. 
 This starts the 14-day free trial with access to all the features in the chosen billing plan  
 Once the 14-day free trial ends, you will be charged as per the monthly billing plan you chose. 
 If you uninstall the app within 14 days you will not be charged anything  
 
 About us 
 
 We've been helping Shopify stores manage inventory for the past 5 years under the StoreBuilder brand. 
 We offer amazing customer support and regularly add features based on customer feedback

title: Tax Exempt Manager
description:
Get your shop ready for sale under EU law 
 LatoriApps Tax Exempt Manager helps you comply with EU directives.
Surely you know about the problem that B2B customers in other EU countries can or must buy without VAT. This is not that easy, because this is only the case if a customer transmits his VAT ID to you and can then also buy tax-free in the shop.  
 What does EU law say about this exactly? 
 Cross-border deliveries of goods to companies within the EU (B2B) are tax-free in the country of origin and are subject to purchase tax by the buyer in the country of destination. 

 No VAT is charged on exports to countries outside the EU (third country). In this case, VAT must be paid in the country of destination. This requires proof that the goods have been exported to a country outside the EU. 
 So how can LatoriApps Tax Exempt Manager help you? 
 
 The algorithm 
 

 LatoriApps has developed an algorithm that collects and automatically checks your customer's VAT ID using the official EU database VIES for tax numbers of the European Commission. If the entered VAT ID corresponds to the correct sample, the customer can buy automatically without VAT. He does not have to create an account and you as store owner do not have to do anything to enable him to do so. 

 
 Easy installation 
 

 Tax Exempt Manager is easy to integrate. Just add the app to your shop and it installs itself almost completely. You only need to enter the text field for the VAT ID - of course we provide the code as well as detailed instructions.  

 
 Keep the overview 
 

 We list an overview of all orders that have been created after a positive VAT ID check, so that you always have an overview. 
 What's next? 
 Sit back and let Tax Exempt Manager do the work for you. You continue to take care of your business - Latori Apps takes care of tax regulation. 
 Enjoy selling!

description:
Manual review staffing is a significant cost to one's business and it will increase the budget and cost of one project. With FraudLabs Pro SMS Verification APP, business owner can streamline transactions by triggering authentication only for only those suspected of being fraudulent.  

 FraudLabs Pro SMS Verification APP that helps merchants to authenticate the client’s identity by sending them an SMS for verification. It is designed to trigger on the cart page to validate the uniqueness of the client. If the client is unable to verify themselves, they are not allowed to proceed to the checkout page. This can help to protect the merchants from payment fraud. 
 How does it work? 
 The system will display the input box on the cart page for clients to enter a valid mobile number to receive the One-Time-Password (OTP). After the clients have successfully verified the OTP on the cart page, they may then proceed to the checkout page for payment completion. 
 Free credits to try out the App 
 Upon the initial installation of the FraudLabs Pro SMS Verification App, 10 free SMS credits will be added to your account. 1 credit will be consumed for each SMS verification that is sent. description:
How Globo Request a Quote Works 
 Globo Request a Quote allows your customers to submit quotes for any product and bargain for the best price. If you agree with these quotes, you can turn them into orders! 

 Your customers can click on the “request for quote” button and fill in the request for quote form. After they submit a price quote, an email will be sent to you automatically (store owner). 
 Convert a quote to an order 
 If you agree with your customers’ bargain price, you can convert the "request a quote" to an order as well as an invoice. An order email will be automatically sent to your customer. The customer then just needs to finalize checkout to complete the order. 
 Upload file to request a quote 
 Depending on your business, and products, you may need your customers to send you a photo, a PDF file, etc. to give them a reasonable price. Request a Quote app supports this feature with the following file extensions: JPG, JPEG, PNG, PSD, AI, STL, STP, STEP, DOC, DOCX, TXT, CSV, and PDF. If you require other file extensions, please contact us. 
 Editable email template 
 Email communication is indispensable for online businesses. That's why this app allows you to edit email templates that are sent to you and your customers. You can edit your shop’s logo, email content, and other information. The customers’ submitted data is displayed on the email as well. 
 Customizable quotes form with Form Builder 
 You can create a complex quote form without any coding experience because “Request a Quote” app provides a form building feature. It is an easy-to-use tool to build a "quote form" by using it’s drag-drop function. 
 Hide product price and Add to Cart button 
 You can hide product prices and “Add to cart” buttons in the settings section with just one click.

title: Multi Country Pricing
description:
The Multi Country Pricing App: 
 Multi Country Pricing app allows setting different prices for different countries in different currency. This can largely increase your sales, revenue and profit. However, one requires to create a separate online store for different countries to set multi currency pricing. Our app enables you to achieve exactly the same with your existing store. It not only saves your money and headache of managing multiple stores but also allows you to expand your horizon across your borders. 
 How it works: 
 The app automatically detects the country of the website visitor and displays the pricing which you have set for the respective product for that respective country. You can set lower/higher prices for different countries by creating variants as mentioned in the FAQ page. Please note that, the app will allow you to sell a single product at multiple prices in multiple countries in any currency. e.g. If your store is based in US, than you can sell a single artefact at $100 USD in US and at £120 GBP in UK to cover your shipping costs or maybe earn higher profits! Please note that the checkout will happen in your store currency only because Shopify does not allow checkout in any other currencies than your store currency. 
 Why you should install 
 Same product has different values in different countries due to variety of reasons. Therefore, it does not make any sense for a store owner to sell their products at same price in different countries. If you are doing or planning to expand your business across countries, and looking for an app which allows you to set separate price for separate country/continent, this app is for you!  
 Developers' Support: 
 The app requires you to do certain settings after installation. Please write us an email at after you install the app with required details. We will setup the app within 48 hours.

title: NS8 Protect
description:
Protect your shop from order fraud, advertising fraud, and poor performance. 

 NS8 Protect uses industry-leading techniques in behavioral analytics, real-time user scoring, and global monitoring to identify bots and other malicious activity in your storefront. As a platform-based approach to online fraud protection, NS8 Protect is designed to help your store fight the three big revenue killers: order fraud, advertising fraud, and poor performance. 
 Revenue Killer #1: Order Fraud 
 NS8 Protect scores every visitor to your storefront. Every action taken by the visitor leading up to and including placing an order is scored individually and reflected in the EQ8 Score. Low-scoring orders are most likely fraudulent and may be held or flagged for manual review. NS8 Protect also provides automated tools to escalate suspect orders or even request e-mail and SMS text verification from the visitor. The mix of automated tools and easier manual reviews empowers merchants to optimize their order processing and minimize risk. 

 
 Benefit from the network of stores and websites already tagging fraudulent users and suspicious behavior by using NS8 software. 
 Reduce costly chargebacks and the risk they pose to your merchant account. 
 Reduce both the labor dedicated to manual review and shipping lead times. 
 Set your own custom threshold for suspect orders and users. 
 
 Revenue Killer #2: Advertising Fraud 
 Advertising fraud (especially remarketing fraud) is a huge and growing issue for online merchants. NS8 Protect not only scores all traffic visiting your store, but it also detects and records the traffic’s source. You will see which advertising sources are delivering high-risk and potentially fraudulent traffic. You will then be able to save money and increase revenue by eliminating poorly performing campaigns and focusing your budget on the successful campaigns that deliver results. 
 Revenue Killer #3: Poor Performance 
 NS8 Protect includes 5 critical monitors that every Shopify store should have. If and when an issue arises, escalating text messages are sent to you and your staff warning of potential or actual problems. 

 No coding or site changes required! 

 We handle the integration via the Shopify API. 

 Once you install the app, just turn the features on, and you will have your shop protected immediately.

description:
Zendesk Chat - turn browsers into buyers, resolve customer inquiries faster, and increase customer happiness. 
 Zendesk Chat allows your agents to engage customers over your Shopify storefront, mobile apps, and popular messaging apps like Facebook Messenger, Twitter, and Line. That means you can build relationships with customers in the places they prefer. 

 
 Access relevant customer Shopify data such as order information, billing, and shipping from within Zendesk Chat. This reduces context-switching for agents, driving productivity, increasing customer satisfaction and ultimately lifetime value. 
 Easily navigate to additional data in Shopify by clicking the Order ID. 
 Add live chat to any Shopify-powered site to convert browsers into buyers, increase average order value, reduce cart abandonment, and improve customer satisfaction. 
 

 The Zendesk Chat integration for Shopify arms your agents with all the information they need when conversing with your customer, without having to leave the chat conversation -  leading to a faster and more pleasant experience for your customers. 
 How to get started 
 To get started you will need to have or create an account for Zendesk Support that is linked to an account for Zendesk Chat .
Once you have set up those accounts you will be given a Zendesk account subdomain that you will be asked to enter during the setup of this integration. Once entered, you can then easily enable the display of the widget via the integration's setup page; no additional code is required to be pasted into your Shopify site. 

 To explore the end user experience after linking your Shopify and Zendesk Chat accounts, just log into your Zendesk Chat account, ensure an agent is available and then visit your Shopify site to start a chat. 

 Note: The app is free for Zendesk customers who are on the Team Plan or above.

 Log in / Create your MoonMail account 
 Choose a list you'd like to keep in sync. 
 
 Connecting Shopify & MoonMail account brings you a host of superpowers: 
 
 Keep your email marketing streamlined automatically through Shopify.

MoonMail's powerful marketing automation tools, now available for all free accounts, make it easy to reach your customers quickly and deliver the right message at the right time. description:
Migrate products from WooCommerce to Shopify. 
 With the help of our app you can migrate your WooCommerce products to your Shopify store in few very simple steps. 
 Why you should use this app? 
 Let me explain what this app can do for you. Let us say you are a website developer and you got a new project to shift a WordPress WooCommerce website to Shopify store. For that you may be first downloading products information from WooCommerce and then from that WooCommerce file you must be trying to create csv file according to Shopify csv format. At this point our app will help you in a better way. With the help of our app you will be able to migrate WooCommerce products simply by clicking buttons. Steps are very simple as given below.
* Install our app & activate charge.
* Enter your WordPress website url, enter consumer key & enter consumer secret.
* Synchronize all of your WooCommerce products to our app.
* Click on migrate buttons to migrate your WooCommerce product to your Shopify store. 

 We created this app because we know that when trying to export a spreadsheet (CSV) of WooCommerce products from WordPress admin the format of that csv does not matches with format of Shopify product import csv. That's a problem if your staff members needs a quick migration tool to migrate WooCommerce products to Shopify store. With the help of this app you will be able to migrate product titles, product descriptions, variants, images, weight, inventory_quantity, tags etc directly on Shopify store by just clicking "Transfer" buttons both effectively and quickly. It's also very simple and easy to use. They are clearly available for you as soon as you install the app and there is no coding knowledge required. Just as simple as opening the app or clicking buttons.

title: Bold Social Autopilot
description:
Bold Social Autopilot is designed to take the pressure off you and let you worry about your store while our app does your social posting for you. 
 How it works 
 Every time you list a new product or publish a new blog post, the app will Tweet it at random intervals with a different message (that you create), putting a large portion of your social media tasks on autopilot :) 
 What makes our app different? 
 Unlike other apps, with Bold Social Autopilot you can set the intervals to any hour span you want so it doesn't clutter your feeds, and our built-in randomizer tool makes each post different so it doesn’t make you look like a robot. And you can create multiple templates for the posts so they're different every time.  
 Setting it up 
 It's SO easy to set up.
1. After you install the app you'll click one button to connect to your Twitter account and away you go.
2. Next you just create a bunch of different Tweet templates for the Blog and Product announcements. 

 When composing your template, just stick the Product and Blog title merge fields wherever you like and wrap it with our genius marketing magic. So one Tweet might look like this:
* We just released our latest product, the Super Product 2000! What do you think of it? http://linkurl.com 

 And then the next time it might look like this:
* Good News! We now carry the Super Product 3000. We just got them and and they're going fast. http://linkurl.com 
 That's it, you're done! 
 You never need to touch the app again, it will run in the background forever! Now go focus on your business and let the app take care of your product and blog announcements for you. 

 
             
               Integrates with 
               
                 
     
      Twitter

Convert, grow, retain more customers by automatic product recommendations. 
 Easy Suggestions+ is an affordable recommendation engine to increase your sales and engagement by automatically displaying product suggestions to your visitors and it is exclusively made for Shopify. 

 You can easily maximize your Shopify store revenue through smarter recommendations. The artificial intelligence of Easy Suggestions+ can automatically display the most relevant products for your each visitor. 
 Key benefits of our recommendation engine 
 
 Increase sales by automatic product recommendations 
 Increase average order value by cross selling and up selling 
 Gain higher engagement and loyalty from your customers 
 
 Manual Product Recommendations 
 Easy Suggestions+ analyzes the behavior of every visitor on your Shopify store to build unique customer data for displaying the most relevant products but you can also manually personalize cross-sells and up-sells for your every product. 
 Real-time Performance Reporting 
 Using manually curated or algorithmically-driven recommendations, Easy Suggestions+ not just tells you "you are going to sell more", it also gives you the ability to track exactly what is going on about product recommendations on your store. You can track click and order statistics per product. You can even instantly track product recommendations which are resulted in an order on your store. 
 No Need for IT Support

The artificial intelligence of Easy Suggestions+ will immediately start to work to show the most relevant product recommendations to your visitors. Recommendations improve as the Easy Suggestions+ learn more about your store and visitors. 
 Special Customization 
 Do you require a unique design implementation? We customize the product suggestion widgets to look like an integral part of your Shopify store, matching your existing design without any interruption. 
 We Value Your Opinions 
 We really care about your opinions and we would like to continuously develop our app with your suggestions. Easy Suggestions+ is a regularly updated application which always uses the latest technology and automatically adapts your needs.  
 Simple Pricing 
 We are offering one fixed price for Easy Suggestions+. There is no plan to choose and there is no limitation. No hidden costs. No setup cost. No customization cost and we are not even interested in your store's revenue or Shopify plan to charge you more.

title: Pre‑order PRO | Pre‑orderly
description:
How does Preorderly work? 
 Preorderly has 2 modes: 

 Mode 1:
Preorderly kicks in regardless of current quantity level. Preorderly replaces the standard "Add To Cart" button with a "Pre-order" button that enables your customers to pre-order your products. 

 Mode 2:
Preorderly kicks in only when current quantity level is 0 or below. Preorderly replaces the standard "Out of Stock" button with a "Pre-order" button that enables your customers to buy your products even when they’re out of stock. For this mode to work Inventory Management must be handled by Shopify and "Allow customers to purchase this product when it's out of stock" must be enabled otherwise it will show as sold out. 

 Preorderly will clearly convey the message about availability and delivery timelines to your customers by displaying a brief message alongside the "Pre-order" button. It can be used to inform when product deliveries are expected to start etc... 

 Preorderly is the perfect app for product launches or accepting pre-orders for out of stock products and generating additional revenue! 

 Preorderly is NOT yet compatible with the "availability" Schema attribute. If you are using Google Shopping Feed it is important that you make sure you send correct value (PreOrder) for products that use Preorderly. 
 Preorderly features (some of many) 
 
 Apply pre-order settings to variants or entire products 
 Automatically show the "Pre-order" button when inventory goes below 0 (Inventory Management must be handled by Shopify and "Allow customers to purchase this product when it's out of stock" must be enabled otherwise it will show as sold out) 
 Schedule start and end date/time for pre-orders 
 Limit quantity available for pre-order 
 Completely customizable 
 Order tagging so you can quickly find orders containing pre-order products 
 Cart labels of products that are on pre-order 
 
 TECHNICAL AND DESIGN SUPPORT? FREE! 
 The app works and looks good out-of-the-box but we can fine-tune it for you. Just send us an email.
